results.summary: A beautifully presented top two bedroom apartment, benefitting from a large walk out balcony and ~ALLOCATED PARKING SPACE~ Devonshire Grange is a popular McCarthy Stone retirement living development. Devonshire Grange - Devonshire Grange was built by McCarthy & Stone purpose built for retirement living. The development consists of 41 one and two-bedroom retirement apartments for the over 60's. You can relax, knowing that there's a House Manager on hand during office hours as well as the added benefit of having security features. These include a 24-hour emergency call system should you require assistance and a camera door entry system linked to your TV, so you can see who's calling before letting them in. There's no need to worry about being weighed down by maintenance costs either as the service charge covers the cost of external maintenance, gardening and landscaping, window cleaning, buildings insurance, water rates, security and energy costs of the homeowners lounge with kitchen facilities and other communal areas. Local Area - A cosmopolitan and highly sought after district of Leeds, Roundhay is ideally located just over 3 miles from the city centre. With stunning Victorian architecture and an excellent selection of bars, restaurants, pubs and independent shops, it is clear to see why Roundhay is such a popular place to live. A range of amenities can be found close by the development on bustling Street Lane, including a Coop, a Sainsbury's Local, a Starbucks, a butchers and a range of high-end shops. There are also a number of eateries including the famous Flying Pizza restaurant. There is a Tesco supermarket in nearby Oakwood, which can be reached easily by car or bus. There is also a Marks & Spencer Simply Food a short drive away at nearby Moortown. Entrance Hall - Front door with spy hole leads to the large entrance hall - the 24-hour Tunstall emergency response pull cord system is situated in the hall. From the hallway there is a door to a storage cupboard and a door to a second storage cupboard with a washer/dryer. Illuminated light switches, smoke detector, apartment security door entry system with intercom and emergency pull cord located in the hall. Doors lead to the lounge, bedrooms and bathroom. Lounge - A beautifully bright and spacious living room, benefitting from a large balcony, overlooking the communal grounds. There is a feature electric fire with surround which acts as an attractive focal point and there is ample space for dining. TV and telephone points, two ceiling lights, fitted carpets and raised electric power sockets. A partially glazed door leads into the kitchen. Kitchen - Fully tiled and fitted kitchen with a range of modern low and eye level units and drawers with a roll top work surface. Stainless steel sink with mono lever tap, drainer and UPVC double glazed window above. Built-in oven and microwave, ceramic hob with extractor hood and fitted integrated fridge, freezer, dishwasher and under pelmet lighting. Bedroom One - Double bedroom with a large double glazed window. Ceiling light, TV phone point, fitted carpets and raised electric power sockets. Separate doors lead to a walk-in wardrobe, housing shelving and hanging rails. Bedroom Two - Generous second bedroom with a double glazed window. Three door built in wardrobe with plenty of hanging space. Ceiling light, fitted carpets and raised electric power sockets. Shower Room - Fully tiled and fitted with modern suite comprising of a walk in shower with glass screen, adjustable shower head over and hand rail. WC, vanity unit with sink and illuminated mirror above, heated towel rail and emergency pull cord. Service Charge (Breakdown) - • Cleaning of communal windows • Water rates for communal areas and apartments • Electricity, heating, lighting and power to communal areas • 24-hour emergency call system • Upkeep of gardens and grounds • Repairs and maintenance to the interior and exterior communal areas • Contingency fund including internal and external redecoration of communal areas • Buildings insurance The service charge does not cover external costs such as your Council Tax, electricity or TV. Find out more about service charges please contact your Property Consultant or House Manager. The annual service charge is £4,155.12 for financial year ending 30/06/2026. Ask about our FREE ENTITLEMENTS SERVICE to find out what benefits you may be entitled to. Lease Information - Lease: 999 years from 1st Jan 2017 Ground rent: £495 per annum Ground rent review: 1st Jan 2032 Managed by: McCarthy and Stone Management Services It is a condition of purchase that all residents must meet the age requirements of 60 years. Parking Space - A parking space is included in the sale Moving Made Easy & Additional Information - Moving is a huge step, but don’t let that hold you back. We have a range of services to help your move go smoothly, including: • FREE Entitlements Advice to help you find out what benefits you may be entitled. • Part Exchange service to help you move without the hassle of having to sell your own home. • Removal Services that can help you declutter and move you in to your new home. • Conveyancing specialists who are experienced with sales and purchases of McCarthy Stone retirement properties. results.summary: Offered for sale with NO ONWARD CHAIN, this extended, three-bedroom semi-detached house sits in a generous corner plot and benefits from having dual driveways and a larger than average garage. The property would benefit from some updating and would be ideal for anyone looking to develop a property to their own style and taste. Ideally situated within walking distance of Morley town centre, this three-bedroom semi-detached house would benefit from some updating but has huge potential and would be ideal for anyone looking to create their ideal home. A viewing is essential to fully appreciate everything this fabulous property has to offer. The ground floor accommodation comprises; - front entrance hall with stairs rising to the first floor and understairs storage, guest WC, spacious living room with ample space for a dining table and a feature bay window overlooking the front garden, completing the ground floor is a large breakfast kitchen to the rear extension. The kitchen has fitted wall and base units, integrated appliances and plumbing is in place for an automatic washing machine. On the first floor there are three bedrooms, two of which are doubles and the third is a good sized single, all of them have fitted wardrobes. The shower room is fully tiled and has a walk-in shower, WC, wash basin and linen cupboard. The landing provides access to the loft which offers a useful additional storage space. Externally, the property has gardens to three sides and two driveways which offer ample off-street parking leading to a larger than average garage which is complete with fitted light and power. The low maintenance front garden has established plants and bushes to the borders; the side garden is mainly laid to lawn and to the rear there is a generous patio area which enjoys a high degree of privacy and is an ideal space for enjoying a barbecue. results.summary: Cornerstone are delighted to offer for sale this well presented, 2018 built two bedroom three-storey corner townhouse, ideally positioned on Asket Row, Leeds, LS14 1EN. Cornerstone are delighted to offer for sale this well presented 2018 built two bedroom three-storey corner townhouse, ideally positioned on Asket Row, Leeds, LS14 1EN. Occupying a desirable corner plot, this attractive home enjoys both a front and side garden along with a block-paved driveway, providing off-street parking and excellent kerb appeal. A pathway leads through the front garden to a stylish composite front door, which opens into a welcoming entrance hallway. The ground floor is thoughtfully laid out, comprising a well-proportioned bedroom, a modern house bathroom complete with a useful utility cupboard that has space for a washing machine, and an additional storage cupboard housing the gas boiler. This level is ideal for guests, home working, or flexible family living. From the hallway, a staircase rises to the first floor, where the real heart of the home is revealed. The impressive open-plan kitchen, dining and living area is flooded with natural light thanks to dual-aspect windows, creating a bright and airy space perfect for both relaxing and entertaining. The kitchen is well-equipped with an excellent range of wall and base units, generous worktop space, and a selection of integrated appliances, including a separate fridge and freezer, an integrated oven with hob, stainless steel splashback and extractor, along with a sink and drainer. The open layout allows for comfortable dining and lounging zones, making this a superb social space. A further staircase from the living area leads to the second (top) floor, which is dedicated to the spacious principal bedroom suite. This tranquil retreat again benefits from dual-aspect windows and is complemented by its own en suite bathroom, which is fully tiled and fitted with a bath, offering a private and relaxing haven. Externally, the corner position enhances privacy and outdoor space, while the driveway provides practical parking — a valuable feature. The property is superbly situated just moments from Wykebeck Way, a fantastic green route that winds through the lesser-known Wykebeck Valley, connecting the stunning Roundhay Park with Temple Newsam via a network of quiet roads, cycle tracks and parkland paths — perfect for walkers, runners and cyclists alike. Located in East Leeds, Asket Row offers excellent access to local amenities, including Seacroft Shopping Centre, with more extensive facilities available at nearby Crossgates, which boasts a railway station, a wide range of shops, bars and eateries. The area is well served by the A58 Wetherby Road and A64 York Road, with easy access to the M1 motorway and Leeds City Centre, making this an ideal home for commuters. An ideal purchase for first-time buyers, professionals or downsizers alike, this stylish townhouse combines flexible living accommodation, a fantastic location and excellent transport links. A viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate everything this superb home has to offer. Important Information - Tenure - Freehold. Council Tax Band B. We carry out electronic anti-money laundering (AML) checks on all buyers and giftors. A non-refundable fee of £36.00 (including VAT) will be charged per individual to cover the cost of these checks. results.summary: The Property This superb four-bedroom semi-detached property has been beautifully presented and finished to an excellent standard throughout, offering spacious and stylish accommodation ideal for modern family living. With a contemporary interior, generous outdoor space, and a highly convenient location, this impressive home is one not to be missed. Early viewing is strongly recommended. Situated within the popular LS12 area, the property is positioned along a shared private driveway behind large sliding composite gates. It is ideally located for commuters, providing excellent access to local bus and rail links as well as Leeds City Centre. Internally, the ground floor showcases a stunning open-plan kitchen diner, designed with both style and functionality in mind. The modern kitchen offers ample worktop space, a central island, extensive under-counter storage, and integrated appliances, alongside generous space for family dining and entertaining. To the rear, a bright and airy conservatory provides additional versatile living space and enjoys pleasant views over the garden. The spacious lounge, featuring a large bay window, is filled with natural light and offers a comfortable and inviting setting. The first floor continues to impress with four well-proportioned bedrooms, all tastefully decorated in neutral tones, with one currently configured as a walk-in wardrobe. The family bathroom is stylishly appointed with a low-level push flush W/C, hand wash basin, and a panelled bath with shower over. In addition, the convenient separate shower room features a walk-in shower, W/C, and hand wash basin, providing added practicality for family living. Externally, the property benefits from off-street parking to the front. To the rear, a substantial hard-standing area provides parking for multiple vehicles alongside a detached garage. The impressive rear garden, complete with artificial lawn, offers a fantastic outdoor space perfect for relaxing. Property Description Disclaimer This is a general description of the property only, and is not intended to constitute part of an offer or contract. It has been verified by the seller(s), unless marked as 'draft'. Purplebricks conducts some valuations online and some of our customers prepare their own property descriptions, so if you decide to proceed with a viewing or an offer, please note this information may have been provided solely by the vendor, and we may not have been able to visit the property to confirm it. If you require clarification on any point then please contact us, especially if you’re traveling some distance to view. All information should be checked by your solicitor prior to exchange of contracts. Successful buyers will be required to complete anti-money laundering and proof of funds checks. Our partner, Lifetime Legal Limited, will carry out the initial checks on our behalf. The current non-refundable cost is £80 inc. VAT per offer. You’ll need to pay this to Lifetime Legal and complete all checks before we can issue a memorandum of sale. The cost includes obtaining relevant data and any manual checks and monitoring which might be required, and includes a range of benefits. Purplebricks will receive some of the fee taken by Lifetime Legal to compensate for its role in providing these checks. results.summary: With accommodation all arranged over one floor is this charming three bedroom, two bathroom period conversion of a former stable block in the heart of the historic village of Walton. The property is in excellent condition throughout having been comprehensively refurbished and improved in recent years by the current owner and benefits from a double garage and car port. The property is approached through the beautifully landscaped walled courtyard garden which is low maintenance with stone flags and is a fabulous sun trap. Once through the front door the property opens up to a spacious dining hall with vaulted ceilings, in the heart of the house is a stunning modern fitted kitchen complete with induction hob, two ovens, stone worktops and breakfast bar whilst there are oak stairs that lead down to a storage room and a stable door gives access to the garage with EV charger and carport. Completing the living accommodation is a separate utility room and fabulous living room with vaulted ceilings, exposed beams and feature stone fireplace with wood burning stove. A bright corridor leads to the master bedroom which benefits from fitted wardrobes and a luxurious ensuite with walk-in shower, there are two further double bedrooms which benefit from fitted wardrobes and a magnificent family bathroom with walk-in shower and separate bath. As period properties such as this are in short supply an early viewing is highly recommended. Walton is a charming medieval village centred around a picturesque church and a strong, thriving community. It offers a local cricket club and a well-regarded restaurant/inn, adding to its appeal. There is also a farm shop being built in the village which is to open this year. The village is ideally positioned for excellent connectivity, with easy access to the region’s motorway network via the nearby A1, linking to the M1 and M62. results.summary: A fantastic opportunity to acquire this beautifully presented four-bedroom semi-detached home, set within the highly sought-after village of Bardsey and surrounded by protected green belt countryside, offering a perfect balance of rural tranquillity and modern living. Set on a generous plot and spanning over 2,300 sq. ft., this impressive home has been carefully updated - featuring fully replaced windows, and meticulously maintained by its current owners. The result is a stylish and versatile layout, perfectly suited to modern family living. The property is approached via a private driveway providing ample parking, leading to a welcoming entrance hallway that sets the tone for the rest of the home. The elegant sitting room features a characterful exposed brick fireplace with a wood-burning stove, creating a warm and inviting space, while seamlessly flowing into a bright and airy dining room - perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. At the heart of the home lies a stunning open plan dining kitchen, designed with both style and functionality in mind. Fitted with high quality appliances and sleek modern worktops, this impressive space enjoys views over the beautifully landscaped rear garden. Additional ground floor accommodation includes a generous family room, a practical utility room with access to the integral garage, and a convenient guest WC. To the first floor, a spacious landing leads to four well-proportioned bedrooms and a contemporary house bathroom, recently refurbished to a high standard. The principal bedroom is a true highlight, featuring a stylish en-suite shower room and access to a private balcony, where you can enjoy uninterrupted views across the surrounding countryside. The remaining bedrooms offer excellent flexibility for family life, guests, or home working. Externally, the property enjoys a high degree of privacy, with mature, well-established gardens to both the front and rear. Thoughtfully landscaped with trees, planting, and hedging, the outdoor space provides a peaceful retreat - ideal for entertaining, family activities, or simply relaxing in a beautiful setting. Bardsey is a charming and historic village, mentioned in the Domesday Book, and offers a wonderful community atmosphere. Local amenities include a well-regarded primary school, parish church, tennis club, and the renowned Bingley Arms pub. The property is also ideally positioned for commuters, with excellent access to Leeds via the A58 and connections to the A1 and wider motorway network. Nearby Collingham and the market town of Wetherby provide a further range of shops, restaurants, and everyday conveniences. results.summary: Set within the highly regarded village of Thorp Arch, this impressive period home blends timeless character with exceptional contemporary living. Beautifully presented throughout, the property offers generous proportions, refined finishes, and thoughtfully designed spaces that cater perfectly to modern family life. From the moment you arrive, the home’s handsome stone façade and classic architecture create a striking first impression. Inside, the sense of quality is immediately apparent, with elegant décor, high ceilings, and a cohesive design enhancing the natural charm of the property. The principal reception rooms are both spacious and inviting, featuring large windows that draw in an abundance of natural light while framing attractive garden views. A superb open plan living dining kitchen forms the heart of the home - an expansive, sociable space ideal for everyday living as well as entertaining. Finished to a high standard, it combines stylish cabinetry, quality work surfaces, and integrated appliances with ample room for dining and relaxed seating. Skylights above flood the area with daylight, while doors open seamlessly onto the terrace, creating a natural connection between indoors and out. Additional reception space provides flexibility for quieter evenings or formal gatherings, and the overall layout flows effortlessly, emphasising both comfort and practicality. Across the upper floors, the bedrooms are well-proportioned and beautifully finished, offering calm retreats with pleasant outlooks. The accommodation is complemented by modern bathroom facilities, all presented with the same attention to detail seen throughout the home. Externally, the property truly excels. The gardens have been carefully landscaped to create a series of distinct yet harmonious outdoor living areas, making this home particularly special for those who enjoy spending time outside. A generous paved terrace directly adjoins the house, perfectly suited for al fresco dining and summer entertaining. Beyond, an impressive outdoor kitchen elevates the space further - ideal for hosting gatherings with family and friends. There is ample room for seating, cooking, and relaxation, allowing the garden to function as a true extension of the home. The lawned garden is both private and well-screened, bordered by mature planting that provides year-round greenery and a wonderful sense of seclusion. At the far end, a superb garden studio and covered entertaining area offer exceptional versatility, whether used as a home office, gym, creative space, or simply a place to unwind. A sheltered structure with space for a hot tub enhances the lifestyle appeal, creating a tranquil setting for relaxation in all seasons. Practicality has not been overlooked, with driveway parking, a garage, and useful ancillary spaces adding everyday convenience to the property’s long list of attributes. Combining period elegance with modern refinement, generous internal space with outstanding outdoor living, this is a rare opportunity to acquire a truly distinguished home in one of the area’s most desirable village locations. Perfect for families and those who love to entertain, the property delivers both sophistication and warmth in equal measure. results.summary: A superbly located family home with an outstanding rear garden, beautifully presented interiors, and clear potential to create a long term home, all within walking distance of Wetherby's town centre and well regarded schools. Set along Spofforth Hill, this is a home that reveals itself once inside. Stepping through the entrance porch, the dining hall provides an immediate sense of calm. The proportions are excellent, the light is balanced, and there is a quietness to the space that feels unexpected. It sets the tone for the rest of the house. The accommodation has been carefully maintained and improved, offering a comfortable layout that works well for modern living. To the rear, the formal sitting room is the standout space. Extended to take full advantage of the garden, it is filled with natural light from a lantern roof and framed by wide openings that draw your eye directly outside. It is a room that connects effortlessly with the garden and works equally well for everyday use and entertaining. The kitchen is well appointed with integrated appliances and underfloor heating, complemented by a separate breakfast room. In addition, a snug or fourth bedroom sits alongside a modern shower room, offering flexibility for family life, guests, or working from home. Upstairs, the principal bedroom includes fitted wardrobes, while two further bedrooms enjoy open views over the rear garden. A fully tiled house bathroom completes the accommodation. The defining feature of this home lies to the rear. The garden is exceptional in both scale and privacy. Deep, mature and beautifully established, it offers a setting that feels far removed from its central Wetherby position. From the raised terrace, the outlook stretches across lawn and planting, with very little sense of neighbouring properties. It is a space that works for families, entertaining, and those simply wanting a private and peaceful environment. There is also clear potential to enhance the property further. Subject to the usual considerations, the layout lends itself to reconfiguration, with the opportunity to create a full width living dining kitchen across the rear elevation, following the approach taken by neighbouring homes. Externally, the property is approached via a generous driveway with turning space, framed by mature boundaries that provide a natural sense of screening on arrival. A home that offers far more than first impressions suggest, with a garden that is rarely found so close to Wetherby's centre. Viewing is essential to fully appreciate what is on offer. The centre offers a mix of independent shops, cafés, bars and restaurants, alongside essential amenities, making it easy to use day to day. Schooling is a key draw, with well-regarded primary options and Wetherby High School supporting its appeal for families. results.summary: A superb detached home, finished to an exceptional standard and forming part of an exclusive collection of homes by Kebbell, set in the heart of one of North Leeds' most regarded villages. Aspen Drive is a small and carefully considered development, discreetly positioned within Scarcroft and comprising a limited number of homes. Built in 2012 by a bespoke developer known for delivering high quality, design led housing, the setting feels established, refined and quietly exclusive. The property is freehold and sits within a well maintained environment, with a managed greenbelt area to the rear that further enhances the sense of space and outlook. This particular home sits comfortably within that environment. While not the largest on the development, it benefits from exactly what discerning buyers look for, exceptional surroundings, strong neighbouring homes, and a setting that underpins long term value. It is a house that feels well placed, both within the development and within the wider village. Internally, the property has been meticulously maintained and presents in true turn key condition. The overall finish is excellent, with particular attention paid to the kitchen and bathrooms, both of which are fitted to a high standard and feel current, clean and well considered. The kitchen is centred around quality integrated Bosch appliances, reinforcing the sense of a well specified, carefully maintained home. The main living space is where the house truly comes into its own. Filled with natural light, the room draws you towards the garden, with bifolding doors creating a strong visual connection to the outside. The garden itself is a key part of the lifestyle here, offering a quiet, private setting that the current owners particularly value, alongside a strong sense of community with well regarded neighbours. The kitchen sits at the heart of the home, offering a sociable and practical layout with quality integrated appliances and a finish that reflects the overall standard of the property. Practical considerations have also been well addressed, including a boarded loft with fitted ladder for additional storage, and modern infrastructure such as fibre connectivity being introduced to the area. To the first floor, there are four well proportioned bedrooms, including a principal suite with en suite, alongside a modern house bathroom. The layout is well balanced, making it equally suitable for families or those looking to downsize without compromise. The house is offered to the market chain free, allowing for a straightforward and efficient move. Externally, the rear garden has been thoughtfully landscaped to create a space that is both private and easy to manage. A raised Indian stone terrace provides an ideal setting for outdoor dining, enjoying a south east facing aspect and long periods of sunlight. Beyond, the garden offers a safe and usable space for children, while remaining entirely manageable for those seeking lower maintenance living. The location within Scarcroft is a key part of the appeal. Positioned close to the centre of the village, the property enjoys access to well regarded local amenities, a highly regarded village pub, and some of the area's most desirable residential surroundings, including the notable Ling Lane approach. A quietly impressive home, offering quality, setting and ease in equal measure. Area: Set just off Wetherby Road, this location places you within one of North Leeds' most established and well regarded village settings. Scarcroft sits comfortably between Leeds and Wetherby, offering a sense of space and calm while remaining highly connected, with Leeds city centre around 20 minutes away and Wetherby closer to 15. What defines this part of North Leeds is balance. There is a genuine village feel, yet everything needed for day to day living is within easy reach. Nearby Wetherby provides a full range of amenities, while Street Lane in Roundhay offers a more boutique feel, with independent shops, cafés and restaurants that give the area its energy. Equally, Shadwell sits just moments away and adds another layer to the lifestyle here. A traditional village in its own right, Shadwell is centred around its green, with a well regarded primary school, local pub and a strong sense of community. It is the kind of place where daily life feels familiar and connected, and where families tend to stay once they arrive. For recreation, the area is exceptionally well served. Several highly regarded golf courses are close by, alongside David Lloyd at Moor Allerton, offering tennis, gym and leisure facilities. Open countryside is never far away either, with walks stretching out towards Harewood and the surrounding villages. Schooling is a key draw, with both The Grammar School at Leeds and Gateways School within a comfortable drive, alongside a range of respected state options in the surrounding villages. results.summary: An exceptional detached family home set on a generous plot in a highly regarded residential setting, offering beautifully appointed accommodation, striking interior design and an outstanding outdoor entertaining space. Occupying a substantial plot with a wide frontage, extensive driveway parking and well-maintained lawned gardens, this impressive home combines space, privacy and lifestyle in equal measure. The property enjoys a particularly attractive rear garden, with a large stone-flagged terrace leading seamlessly from the house - ideal for entertaining and family living alike. Internally, the quality of finish is immediately apparent. The welcoming reception hall leads through to a stunning open plan living kitchen and dining space, thoughtfully designed as the heart of the home. The bespoke kitchen features sleek cabinetry in rich navy tones, complementary wood finishes and Dekton work surfaces, centred around a substantial island with statement pendant lighting and bar seating. Integrated appliances and carefully considered storage solutions reflect the high specification throughout. The dining area is bathed in natural light from large windows, enhanced by feature lighting and bold designer décor, creating a space that is both elegant and functional for everyday family life and entertaining. The adjoining sitting areas continue the theme of luxury, with stylish panelling, contemporary fireplaces and high-end fittings, all finished to an exceptional standard. The bedrooms are equally impressive, with beautifully styled interiors and quality fixtures. The principal bedroom offers a boutique-hotel feel, complete with bespoke wall detailing and rich fabrics, while the bathrooms are finished with modern tiling, premium sanitaryware and statement freestanding bath. Externally, the property truly excels. The generous rear plot has been expertly landscaped to create a superb outdoor lifestyle area. A standout feature is the bespoke covered outdoor kitchen and entertaining pavilion. Constructed in timber with a solid roof and integrated lighting, this space includes a built-in barbecue, preparation surfaces and ample seating areas. There is also a separate outdoor fireplace, creating a cosy, year-round entertaining area perfect for hosting gatherings whatever the season. The expansive stone terrace and lawn beyond provide plenty of space for children to play and for summer entertaining on a larger scale. To the front, the property benefits from a substantial driveway providing ample off-street parking, framed by neat lawned gardens and attractive stone elevations which give the home strong kerb appeal. Wetherby itself is a highly sought-after market town, prized for its blend of charming character, strong community feel, and excellent amenities. Positioned along the River Wharfe, the town offers a vibrant high street filled with independent boutiques, cafés, and restaurants, as well as well-regarded schools and superb leisure facilities. Its strategic location provides convenient access to York, Harrogate, and Leeds, making it ideal for commuters while still offering the tranquillity and green spaces of a more rural setting. With scenic riverside walks, historic architecture, and a welcoming atmosphere, Wetherby remains one of the region’s most desirable places to call home. This is a rare opportunity to acquire a high-specification detached home on a generous plot in a prime Wetherby location, offering stylish, ready-to-move-into accommodation and exceptional indoor-outdoor living. results.summary: An exceptionally well presented, Grade II Listed, two double bedroomed, converted first floor apartment with a stunning, open plan living, dining kitchen space with bespoke cabinetry incorporating a full complement of integrated appliances, master bedroom with dressing room and en suite shower room and spacious entrance hall. The property enjoys access to the beautiful, communal grounds and impressive ballroom within the original Clock Tower building. The apartment enjoys a simply beautiful, generously proportioned, open plan living/dining/kitchen with a bespoke designed kitchen with high quality fixtures and fittings including a good sized central island, attractive, log effect, recessed fire and bespoke fitted units to one alcove. The master bedroom has an immaculate en-suite shower room and well designed dressing room. A second double bedroom, spacious entrance hall with good sized walk-in storage cupboard and three-piece bathroom complete the accommodation. Within a short walk of Menston village amenities and train station providing rapid links with Leeds, Bradford and beyond the position is highly desirable and an early viewing is recommended. This highly regarded development portrays the grandeur of a bygone era brought up to date. The communal grounds create a parkland feel and extend to around 200 acres and include tennis courts, a cricket pitch, ponds and bridleways to explore, while the location, on the periphery of Menston village, gives excellent road access into the region’s business centres including bus routes to Otley and bicycle routes along the canal. Menston railway station is within walking distance of the property and there are frequent services throughout the day into the cities of Leeds and Bradford with onward connections from Leeds into London Kings Cross. Whilst being an ideal base for the commuter, High Royds Village is also readily accessible to beautiful, open countryside and excellent primary and secondary schools including the outstanding St Mary’s High School. This beautiful property with DOUBLE GLAZING THROUGHOUT and GAS FIRED CENTRAL HEATING and with approximate room sizes comprises: Ground Floor - Communal Entrance - A solid timber door opens into a well presented, communal entrance area with practical, carpeted flooring and intercom system. Stairs lead to the upper floors. First Floor - Entrance Hall - A solid timber entrance door opens into a spacious, light and airy, welcoming entrance hall with a tall window to the front elevation, allowing ample natural light, with smart plantation shutters and Amtico flooring. Doors lead into the beautiful, open plan living dining kitchen, two, double bedrooms, the house bathroom and a most useful walk- in cupboard providing excellent storage and housing the gas central heating boiler. Open Plan Living Area - 8.9 x 7.2 (29'2" x 23'7") - A stunning, generously proportioned, open plan kitchen/dining/living space, with bespoke fitted units to one alcove, space for a flat screen, wall mounted TV, and a beautiful, recessed, log effect, electric fire creating a fabulous focal point to the room. Recessed ceiling lights. Amtico flooring. This large room enjoys an abundance of natural light courtesy of one window to the front elevation, two to the rear, with plantation shutters, and three Velux windows. The beautifully presented fitted kitchen comprises of a range of fitted cabinetry with Quartz worksurfaces and upstands and a good sized central island housing cupboards, drawers and wine fridge providing seating for four people. Appliances include electric oven and microwave with warming drawer, four ring induction hob with extractor over, dishwasher, fridge/freezer and washer/dryer. A Belfast sink with mixer tap sits beneath a large window to the front. There is ample space for a dining table making this a most sociable room, ideal for entertaining friends and family. High ceilings add to the feeling of grandeur. Master Bedroom - 4.8 x 3.1 (15'8" x 10'2") - A fabulous double bedroom with carpeted flooring, radiator and window to the rear elevation, with plantation shutters. Incorporating an elegant dressing area and with a door leading into: En Suite Shower Room - Beautifully presented with low level W.C., wall mounted handbasin with chrome mixer tap and a large shower cubicle with thermostatic drench shower, heated towel rail, attractive wall and floor tiling. Window to the rear elevation with plantation shutters. Dressing Area - With bespoke, built-in wardrobes and drawers, offering generous hanging space and well designed storage. Bedroom Two - 4.1 x 2.9 (13'5" x 9'6") - A second double bedroom with window to the rear elevation, with plantation shutters, carpeted flooring and radiator. Bathroom - A superb, three-piece house bathroom with low level W.C., wall mounted handbasin with chrome mixer tap and bath with thermostatic, drench shower and heated towel rail. Beautiful, fully tiled walls and floor.

results.summary: This cleverly extended four bedroom detached family home (1400 sqft) enjoys a quiet cul-de-sac position within the favoured Spofforth Hill neighbourhood and within close proximity of an excellent range of local amenities including shops and schools. Constructed of brick under a tiled roof and benefiting from gas fired heating and double glazing this deceptively spacious detached family home has been cleverly extended to now provide a flexible layout of accommodation over two floors with attractive interior design and little or no wasted space within the ground and first floor layout. A reception hall with guest cloakroom leads to a full depth sitting room and the opposite side of the hall a family room / study. results.summary: A desirable ground floor retirement apartment for the over 65’s benefitting from nearby riverside walks and communal amenities, offering the opportunity to embrace a fulfilling and active lifestyle in a welcoming environment and supportive community. A most attractively presented purpose built ground floor retirement apartment set in this delightful complex for the over 65’s boasting nearby lovely riverside walks, benefitting from many communal amenities including pleasant gardens, laundry room, an elegant lounge and guest suite for friends and family to use at a nominal cost. The apartment has an electric thermostatic controlled heating system, and the windows are UPVC sealed double glazed. The entrance to Adlington house is by way of a secure locked outer door with video entry system to the apartments and the office is directly opposite the entrance. The private entrance hall to No. 7 is of a good size with a video entry system and a walk-in utility/store cupboard with plumbing for a washing machine and space for a tumble dryer. The open plan sitting room and kitchen offers lovely living space having an electric coal-effect fire with decorative surround and French doors out to the private patio with access to the communal carpark beyond. The kitchen area has fitted wall and base units, integrated oven/hob, microwave, slimline dishwasher and fridge freezer. The bedroom is a good-sized double with built in wardrobe. The shower/wet room is well designed with tiled walls and large walk-in shower. Agents Note – Refurbishment of the communal areas including the homeowners’ lounge, restaurant, coffee area, hair salon and therapy suites is currently being undertaken as part of the high standard of upkeep, these areas are periodically refreshed so access is temporarily restricted as explained below. Compulsory Anti Money Laundering (AML) checks must be carried out on all potential buyers once an offer has been agreed on a property, as per HMRC requirements. The cost payable by the buyer(s) is £20 (inc VAT) per individual check. These checks are carried out via Thirdfort Group. We are also required to obtain identification and proof of funding from all prospective buyers. Please note that the property will not be marked as Sold STC until these checks have been completed. Otley – The historic and thriving market town centre offers extensive shopping facilities with great pubs, independent restaurants, cafes and bars. There are superb sports and recreational facilities, scenic walks can be enjoyed in the parks, along the picturesque River Wharfe and the views from the top of The Chevin Forest Park are simply breath-taking. Waitrose, Asda and Sainsbury’s supermarkets are based in Otley. The town is strategically located for daily commuting into Yorkshire's key commercial centres including Leeds, Bradford and Harrogate. The national A1/M1/M62 motorway network near to Wetherby makes areas further afield more accessible by road. The town's central bus station has synchronised hopper links to Menston's train station nearby with rail links to Leeds, Bradford and beyond. There is the Leeds/Bradford International Airport at Yeadon. Adlington House Facilities include: •Elegant Table Service Restaurant •Beautifully Appointed Lounge & Outdoor Patios •Activities & Craft Room •Spa Suite •Hairdressing Salon •Internal Mobility Scooter Store with Electric Charging Facilities •Fully Furnished Guest Suite with En Suite, TV and Tea/Coffee Making Facilities •Lifts To All Floors •Private Residents Parking and Landscaped Gardens Tenure – Leasehold 125 years from 1st January 2016. Monthly Service charge £937.44p per month (2026/27) providing services: •Communal cleaning and maintenance •External window cleaning, water and sewage •Buildings insurance and estate management The service charge enables AMS to have someone on duty 24 hours every day in case of emergency, working in tandem with a discreet emergency call system installed in each apartment and includes the provision of a daily restaurant service which allows homeowners to enjoy a delicious a la carte three course meal at a nominal cost of approximately £6.50 per person. In addition, the apartments pay a ground rent charge based on the number.of bedrooms, with this apartment currently paying £1,338.64 per annum (2026/27). The ongoing charges are reviewed on an annual basis. Upon resale, the apartment owners are required to contribute 3% of the profit made to the contingency fund. results.summary: This modern 3-bed detached home in Guiseley offers an incredible eco-friendly lifestyle with solar panels, low running costs, and a south-facing garden. Perfectly positioned for park walks and commuters alike, it's a rare find in a quiet cul-de-sac. Imagine waking up, grabbing the dog's lead, and being in the lush greenery of Parkinson Park in under a minute. Built in 2013, this modern detached home isn't just about stylish living; it's about a smarter lifestyle. With solar panels and a brilliant EPC B rating, you can enjoy a toasty-warm home while the planet (and your wallet) gives you a high-five. Tucked away in a quiet friendly cul-de-sac yet a stone's throw from Guiseley station, it's the perfect blend of peace and convenience. Key Features: * **Eco-Warrior Approved:** Solar panels and a top EPC B rating for low bills. * **Sun-Seeker's Paradise:** South-facing rear garden that's a total sun trap. * **Park Life:** Adjacent to Parkinson Park—perfect for morning strolls with your four-legged friend. * **Commuter Gold:** Close to Guiseley train station for easy city access. * **Storage Galore:** Garage with a pitched roof for all your extra gear. * **Modern Comfort:** Built in 2013 with an ensuite to the main bedroom. Property Tour Kick off your shoes in the welcoming hallway, which features a handy guest WC (perfect for when friends pop round). The living room is a bright, airy sanctuary with patio doors that blur the lines between inside and out. Across the hall, the kitchen-dining room is the social hub of the house, also boasting patio doors that lead directly to the south-facing garden. Head upstairs to find three well-proportioned bedrooms. The main bedroom is a peaceful retreat with its own private ensuite, while the second double and versatile single share the modern family bathroom. Outside, the garden is ready for summer BBQs, and the single garage with side door access that offers that much-needed extra storage space with its clever pitched roof design. Driveway parking allows for two cars. Location The town offers a wide range of shops, supermarkets, restaurants, gyms, and leisure facilities. Guiseley train station provides direct links to Leeds, Bradford, and Ilkley, while Leeds Bradford Airport is just a short drive away. Families are also well served by highly regarded nearby schools for all ages. results.summary: Having probably the finest views of a property in the Otley area, a substantial, beautifully appointed and imaginatively designed converted barn with roughly 2800 sq.ft. (267 sq.m) of space, including three substantial reception areas, a master bedroom with galleried portion and ensuite, three further bedrooms and two bath/shower rooms together with scope for further extension, with parking, gardens and land in all stretching to 0.75 acres, conveniently located for Otley, Guiseley and Menston. The Rafters is one of the most substantial and imaginatively designed converted barns offered for sale in Otley over recent years. It has a wonderful blend of the contemporary and traditional with the majority of the accommodation on the ground floor. There is further scope for reconfiguration and extension subject to the necessary consents. As the photographs show, the living space is appointed and finished to an exceptional standard, and benefits from mains electricity, water and drainage with gas central heating and double glazing. It is approached by a central hallway leading to a substantial family kitchen, which in turn leads to a large games room and a lounge with stunning views over the town’s rooftops the Wharfe valley. There is a ground floor bedroom with ensuite and two further bedrooms. A small flight of stairs leads to the master bedroom having an ensuite and walk-in wardrobe with stairs leading to a delightful galleried mezzanine. There is further scope for extension into a semi converted integral 'barn' area subject to the necessary consents. The property forms part of a courtyard development and has parking facilities to the front whilst to rear are reconfigured gardens with lawns and a sitting out area to enjoying the stunning views, whilst steps lead down to a play area and approximately 0.75 acres of pastureland leading to the road. The Rafters is strategically placed close to Otley Chevin and Otley centre with Menston village and railway station close by, plus the facilities in Guiseley a little further afield. Both primary and secondary schooling in the area are highly regarded and the West and North Yorkshire conurbations of Leeds, Bradford and Harrogate are readily accessible. The property is also conveniently placed for international travel with Leeds/Bradford International Airport sitting at nearby Yeadon. results.summary: 53 The Spindles is a westerly facing one bedroom deluxe apartment with garden view and a pleasant balcony, located on the second floor with lift access. The Spindles forms a collection of 72 recently built retirement apartments for those aged over 65. Designed to help you make the most of everyday, with an onsite support team available 24/7, 365 days a year. Enjoy the privacy of your own peaceful apartment, spend a relaxing afternoon in the onsite restaurant, stroll around the landscaped gardens, relax in the homeowners’ lounge or coffee lounge. There is also an activity studio, hairdressing salon, therapy suite and cinema room. For visitors there is also a beautifully appointed guest suite. Apartment 53 is light and airy. The entrance hall has a monitor for the audio video entry security system and a deep utility storage cupboard with plumbing for an automatic washing machine. The lounge dining room is a generous space with a feature fireplace housing a coal effect fire. Double doors lead onto the balcony which overlooks the lovely communal garden. The kitchen has a range of contemporary wall, base and drawer units with working surfaces over. The integrated appliances (which have barely been used) include oven, hob, extractor, microwave, fridge freezer and dishwasher. The bedroom is also a generous size having fitted wardrobes and a full height window overlooking the garden. The contemporary shower room is fully tiled and has a step in double shower enclosure. The village of Menston enjoys an appealing semi-rural location on the edge of the Wharfe Valley, a short drive from the towns of Ilkley and Otley. It is also well-positioned for the railways station with frequent daily rail services to the cities of Leeds and Bradford. Menston enjoys a broad provision of everyday amenities including local shops, primary school, churches, pubs/restaurants and a variety of sports clubs with the cricket club being particularly close by. results.summary: This beautifully presented and significantly extended detached home occupies a prime position within the ever-popular suburb of Cookridge, offering a rare level of versatility perfectly suited to the evolving needs of a growing family. Its location is a particular highlight, being ideally placed for a wealth of local amenities, well-regarded schooling, and the convenient transport links of Horsforth train station. The property makes an immediate impression from the front elevation, where a flagged driveway provides ample off-road parking alongside a neat lawn frontage framed by established hedge borders. Upon entering, a welcoming hallway with a staircase to the first floor sets a warm and inviting tone. To the front of the home, the principal lounge offers a bright retreat featuring a large double-glazed window and stylish laminate wood flooring. The heart of the residence is undoubtedly the expansive open-plan dining area and kitchen, which benefits from the added luxury of underfloor heating. The kitchen itself is equipped with a range of contemporary base and wall units, contrasting work surfaces, and a suite of integrated appliances including an induction hob with extractor hood over, oven, microwave, and dishwasher. The ground floor continues to impress with a second sitting room to the rear and a functional rear hallway, housing a guest W.C., built-in storage, and direct access to the garden. A standout feature is the expertly converted garage, which can be utilized as a generous fifth bedroom or an additional reception room, complete with its own dedicated shower room and a useful loft space above—currently serving as an ideal home office with a Velux roof window. Moving to the first floor, the property offers four well-proportioned bedrooms, including three spacious doubles, all served by a modern three-piece house bathroom featuring a panelled bath with shower over, pedestal wash hand basin, and low-level W.C. Further storage is available via a drop-down ladder to a part-boarded loft space. Externally, the rear of the property reveals a private, enclosed garden with a lawn and a flagged patio perfect for entertaining, complemented by a useful garden shed equipped with light and power. An internal inspection is considered essential to fully appreciate the remarkable size and quality of accommodation on offer. results.summary: A beautifully presented first-floor retirement apartment in the highly sought-after Orchard Court development, ideally suited for over 60s seeking a low-maintenance, comfortable lifestyle. This apartment offers a bright living space, generously proportioned bedroom, practical kitchen, and accessible shower room, all within a secure, professionally managed development in the heart of Guiseley. With lift access, communal gardens, residents’ parking, and a 24-hour emergency call system, this property combines convenience, comfort, and peace of mind. Offered with no onward chain. LOCATION Orchard Court enjoys a prime location on Orchard Lane, right in the centre of Guiseley, within easy reach of everyday amenities. The town centre features a variety of shops, supermarkets, cafés, and restaurants, while Guiseley railway station is just a short walk away, offering regular services to Leeds and Bradford. Excellent bus routes and major road links make commuting straightforward, with Leeds Bradford Airport only a short drive away. Guiseley is renowned for its strong community spirit, local leisure facilities, and easy access to surrounding towns, making it an ideal spot for retirement living. MANAGEMENT COMPANY Orchard Court is professionally managed by Anchor Housing, who oversee the day-to-day running of the development and maintain the communal areas to a high standard. A service charge of £2,541 per annum covers building insurance, maintenance of communal areas and grounds, lift servicing, the emergency call system, and on-site management. The property is held on a long lease from 1989 to 2178, with 152 years remaining. Please note that pets are not permitted within the building. ACCOMMODATION This first-floor apartment has been thoughtfully designed for ease of living. A communal entrance hall leads to a private front door, opening into a welcoming hallway with useful storage. The living and dining room is bright and spacious, accommodating both seating and dining furniture comfortably, with a pleasant outlook. The fitted kitchen is arranged for maximum practicality, featuring a range of units and work surfaces. The double bedroom is generously sized and includes built-in wardrobes, while the shower room has been carefully designed with a walk-in shower and modern fittings, ensuring accessibility and comfort. The apartment is finished in a neutral style throughout. OUTSIDE The development is purpose-built for residents aged 60 and over, providing a safe, welcoming, and well-managed environment. Accessed via a secure communal entrance with intercom system, residents can reach all floors by lift or stairs. The building is surrounded by well-maintained communal gardens, offering pleasant seating areas for relaxation and socialising. Residents’ parking is available, and a site manager is on hand during the week. Additionally, a 24-hour emergency call system offers reassurance and peace of mind. LEASEHOLD & RELATED CHARGES We understand that the property is leasehold and may there fore carry an annual charge for maintenance/ground rent. We are advised that the following applies. Lease with 170 years remaining as of 2026 - Ground Rent N/A. Maintenance charge of £211.73 PCM. Clarification regarding lease terms, length and any charges should be sought via the vendors solicitors. BROCHURE DETAILS Hardisty and Co prepared these details, including photography, in accordance with our estate agency agreement. SERVICES – Disclosure of Financial Interests Unless instructed otherwise, the company would normally offer all clients, applicants, and prospective purchasers its full range of estate agency services, including the valuation of their present property and sales service. We also intend to offer clients, applicants and prospective purchasers' mortgage and financial services advice through our association with Mortgage Advice Bureau. We will also offer to clients and prospective purchasers the services of our panel solicitors, removers, and contactors. We would normally be entitled to commission or fees for such services and disclosure of all our financial interests can be found on our website. results.summary: This beautifully presented ground floor apartment occupies part of an impressive stone-built period property and comes with its own, enclosed gardens at the front and rear. The property offers stylish, character-rich interiors blending traditional features with modern updates. Highlights include a recently fitted, bespoke kitchen which features a full range of sleek navy units, concrete-style worktops, integrated appliances and a feature island with induction hob and casual seating with dining space, an spacious and elegant lounge with high ceilings and a bay window, two large double bedrooms, and a luxurious four-piece bathroom. Offering substantial living space across one level, it also benefits from a large lower ground floor comprising three full-height rooms with stone-flagged floors and windows to both front and rear—currently used for storage but with approved planning permission to convert (Visit Leeds Planning Portal - 23/07327/FU). Located in the highly desirable village of Calverley, the property enjoys a vibrant community atmosphere, excellent schools, a range of local amenities, and strong transport links—including Apperley Bridge train station just down the road, making it ideal for commuters. This is a rare opportunity to own a spacious, character-rich home in a prime location—perfect for a wide range of buyers. LOCATION Calverley Village offers a thriving village atmosphere. Situated between Leeds and Bradford, with excellent access links into the City Centres making commuting straightforward. The A658 and A657 both provide major links to the motorway networks and for those wishing to travel further afield, Leeds-Bradford Airport is a short drive away. The train station at Apperley Bridge gets you into Leeds in ten minutes. Just along the A657 is a shopping complex where a Sainsbury's supermarket and other major retail outlets can be found. The popular Owlcotes Centre at Pudsey offers Marks & Spencers & Asda Superstores, with New Pudsey train station adjacent. The Village has two primary schools, Calverley Church Primary School, and Calverley Parkside School, a park, Village pubs and a handful of local amenities are on hand, in addition there are also two golf courses nearby. Only a short car ride away are the neighbouring 'villages' of Horsforth, Guiseley, Rawdon and Farsley where a further selection of shops, pubs, restaurants and eateries can be found. GROUND FLOOR The property is accessed directly into a bespoke kitchen, featuring a full range of sleek navy fitted units, a concrete-style worktop, and a central island with an induction hob and casual seating. Integrated appliances include a dishwasher, washer/dryer, oven, and a Belfast sink. There's space for a large American-style fridge freezer. There is also plenty of room for a formal dining table and chairs. From here a hallway gives access to the living room which is elegant and generously proportioned, with a high ceiling that enhances the sense of space. Period details include deep ceiling coving, skirting boards, a picture rail, and decorative wall panelling. A standout feature is the superb fireplace with a cast iron surround and open grate fire. Stripped and stained floorboards add warmth, while a large walk-in sash bay window floods the room with natural light and offers a pleasant outlook to the rear. The main bedroom is spacious and beautifully styled with a traditional feel. It features 'Lincrusta' wall coverings, a period-style fitted cupboard with arched detailing, and access to the cellar via a discreet staircase. The second bedroom is also a large double, full of character, with a sash window, picture rail, deep coving, and skirting boards. Carpet to the flooring and a feature timber fire surround with a cast iron insert and slate hearth. The bathroom is a standout feature—generously sized and luxuriously finished. It includes a contemporary free-standing bath on chrome claw feet with a wall-mounted mixer tap, a pedestal sink, W.C., and an oversized shower cubicle. The space is half-tiled in white ceramics, with tiled flooring and a bold feature wall that includes a large inset mirror. LOWER GROUND FLOOR The lower ground floor currently offers a generous space divided into three rooms, all with good head height, stone-flagged floors, and windows at both the front and rear. Currently used for excellent storage. Planning permission has been granted to convert into further living accommodation. Visit Leeds Planning Portal to see the plans - 23/07327/FU). OUTSIDE The outside space is a rarity with the apartment boasting gardens to the front and rear. The rear is landscaped to provide an impressive garden with block paved patio area for alfresco dining or entertaining, along with a low maintenance mulched area where children can play and astro-turf area. Enclosed by fencing with pebbled borders. The front has been recently updated to include fenced boundaries, providing a private aspect and gravelled area. Parking can be found on street. BROCHURE DETAILS Hardisty and Co prepared these details, including photography, in accordance with our estate agency agreement. SERVICES – Disclosure of Financial Interests Unless instructed otherwise, the company would normally offer all clients, applicants, and prospective purchasers its full range of estate agency services, including the valuation of their present property and sales service. We also intend to offer clients, applicants and prospective purchasers' mortgage and financial services advice through our association with Mortgage Advice Bureau. We will also offer to clients and prospective purchasers the services of our panel solicitors, removers, and contactors. We would normally be entitled to commission or fees for such services and disclosure of all our financial interests can be found on our website. MORTGAGE SERVICES We are whole of market and would love to help with your purchase or remortgage. Call to book your appointment today option 4. PEPPERCORN LEASE As with a vast majority of properties in the Calverley and surrounding areas a 'peppercorn' lease exists whereby in many cases a long lease of 999 years was granted when the property was built. Usually a small annual fee is payable in the form of a Peppercorn Ground Rent which has no increase date agreed. Usually no service charge is payable and no increase date is set. As we are not leasehold specialists, clarification regarding lease terms, length and any associated charges should be sought via legal advice. We would however advise that this is very common place and normal in this area and not something that we have seen affects value or future sale ability. results.summary: A well planned and impeccably presented, three bedroom end terrace property with excellent gardens, parking and detached garage at the head of this quiet yet central location in the ever popular village of Pool in Wharfedale. This stone built three bedroom end terrace property has been much improved and reconfigured over recent years to its present excellent standard. To the ground floor is a through living room with a focal woodburning stove, and a fitted kitchen with a number of integrated appliances, whilst to the upper storey are three bedrooms of varying sizes two of which have decorative fireplaces and the house bathroom. All main services are installed including gas fired central heating as well as sealed unit double glazing. Externally there is a low maintenance garden to the front and to the rear of the property is an attractive and well stocked garden, offering plenty of privacy, and a paved patio sitting out area. In addition, to the side of the house there is a single detached garage having light and power plus driveway parking at the front for two vehicles. Located in this popular area of Pool in Wharfedale, the property enjoys the village's amenities including a pub, chemist, post office/general store plus active sports and social club and the highly regarded Pool Primary School. Leeds/Bradford International Airport is a short drive away and there is regular bus service to Otley, Harrogate, Leeds and Bradford. The market town of Otley provides a number of shops, supermarkets, schools and other facilities. Weeton and Menston railway stations are also within easy reach. results.summary: A spacious and well-presented three-bedroom home featuring a large open-plan living layout, generous bedrooms including a dressing area to the principal, and a substantial rear garden, all set within a popular and well-connected area of Leeds ideal for families and commuters. This well-presented three-bedroom home offers an impressive balance of space, practicality and modern comfort, making it an excellent choice for families, first-time buyers or investors alike. Set across two floors, the property has been thoughtfully arranged to maximise both living and entertaining space, with a standout open-plan layout forming the heart of the home. Upon entering, a welcoming hallway leads through to a generous open-plan kitchen, living and dining area, measuring an impressive size and creating a sociable environment ideal for both everyday living and hosting. The living space benefits from excellent natural light through large rear-facing windows, while the neutral decor and soft finishes create a warm and inviting atmosphere. The kitchen is fitted with a range of modern units and ample worktop space, complemented by integrated and freestanding appliance areas, with a seamless transition into the dining area overlooking the garden. A convenient ground floor WC adds further practicality. Upstairs, the property continues to impress with three well-proportioned bedrooms. The principal bedroom is particularly spacious and benefits from a dedicated dressing area, offering a level of storage rarely found in properties of this type. The second bedroom is another generous double, while the third room provides flexibility as a single bedroom, nursery or home office. A contemporary family bathroom completes the first floor, fitted with a three-piece suite including a bath with overhead shower. Externally, the property boasts a substantial rear garden, offering excellent potential for landscaping or further enhancement. The space is ideal for families, outdoor entertaining or those seeking a private garden retreat. The property is situated in a well-established residential area of Leeds, known for its strong community feel and excellent local amenities. Nearby, Bramley Shopping Centre provides a wide range of shops, supermarkets and everyday conveniences, while additional retail and leisure facilities can be found at the nearby Kirkstall Bridge Shopping Park. The area is well-served by reputable local schools, making it a practical choice for families, and there are several green spaces and parks within easy reach, including Bramley Park and the scenic canal-side walks along the Leeds and Liverpool Canal. For commuters, the location is particularly well-positioned, with easy access into Leeds city centre via regular bus routes and nearby rail connections from Bramley station. Road links are also strong, with convenient access to the ring road and motorway network, making travel across the region straightforward. Overall, this is a spacious and versatile home in a popular and well-connected location, offering excellent value and strong long-term appeal. Asbestos has been identified within the property. It has been confirmed that removal works are scheduled and will be completed prior to sale (anticipated end of March). Buyers are advised to rely on their own inspections and satisfy themselves as to the completion and certification of any works. Works have been carried out to create an open-plan kitchen, including removal of a supporting wall. The town is home to Yeadon Tarn, a scenic spot perfect for leisurely walks, green spaces, and a children's play park. results.summary: On entering the property you are greeted by a spacious hallway, from here, you step into a great sized living room which features a charming fireplace as a focal point and a bay window that allows natural light to pour in, creating a bright and relaxing space for everyday living. Continuing through the hallway, you`ll find a fully fitted kitchen with a good range of wall and base units, providing plenty of storage and worktop space. The kitchen is well equipped with integrated appliances including a double oven, hob, extractor fan, dishwasher and washing machine, as well as space for a fridge. A side access door adds extra convenience, ideal for day to day use. The hallway also benefits from two useful storage cupboards, perfect for keeping coats, shoes and household items neatly tucked away. The ground floor accommodation includes a generous master bedroom, complete with French doors opening out to the rear garden and a walk-in wet room en-suite, offering both comfort and practicality. The second bedroom is another versatile space, suitable as a bedroom, dining room or home office, and also features French doors leading into the conservatory. The conservatory itself is a fantastic addition, offering a bright and airy space to enjoy all year round, with a further set of French doors opening directly onto the rear garden. Completing the ground floor is the main bathroom, fitted with a WC and basin, and enhanced by a feature jet shower for a modern finish. To the first floor is a further good-sized bedroom, flooded with light from Velux windows and offering a bright, airy atmosphere. This room also enjoys excellent eaves storage, making it ideal as a guest room, teenager`s space, or additional home office. Externally, the property continues to impress. To the front is a beautifully maintained garden along with a driveway providing off-street parking and leading to the garage. A pathway to the side offers access through to the rear. The rear garden has been thoughtfully landscaped, featuring a large raised patio area that wraps around the garage, perfect for outdoor seating and entertaining. Beyond this is a lawned section and an astroturf area positioned outside the main bedroom, offering a low maintenance space to relax and enjoy. Overall, this home combines generous living space, flexible layout options and attractive outdoor areas, making it a fantastic opportunity for anyone looking for a well rounded property ready to move into. Situated in the ever popular Morley Bird Estate, this property enjoys a fantastic position in one of the area`s most well regarded residential locations. The estate is known for its quiet, family friendly feel while still being close to everything Morley has to offer, including local shops, schools, parks and everyday amenities. With Morley town centre and the train station only a short distance away, plus excellent road links for commuting, this is a superb location that combines convenience with a great neighbourhood atmosphere. **Some images have been virtually staged and contain digitally added furniture, lighting, and accessories. The rooms are well-proportioned, providing a solid footprint for redesign and improvement. Period features such as fireplaces and exposed wooden flooring are present and offer scope for restoration or incorporation into a refreshed interior. results.summary: A striking contemporary home finished to an impeccable standard with all modern amenities. Description The Manor is a truly spectacular and substantial residence offering approximately 6,294 sq ft of beautifully styled contemporary accommodation, finished to an exceptional standard. Built by the current owner in 2019, the property features high-quality materials, bespoke fixtures and fittings, and cutting-edge technology. The striking stone elevations are complemented by modern architectural glazing. A dramatic glass atrium entrance welcomes you into the magnificent reception hall, which boasts a double-height ceiling and a bespoke Bisca floating staircase leading to the galleried landing above. The open-plan ground floor benefits from wet zoned underfloor heating, feature LED lighting, ceiling speakers, and extensive full-height glazing that floods the space with natural light. To one side, there is a sitting room with a polished plaster wall-mounted fireplace and bespoke wall display units. On the opposite side, an enclosed, soundproofed cinema room provides a perfect retreat. Both rooms are supported by a useful cloaks cupboard/cloakroom. The principal living and entertaining area is complemented by a bespoke kitchen with a range of contemporary wall and base units, a large central island with breakfast bar, and quartz work surfaces. Integrated appliances include two full-height wine fridges, a coffee machine, double oven, fridge, and gas hob. Sliding patio doors provide seamless access to the outside and the westerly rear terrace. The ground floor further benefits from an impressive leisure complex, comprising a gym with mosaic-tiled sauna, shower room, and access to the front aspect. Additionally, there is a 55 ft pool room offering fabulous garden views. Stairs from the kitchen lead down to the lower ground floor, which includes a comfortable snug, a fitted kitchen, utility room, two double bedrooms each with en suite shower rooms, and a second cloakroom. There is direct access to the garden. This self-contained annexe space is ideal for multi-generational living, dependants, or staff accommodation. On the first floor, a galleried landing with glass balustrades leads to the luxurious principal suite overlooking the rear garden. The suite features a full-height picture window, a fitted walk-in wardrobe, and a fully tiled en suite shower room. Both the bedroom and en suite open onto an expansive rear balcony. Additionally, there are two vaulted bedrooms—one with a walk-in wardrobe, mezzanine bed deck, and balcony access—both with en suite shower rooms. Outside Set behind high brick walls and sliding electric gates, the property is approached via a tiled forecourt offering private, secure parking and access to a detached double garage. The generous, partly walled landscaped garden is mainly laid to level lawn, with well-stocked and maintained perimeter beds. Several seating areas provide perfect spots to enjoy the surroundings, with the focal point being an outdoor kitchen with pizza oven and a spacious porcelain-tiled terrace, creating an ideal entertaining space. Location Oulton is a well-connected and desirable village on the outskirts of Leeds, offering a blend of local charm, green spaces, and excellent amenities. It’s home to the renowned Oulton Hall Hotel, Spa & Golf Resort, along with local shops, pubs like the Three Horseshoes Inn. The area benefits from strong transport links: frequent bus services (routes 140, 141, 9A, and 446), nearby Woodlesford railway station (offering regular services to Leeds and Wakefield), and easy access to major roads including the A639, A642, and the M1/M62 network. Residents also enjoy proximity to St Aidan’s Nature Reserve and walking/cycling routes connecting to Rothwell and surrounding villages. results.summary: Combining architectural elegance with luxurious modern living, this beautifully considered home extends to approximately 2,930 sq. ft. and offers a seamless balance of style, comfort, and practicality. Set behind electric gates on a generous plot in one of Collingham’s most desirable positions, Deerstone House is an exceptional six-bedroom detached residence crafted by the renowned JWT Developments. Combining architectural elegance with luxurious modern living, this beautifully considered home extends to approximately 2,930 sq. Ft. and offers a seamless balance of style, comfort, and practicality, whilst enjoying underfloor heating throughout the ground floor. From the moment you enter, the attention to detail is evident. The spacious reception hall, illuminated by natural light, sets the tone for the rest of the property. To the right, a sleek under-stairs bar creates an atmospheric entertaining feature, complete with integrated wine storage and glass shelving - an impressive statement on arrival. At the heart of the home lies the spectacular open plan living dining kitchen, fitted with high-end cabinetry in a striking dark palette, paired with quartz worktops and ambient LED lighting. A large central island forms the perfect gathering point for family life and social occasions. Full-height windows and sliding doors invite views of the garden and allow light to flow throughout the space. Adjoining the kitchen is a versatile family area, ideal for everyday relaxation. Two additional reception rooms offer superb flexibility: a sophisticated formal sitting room with dramatic feature wall and a contemporary inset fire, and a separate family room currently used as a home gym. The ground floor also hosts a guest cloakroom and a practical utility room. Upstairs, the first floor presents four beautifully proportioned bedrooms, three of which enjoy luxurious en-suite facilities. The principal suite impresses with its elegant décor, lighting, and windows that fill the room with morning sun. A generous dressing area and stylish en-suite complete this serene retreat. The family bathroom on this floor is appointed to the same high standard, featuring a contemporary vanity and premium tiling. The top floor offers two further double bedrooms - perfect for teenagers, guests, or a home office suite - served by an additional private en-suite. Externally, the property continues to impress. The landscaped rear garden provides a wonderful sense of privacy, with a large terrace for outdoor dining, a lawn edged with established planting and inviting seating areas for relaxation. The front of the house features extensive parking and a detached garage. The charming village of Collingham is one of West Yorkshire’s most desirable places to live, combining a strong sense of community with excellent connectivity. The village offers a range of local amenities, including a convenience store, GP surgery, pharmacy, and several well-regarded pubs and restaurants. Families benefit from access to Collingham Lady Elizabeth Hastings Primary School and proximity to Wetherby High School and other top-rated secondary options. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the extensive footpaths, countryside walks, and the Calsa sports grounds right on the doorstep, providing tennis courts, football pitches, and social facilities. Excellent transport links via the nearby A1(M) and Leeds Road make commuting to Leeds, York, or Harrogate quick and convenient. Perfectly positioned in this thriving village, Deerstone House represents a unique opportunity to acquire a truly exceptional, turnkey family home that balances luxury living with a relaxed rural lifestyle. Beautifully designed and meticulously finished, Deerstone House represents modern luxury at its finest—an exceptional home built with the quality, craftsmanship, and architectural flair for which JWT Developments are known.
