results.summary: Situated in the ever popular area of Cookridge with fabulous far reaching rear views, this extended semi-detached residence offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience, having been freshly decorated and newly carpeted throughout. Boasting three bedrooms plus a versatile occasional loft room, this well-maintained family home features a private rear garden, perfect for outdoor gatherings, as well as off-street parking & a garage for added convenience. Situated in a quiet neighbourhood, this home is an ideal choice for the professional couple or growing family and there is the added advantage of no chain involved. The property has an extended porch, leading into the hallway with stair case to the first floor. The lounge is to the front with a Living Flame gas fire. To the rear is the extended dining kitchen with garden room, a range of modern base & wall storage units, ceramic tiling, built in oven & hob, plumbing for a washing machine, under stair storage with the boiler, laminate flooring and full height windows to the rear making the most of the incredible outlook. To the first floor are three bedrooms. The bathroom has a three piece suite with a bath & shower facilities, glass shower screen, vanity unit and ceramic tiling. To the second floor, accessed via a stair case from the landing, is a versatile occasional loft room with a front facing Velux window and a PVCu double glazed dormer to the rear with fantastic views. Outside is a garden to the front and a driveway. To the rear is a private garden over two levels with gated lawn, paved patio, great views and a single garage. Cookridge is an ever-popular residential area and is ideally located for the local amenities, although the further amenities of Horsforth are within vehicular access as well as Holt Park Asda Complex. results.summary: Preston Baker are pleased to offer to the market this beautifully presented, recently refurbished 1930s semi, much-loved by the same owner for 24 years. The property has undergone extensive renovation in recent years, offering stylish, well-presented accommodation throughout, and peace of mind for years to come. "No. 28 was our first home we bought just before we got married and where we welcomed both our daughters. This house was more than a family home, it kept us safe and holds wonderful memories" - the current owner. Step inside into the welcoming entrance, with an open staircase to your left leading to the first floor. To your right is the spacious and versatile through lounge/diner, with extra space and light from the addition of a conservatory to the rear, ideal for a play area, work from home space, or simply for quiet relaxation. Newly laid oak floors run through the living space and into the entrance. Also off the hall is the delightful kitchen, with social breakfast bar dining around the large peninsula. The recently fitted kitchen receives light through a large bay window and features quartz worktops, sleek, handle-less cabinetry, integrated Lamona appliances, drinks cooler and warmth from underfloor heating. There is access to a useful under stair storage cupboard, and a side door leading outside. Upstairs are three bedrooms, two doubles and a further good-sized single. A recently fitted house bathroom offers a relaxing retreat and features a luxurious walk-in shower, w/c, wash hand basin and the added bonus of underfloor heating. The home has been lovingly finished to the same high standard throughout. Other improvements in recent years include: Full rewire and new fuseboard New combi boiler New radiators New windows and new front door New roof New stain-resistant carpets to stairs and first floor New skirting boards and architraves New oak internal doors For added reassurance, the home includes a modern alarm system and CCTV. Outside, the home sits on a spacious, secure plot with a gated driveway, currently providing parking for up to four vehicles and a detached garage for additional storage or as a workshop. While there is currently no formal garden, the size of the plot offers exciting potential for the next owners to landscape or reconfigure the outdoor space. There is plenty of scope to create one large garden or front and back gardens, with room leftover for off-street parking. Maturing laurels will grow to provide privacy with a hedge around the plot. In the meantime, the railings could be changed to wooden fence panels for instant privacy. The large plot also offers potential for extending the home single/double storey (STPP). Laurels were planted around the perimeter of the property and are gradually maturing to offer further privacy. Moorland Grove is a friendly, family neighbourhood, ideally situated within walking distance of coffee shops, bakeries, bars and restaurants. Retail options include Moor Allerton shopping centre with a Sainsburys supermarket, and the nearby town streets at Street Lane, Moortown Parade and Chapel Allerton boast wonderful, independent local businesses. A big draw to this area are the highly regarded primary and secondary schools nearby, plus great transport links. Parks and green spaces close by include King Alfreds field and Moortown Park, and a short drive takes you to Roundhay Park and Golden Acre Park. There are good commuter links to Leeds City Centre, Harrogate, Wetherby, and York, with excellent public transport links nearby. Leisure facilities nearby include a David Lloyds and a variety of golf courses. Please contact us to book your in-person viewing appointment, or head to our website to use our online viewing booking tool! results.summary: A FOUR BEDROOM DETACHED HOUSE AVAILABLE TO VIEW WITH BEAUTIFUL VIEWS! Hunters Wetherby are proud to present this beautifully presented three/four bedroom detached house in the highly sought after village of Collingham, set within a charming cul-de-sac location. On entering the property, the entrance hall houses the downstairs w/c featuring a low level w/c and wash hand basin, and leads into the spacious living room and the stairs leading to the first floor accommodation. The living room features a gas fire set within a timeless stone mantle and hearth, and a beautiful bay window which allows for natural light to flood the space. An archway opens up the space further into the dining area. The dining area features large patio doors opening out onto the rear patio overlooking the garden. The kitchen in this property is perfect for family living with space for a further dining table or family living space. It is fitted with contemporary wall and base units and island, with sleek curves and leathered granite worktops, and benefits from integral Bosch appliances including fridge freezer, dishwasher, induction hob with extractor and double oven. Patio doors from the dining/living space, a separate rear door from the kitchen, and a sky light allow for even more natural light to fill the room. Access to the garage can also be found leading off from the kitchen. To the first floor, the main bedroom benefits from fitted mirrored wardrobes and a dressing table. The second bedroom is a good sized double and benefits from views over the rear garden and landscape beyond. Bedroom three is a good sized single with views over the rear garden and landscape beyond. The additional room upstairs offers versatility to the modern family; currently used as a fourth single bedroom, this space has the scope to become an en suite or home office. The spacious house bathroom features a four piece white suite including, bath, shower, low level w/c and hand wash basin with vanity unit. Externally, the front of the property is partially laid to lawn with mature shrubs and plant. A generous block paved drive allows for off street parking for several cars, and a side gate provides access to the rear garden. The rear of the property is laid to lawn, with a spacious patio area sitting adjacent to the width of the property providing plenty of space for lounging and entertaining in the summer months, overlooking the beautiful view beyond. Mature trees, shrubs and plants boarder the lawn to the rear. The charming and popular village of Collingham boasts many local amenities catering for most daily needs including shops, doctors, restaurant and public houses. The market town of Wetherby which houses further amenities is a short drive away and easily accessible by car or public transport. Collingham is a commuters haven, with easy access to the A1 linking with the region's major motorway network. results.summary: A beautifully renovated detached family house located in an especially popular residential area so conveniently placed for easy access to excellent village amenities, an outstanding primary school and with a private enclosed rear garden An excellent opportunity to acquire a recently tastefully extended detached family house located in an especially popular residential area so conveniently placed for easy access to excellent village amenities, an outstanding primary school and has a private enclosed rear garden with shaped lawn, patio, flowerbeds and boundary shrubs. A central covered entrance opens to the hallway with a recessed cloaks cupboard, doors connecting to the principal rooms and a staircase leading to the first floor. The cosy front facing lounge has a splayed bay window and a wood burning stove. The open plan living family kitchen is instantly impressive, having a good range of fitted wall and base units with integrated appliances, a centre island with a breakfast bar provision, Quartz working surfaces, well lit by a sky light and bi-folding windows opening to the rear patio and private garden. There is a downstairs guests’ cloakroom/Wc and the separate useful utility room has fitted cupboards with Quartz working surfaces and door access to what was the garage now reduced to providing excellent secure storage. There are four double bedrooms on the first floor with an en-suite to the rear main bedroom and the house bathroom which is of a good size has a white four-piece suite with a separate shower cubicle as well as a bath and a sun pipe within the ceiling provides natural lighting. The beautifully presented accommodation is offered with a gas-fired heating system, the windows are UPVC sealed double glazed and features exposed wood internal doors. Bramhope is so highly regarded as one of North Leeds most sought-after villages in the heart of Yorkshire’s beautiful countryside. It enjoys an active community spirit with an Ofsted rated “Outstanding” primary school, which currently feeds to Prince Henry’s Grammar School in Otley. There is a children's nursery, a medical centre including a dental practice and The Fox and Hounds pub has a coffee lounge and patio. Local shops include the village bakery, butchers’, grocers, Post Office/Store and a recently opened COOP store amongst other general amenities. Sporting facilities include tennis and bowling clubs, a cricket ground and West Park rugby club on the edge of the village. 130 acres of gardens and woodland at Golden Acre Park approx. a mile or so down Leeds Road is popular to walkers and family entertainment. The village is strategically located for commuting into Yorkshire's key business centres including Leeds, Bradford and there is the M1/A1/M62 national motorway network near to Wetherby making areas further afield more accessible by road. More extensive daily requirements are available in Otley's nearby market town approximately 3 miles away with Waitrose, Sainsburys and Asda supermarkets and there are the popular spa towns of Ilkley and Harrogate within comfortable travelling distance. A train station with main line links is available at nearby Horsforth and there is the Leeds/Bradford International Airport at Yeadon. Leeds 7.5 miles, Bradford 11 miles, Harrogate 11 miles, Motorway 11 miles – All distances approximate. results.summary: Offered for sale with NO ONWARD CHAIN, this three-bedroom detached house is ideally situated just a short distance from Morley town centre. The property would benefit from some updating but offers huge potential and would suit a wide variety of buyers. A viewing is essential to fully appreciate everything this property has to offer. A fabulous opportunity to update a property to your own style and taste. This three-bedroom detached house enjoys a cul-de-sac position in a highly popular residential area within easy reach of Morley town centre. Offered for sale with NO ONWARD CHAIN it is likely to be very popular and an early viewing is highly recommended. The ground floor accommodation comprises; - front entrance hall with a cloaks cupboard and stairs rising to the first floor, spacious living room with a bay window overlooking the front garden, dining room with access to the conservatory and a kitchen with access to the rear garden. The kitchen has fitted wall and base units, ample worktop space, integrated gas hob and a large under-stairs storage cupboard. On the first floor there are three bedrooms, two of which are doubles and the third is a good-sized single. The shower room is fully tiled and has a three-piece suite comprising shower cubicle, WC and wash basin. results.summary: Situated just a short walkable distance to the centre of the market town of Wetherby, this beautifully presented modern two-bedroom mid-terrace home offers stylish, turnkey living ideally suited to first-time buyers, downsizers or investors alike. The property has recently undergone a programme of meticulous refurbishment, resulting in a finish that will be rivalled by few. The property opens into a welcoming entrance hall leading through to a bright and spacious living room, flooded with natural light from rear patio doors overlooking the private garden. The well-planned layout comfortably accommodates both lounge and dining areas, creating an inviting space equally suited to relaxing evenings and entertaining guests. To the front, the fitted kitchen provides a smart range of units and generous worktop space with room for appliances, combining practicality with modern styling. To the first floor are two well-proportioned bedrooms, both offering excellent space for wardrobes and additional furniture. The shower room has been thoughtfully upgraded and now presents as a sleek, contemporary space featuring a stylish suite, modern fittings and a crisp, high-quality finish, designed to provide a comfortable and luxurious start to the day. Externally, the home enjoys a private enclosed rear garden, mainly laid to lawn and complemented by a large timber decked seating area - ideal for outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply enjoying warmer months in a low-maintenance setting. To the front there is allocated parking, providing convenient off-street parking. Wetherby itself is a highly sought-after market town, prized for its blend of charming character, strong community feel and excellent amenities. Positioned along the River Wharfe, the town offers a vibrant high street filled with independent boutiques, cafés and restaurants, as well as well-regarded schools and superb leisure facilities. Its strategic location provides convenient access to York, Harrogate and Leeds, making it ideal for commuters while still offering the tranquillity and green spaces of a more rural setting. With scenic riverside walks, historic architecture and a welcoming atmosphere, Wetherby remains one of the region’s most desirable places to call home. Early viewing is highly recommended. results.summary: A charming Edwardian terrace enjoying generous sized living accommodation and retaining characterful original features arranged over three floors. Occupying a pleasant position in the heart of Collingham village with convenient access to shops primary school and excellent village amenities while enjoying elevated and far reaching views to the rear. Approached through an attractive brick archway, the property opens via a decorative Edwardian front door with stained glass panels into a welcoming entrance hallway, complemented by high ceilings, deep skirting boards, dado rail and ornate cornice. The living room is generously proportioned, featuring a large double glazed window to the front and an elegant fireplace with polished stone hearth, decorative tiled surround and living flame gas fire. The formal dining room continues the period charm with high ceilings, ornate cornice and a further feature fireplace, along with a large picture window overlooking the rear courtyard. Steps lead down to the re fitted kitchen, fitted with shaker style units, coordinating work surfaces and matching upstands, Beko range style double oven with grill, five ring gas hob with extractor, under counter dishwasher and space for an American style fridge freezer. A step leads through to the utility/boot room and boiler house with plumbing for a washing machine, Worcester gas fired boiler and rear personnel door. To the first floor, the landing leads to a spacious principal bedroom with high ceilings, large window to the front and decorative cast iron fireplace. Bedroom two is a bright double room with views to the rear, feature fireplace and walk in wardrobe cupboard. Bedroom three is a single room to the front, ideal as a child’s bedroom or home office. The recently fitted family bathroom offers a modern white suite with vanity basin, step in shower, panelled bath, tiled walls and flooring, and heated towel rail. Stairs rise to the second floor where the landing provides an excellent home office space with far reaching views towards the River Wharfe. results.description: A charming Edwardian terrace enjoying generous sized living accommodation and retaining characterful original features arranged over three floors. Occupying a pleasant position in the heart of Collingham village with convenient access to shops primary school and excellent village amenities while enjoying elevated and far reaching views to the rear. Approached through an attractive brick archway, the property opens via a decorative Edwardian front door with stained glass panels into a welcoming entrance hallway, complemented by high ceilings, deep skirting boards, dado rail and ornate cornice. The living room is generously proportioned, featuring a large double glazed window to the front and an elegant fireplace with polished stone hearth, decorative tiled surround and living flame gas fire. The formal dining room continues the period charm with high ceilings, ornate cornice and a further feature fireplace, along with a large picture window overlooking the rear courtyard. Steps lead down to the re fitted kitchen, fitted with shaker style units, coordinating work surfaces and matching upstands, Beko range style double oven with grill, five ring gas hob with extractor, under counter dishwasher and space for an American style fridge freezer. A step leads through to the utility/boot room and boiler house with plumbing for a washing machine, Worcester gas fired boiler and rear personnel door. To the first floor, the landing leads to a spacious principal bedroom with high ceilings, large window to the front and decorative cast iron fireplace. Bedroom two is a bright double room with views to the rear, feature fireplace and walk in wardrobe cupboard. Bedroom three is a single room to the front, ideal as a child’s bedroom or home office. The recently fitted family bathroom offers a modern white suite with vanity basin, step in shower, panelled bath, tiled walls and flooring, and heated towel rail. Stairs rise to the second floor where the landing provides an excellent home office space with far reaching views towards the River Wharfe. Bedroom four is a comfortable double with front dormer window. The full height loft space has been insulated and fitted with a Velux window, offering excellent storage and potential for further development. To the outside, a private rear lane shared with neighbouring properties provides access to gravelled parking for multiple vehicles, a lawned garden with storage shed and a rear courtyard enclosed by brick walls. The front garden is set to lawn behind a mature hedge, creating an attractive approach. The property has the benefit of PVCu double-glazing, two double bedrooms (both with storage), a modern kitchen and bathroom and a low maintenance landscaped garden. Viewing is essential to appreciate the size and standard of the accommodation. The accommodation briefly comprises to the ground floor; entrance hall, through living/dining room and kitchen with utility room off. To the first floor are two bedrooms and the house bathroom. Outside there is a block paved parking apron to the front with and a fully enclosed landscaped garden to the rear with a storage shed. The location is conveniently placed for local schools, local amenities and shops plus public transport routes. Ideal for commuters requiring access to Leeds, Wetherby and York, with main arterial roads providing access to surrounding districts and motorway networks, including the A64 York Road and the new orbital A6120 just a short drive away which also gives quick access to 'The Springs' at Thorpe Park which offers an Odeon cinema, a Marks & Spencer food hall & Next clothing. Nearby at Crossgates there is a railway station for a quick and smooth commute to LEEDS city centre plus Crossgates shopping centre with an excellent choice of shops, banks, cafes and bars. *** Call now to arrange your viewing *** Entrance Hall - Enter through a PVCu access door into the entrance hall with door to the utility room and staircase rising to the first floor. Utility Area - 2.25m x 1.50m (7'5" x 4'11") - A very useful utility room providing space for a dryer and fridge/freezer, there is also a large built-in cupboard providing useful storage. Lounge/Dining Room - 6.65m x 3.30m (21'10" x 10'10") - A spacious, light and airy reception room flooded with natural light through the dual aspect windows. Easily zoned into living and dining areas with modern and light decor there is underfloor heating, wall mounted electric radiators, laminate flooring and two double-glazed windows to the front and rear. Kitchen - 2.95m x 2.44m (9'8" x 8'0") - The kitchen is fitted with a quality range of base and eye level units in a modern white finish with complimentary work surfaces over which incorporate a stainless steel sink with side drainer and mixer tap and laminate splashback. A cooker point with chimney style extractor hood and space for a washing machine. A double-glazed rear window and PVCu entry door gives access to the rear garden. Landing - 3.59m x 1.64m (11'9" x 5'5") - Doors to both double bedrooms, bathroom and a built-in storage cupboard handy for bedding and towels. Bedroom 1 - 2.84m x 4.91m (9'4" x 16'1") - A very spacious double bedroom with a double-glazed window to the front, a wall mounted electric heater and a built-in storage cupbaord. Bedroom 2 - 3.72m x 3.25m (12'2" x 10'8") - A second double bedroom with semi-fitted wardrobes to two walls providing ample hanging rails and storage. A double-glazed window and wall mounted electric heater. Bathroom - 1.91m x 2.54m (6'3" x 8'4") - The modern bathroom is fitted with a white three piece suite which comprises; a low level WC, a vanity hand wash basin with storage below and a P-shaped bath with shower and glass shower screen. Tiled splashback and flooring plus two double-glazed windows to rear. Exterior - To the front is a block-paved parking apron providing off road parking. The gorgeous rear garden is low maintenance and offers a large patio seating area, a raised artificial lawn, compostite boundary fencing and a storage shed. Directions - From the Crossgates office, proceed along Austhorpe Road and at the traffic lights turn right. Take the third exit onto Ring Road Crossgates. At the next roundabout, turn right onto Barwick Road. Proceed, turning left onto Stanks Drive. Proceed along, around the bend, continue onwards where the property can be found on the left hand side. The three reception rooms and three bedroomed property was originally built around 1730, modernised and extended in 2008. The current kitchen was fitted in 2017. Electricity and Gas service the property, heating via a gas powered combination boiler. EPC is “C”, improving from the previous “D” with the use of internet heating controls. Internet connection is via fibre with connection speeds up to 1Gb available. Outside, the property has off road gated parking for two average sized cars and a single garage for a third. A secluded private garden includes flower beds, a centre grassed area, a stone built storage shed and a timber garden room. Entrance to Ashdown Cottage is from the driveway into the entrance hall off which is a utility area with space for a fridge freezer, washer and dryer. The ground floor layout is currently a lounge, dinning room, tv/music room and kitchen. Access to the first floor is by staircase in the dinning room to the three bedrooms and house bathroom. The main bedroom has a large ensuite containing two basins, walk-in shower and bath. The main bedroom has a convenient walk-in wardrobe. The village of Bramham has excellent road connections given its location next to the A1M. Bus services to Wetherby, Leeds and Harrogate pass through the village. Garforth is the nearest train station. Bramham enjoys the normal range of community activities with three community facilities, a doctors surgery, a primary school and CofE Church. results.summary: This spacious, five bedroom family home offers generous accommodation and excellent potential for modernisation and remodelling. The property provides five bedrooms, multiple reception rooms, a double garage, and a wide rear garden, making it well suited to family living and buyers looking to update and personalise to their own taste. Located in a quiet cul-de-sac within the highly sought after village of Collingham. The property is entered via a welcoming entrance hall that leads to a large through lounge, providing a flexible living space suitable for everyday use and entertaining. A separate dining and living area further increases the available reception space and benefits from sliding doors opening onto the rear garden. The kitchen/breakfast room is well proportioned and offers clear scope for modernisation and reconfiguration. A downstairs WC and separate shower room provide added convenience, while a utility area located behind the garage offers additional storage and practical workspace. The first floor comprises five bedrooms. Two are large double bedrooms with fitted wardrobes, while two further double bedrooms offer good-sized accommodation, one of which has double doors opening onto a balcony. The fifth bedroom is currently used as an office however could serve as a study, nursery. A family bathroom completes the first floor accommodation. Outside, the property benefits from a double garage, a rear extension, and a wide lawned garden. Offered to the market with the great benefit of no onward chain. The Vale is a quiet residential cul-de-sac in the sought after village of Collingham, about three miles from Wetherby and within easy reach of Leeds, Harrogate, and York. The area is known for its detached family homes and peaceful setting. Collingham offers a range of local amenities, including shops, cafés, a primary school, and sports facilities, with good access to the A1(M). The surrounding countryside and River Wharfe provide attractive walking and outdoor opportunities. results.summary: CHAIN FREE | Tucked away in a peaceful cul-de-sac in the heart of Bramley, this beautifully presented three-bedroom end-terraced stone home seamlessly blends period charm with thoughtful modern upgrades. Recently improved throughout, the property offers stylish interiors, a landscaped front garden, and a private rear drive for off-street parking. With a stunning loft master suite, character features such as a bay window and log burner, and excellent access to amenities and transport links into Leeds, this home delivers both comfort and convenience in an enviable residential setting. LOCATION A fast changing suburb with a great community spirit. Conveniently placed for the Ring Road (A6120), with good bus services to Leeds/Bradford and a local train station getting you into Leeds in ten minutes. Bramley Shopping Centre forms the hub and offers a good selection of shops/amenities, Bank, Post office, Costa Coffee etc. Green spaces include Bramley park & Bramley Fall park, (from where it is only a short walk to the Leeds-Liverpool canal), where you can explore lovely scenic pathways. The privately run Bramley baths has been in-situ since 1904, swimming and fitness classes can be enjoyed here. Local supermarkets include Aldi & Tesco, whilst Morrisons & Lidl are super close in nearby Stanningley, where there is also a Home Bargains store. A short car journey away you will find the popular Owlcotes Centre at Pudsey offering a Marks & Spencer, a Walmart/Asda superstore & B & M, with New Pudsey train station adjacent. Rodley is close, with a further selection of amenities and of course the Millennium Trail, a popular local beauty spot. A short distance away in Kirkstall you will find a leisure centre, Kirkstall Bridge retail park which boasts a gym and an array of shops, with a further shopping centre across the road with a Morrisons supermarket, Boots, Matalan etc. GROUND FLOOR The property welcomes you into a tastefully decorated hallway that then opens into a welcoming lounge, where a charming bay window allows natural light to pour in, enhancing the sense of space. Wood effect laminate flooring and a feature log burner create a warm yet contemporary living environment, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. To the rear, the spacious shaker-style kitchen has been designed with both practicality and style in mind, featuring solid wood worktops, a gas hob with electric oven, and dedicated space for a washing machine and dishwasher, making it ideal for day-to-day family life as well as hosting friends and dinners FIRST FLOOR The first floor hosts two well-proportioned bedrooms and the main house bathroom. The first bedroom on this floor is a generous double, it is comfortably carpeted and offers ample space for furnishings. Whilst the second bedroom provides a versatile single room suited to a child’s bedroom, guest room, or home office. The spacious bathroom is fitted with laminate flooring and includes a separate corner shower as well as a freestanding roll-top clawfoot bathtub, along with a WC and wash basin, delivering both functionality and a touch of luxury. SECOND FLOOR Occupying the converted loft space, the impressive master bedroom benefits from a dormer extension that floods the room with natural light while adding valuable headroom as well as double aspect views of the city skyline. This tranquil retreat features a walk-in wardrobe and a private en suite shower room, creating a stylish and secluded principal suite ideal for modern living. results.summary: STEP INTO QUALITY. FastMove are proud to introduce this spacious detached family home, with modern fixtures and fittings throughout. Boasting a wealth of living accommodation, three double bedrooms wonderful private rear garden and off road parking for a number of vehicles. The property is situated in this prime position at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, with no through traffic, perfect for any family. The property has been designed aimed to offer a lifestyle as well as a beautiful home. The interior of this elegant property harmoniously fuses sophisticated design with modern practicality, evoking a classic charm throughout the house. We are open from 8am - 9pm Monday - Sunday so why not book your viewing now? On entering the property you are greeted a hallway, the perfect place for coats and shoes. From the hallway internal doors lead to the lounge and downstairs w/c. Lounge A spacious, bright and airy principal reception room with space for plenty of pieces of comfy furniture, the perfect place to sit back and relax. An excellent level of natural light floods into the room through a large window to the front aspect. To the centre of the room is a cast iron log burner, giving the room a focal point, cosy feel and helps add to the level of ambience the property offers. The room also benefits from a wall mounted radiator. From the lounge an open entrance leads to the dining room. Dining Room A spacious second reception room, which offers plenty of space for a large dining table and chairs, perfect to entertain family and friends. The wonderful level of light the property offers continues in the dining room through a set of patio doors which lead to the rear garden. There is also a wall mounted radiator. From the dining room access is gained to the kitchen. Kitchen The Kitchen area has an array of stylish, wall and base units providing plenty of storage with complementary work-surfaces. Benefiting from a fitted range with (double oven, grill and hob), overhead extractor and a single sink and drainer. There is also plumbing for a washing machine and space for a large fridge/freezer. A window overlooks the rear garden. Downstairs W/C Comprising of a low flush w/c and wash hand basin, built onto a useful vanity unit. The room benefits from a wall mounted radiator, frosted window and is decorated with tiles to the walls and cushioned flooring. First Floor Landing The property boasts a rare and spacious landing with two windows, wall mounted radiator and useful storage cupboard. From the landing internal doors lead to all three bedrooms and the family bathroom. Main Bedroom A wonderful main bedroom with fitted wardrobes. However, there is still space for a king size bed and an array of free standing furntiure. Benefiting from a window and a wall mounted radiator. Bedroom Two and Three Both bedrooms offer space for a double bedroom and free standing furntiure. Benefiting from a window and a wall mounted radiator. Family Bathroom Another well presented room is the family bathroom. Comprising of a three piece suite including a panelled bath, with wall mounted shower head and glass screen, low flush w/c and wash hand basin, built onto a vanity unit. There is also a frosted window, heated towel rail and the room is decorated with tiles to the walls and cushioned floor. EXTERIOR To the front is a generous size garden, which is laid with lawn and surrounded by mature shrubbery and borders. To the side a substantial driveway runs the full length of the property providing off road parking for a number of large vehicles. At the end of the driveway access is gained to the garage, which is accessed via an up and over door. T The rear garden is an absolute GEM! Incredibly private which is not overlooked. The garden is mainly laid to lawn, ideal for the family to enjoy during the Summer months. However, there are also a large patio, ideal for outdoor furniture and the BBQ weather. The property has been designed aimed to offer a lifestyle as well as a beautiful home. The interior of this elegant property harmoniously fuses sophisticated design with modern practicality, evoking a classic charm throughout the house. An excellent level of natural light floods into the room through a large window to the front aspect. The room also benefits from a wall mounted radiator. From the lounge an open entrance leads to the dining room. The wonderful level of light the property offers continues in the dining room through a set of patio doors which lead to the rear garden. There is also a wall mounted radiator. Benefiting from a fitted range with (double oven, grill and hob), overhead extractor and a single sink and drainer. There is also plumbing for a washing machine and space for a large fridge/freezer. The room benefits from a wall mounted radiator, frosted window and is decorated with tiles to the walls and cushioned flooring. First Floor Landing The property boasts a rare and spacious landing with two windows, wall mounted radiator and useful storage cupboard. From the landing internal doors lead to all three bedrooms and the family bathroom. Main Bedroom A wonderful main bedroom with fitted wardrobes. However, there is still space for a king size bed and an array of free standing furntiure. Benefiting from a window and a wall mounted radiator. Bedroom Two and Three Both bedrooms offer space for a double bedroom and free standing furntiure. Benefiting from a window and a wall mounted radiator. Family Bathroom Another well presented room is the family bathroom. Comprising of a three piece suite including a panelled bath, with wall mounted shower head and glass screen, low flush w/c and wash hand basin, built onto a vanity unit. There is also a frosted window, heated towel rail and the room is decorated with tiles to the walls and cushioned floor. To the side a substantial driveway runs the full length of the property providing off road parking for a number of large vehicles. At the end of the driveway access is gained to the garage, which is accessed via an up and over door. T The rear garden is an absolute GEM! Incredibly private which is not overlooked. The garden is mainly laid to lawn, ideal for the family to enjoy during the Summer months. However, there are also a large patio, ideal for outdoor furniture and the BBQ weather. results.summary: No onward chain. Join us for our Open Day on Sunday 29th March from 11am. Viewings are strictly by appointment, so please email or call Donnelly & Co to book. Overview Homes like this rarely come to market. Set within the heart of Old Cookridge, this attractive 1930s Crowther-built detached bungalow occupies a generous south-east facing plot, offering excellent privacy and significant scope for extension, subject to the necessary planning permission and building regulations. This beautifully presented home provides a superb opportunity to downsize without compromise—combining character, space and future potential within a peaceful, well-established setting. Offering off-street parking, a single garage and a wonderful garden, this is a home that balances immediate comfort with long-term flexibility. Bungalows of this calibre are seldom available, and this property has been thoughtfully arranged to maximise space, light and ease of living. Accommodation A wide, square entrance hall creates an immediate sense of space on arrival, ideal for welcoming guests. The home also retains its original internal doors, adding a touch of character and charm throughout. From here, a loft hatch with pull-down ladder leads to a converted loft space with two Velux windows and carpet, complete with power and lighting, providing excellent storage space and previously used as an occasional home office. The living kitchen is a standout feature—immaculately presented and opening into the dining area, with a beautiful bay window providing space for a table comfortably seating six. A useful side lobby provides additional utility space with plumbing and space for white goods, together with direct access onto the garden. The dual-aspect living room is a warm and inviting space, ideal for both relaxing evenings and spending time with family and friends, with a door to the rear garden. There are two well-proportioned double bedrooms, complemented by a contemporary wet room. Outside Externally, the property offers plentiful off-street parking to the front, along with a single garage complete with power, lighting and workbench. The rear garden is a particular highlight—enjoying a south-east facing aspect and extending to approximately 0.127 acres. Beautifully maintained, it features a sun terrace, greenhouse and shed, offering a wonderful outdoor space to enjoy throughout the seasons. Location The location is equally impressive, with excellent access to Leeds, Harrogate and Leeds Bradford Airport. Cookridge Hall Golf Club is close by, along with scenic walks through Golden Acre Park and Paul’s Pond. This is a rare opportunity to secure a well-positioned bungalow in one of North Leeds’ most desirable areas. results.summary: OPEN AFTERNOON Join us for our Open Day on Saturday 28th March from 1pm. Viewings are strictly by appointment, so please call ahead to secure your time slot. Key Features Attractive 1940s-built detached bungalow with rear extension Thoughtfully extended and ready to move straight into Two comfortable double bedrooms Occasional loft room for guests or hobbies Stylish, recently refitted Wren kitchen with breakfast bar Light and spacious living room with dining area Principal bedroom suite with dressing area and garden access Modern house bathroom Private, manageable gardens to front and rear Driveway parking Sought-after Cookridge setting Horsforth train station accessible at the foot of Tinshill Lane Tucked away from Tinshill Lane and enjoying a lovely sense of privacy, this beautifully presented detached bungalow offers a rare opportunity for those looking to downsize without compromise. Designed with ease of living in mind, the property provides well-balanced, versatile accommodation, predominantly across one level, with the added benefit of a useful loft room for visiting family, hobbies or a quiet workspace. At the heart of the home is the recently refitted Wren kitchen, a stylish yet practical space that naturally lends itself to both everyday living and relaxed entertaining. With its breakfast bar seating, integrated appliances and excellent storage, it’s a space where you can enjoy a morning coffee or host friends with ease. Just off the kitchen, the dining room comfortably accommodates six and is designed as a bright, sociable space that flows seamlessly from the kitchen. Open through to the living room, it creates a superb sense of space—ideal for modern living, entertaining and relaxed everyday life. The living room provides a welcoming and comfortable setting, perfectly suited to both quiet evenings and spending time with family and friends. To the rear, the principal bedroom provides a calm and inviting retreat, opening into a dedicated dressing area with fitted wardrobes, complemented by an ensuite shower room and direct access onto the garden—perfect for enjoying a slower pace of life. A second double bedroom to the front offers flexibility for guests or additional living space. The house bathroom is a particularly good size and well appointed, with tiling to the wet areas and natural light from a ceiling skylight. It features an L-shaped bath with a central waterfall-style tap and two recessed display shelves, creating a practical yet stylish finish. There is a concealed cistern WC and a wash hand basin set within a fitted unit with two storage drawers beneath, along with an illuminated mirror, completing this modern bathroom. Upstairs, the occasional loft room is a valuable addition, offering a private and adaptable space—ideal for visiting family, hobbies or simply somewhere to retreat. Outside, the property continues to impress. The gardens are private and well maintained, designed to be enjoyed without being demanding, with a patio area ideal for sitting out in the warmer months. The driveway provides convenient off-street parking. The location is equally appealing, offering a wonderful balance of convenience and lifestyle. Cookridge is well regarded for its green surroundings and community feel, with access to Cookridge Hall Golf Club and the nearby Bannatyne’s Health Club & Spa. There are also some lovely walks nearby, with routes leading through Paul’s Pond and on towards Golden Acre Park—perfect for enjoying the outdoors. For those needing to travel further afield, Horsforth train station is conveniently located at the bottom of Tinshill Lane, providing regular links into Leeds and beyond. The area is also well served by local amenities and a selection of well-regarded schools, including Cookridge Primary School, Cookridge Holy Trinity School and Ralph Thoresby School. Altogether, this is a home that offers comfort, practicality and a relaxed lifestyle in a highly desirable setting. Cornerstone Sales & Lettings are delighted to present this nearly new two-bedroom apartment, located on Buckthorn Avenue, Meanwood, within the recently completed and highly regarded Vision Development. The contemporary kitchen is well-appointed with sleek units, quality work surfaces, and integrated appliances such as a washer-dryer, a dishwasher, oven, hob and a tall fridge and freezer. The kitchen space flows seamlessly into the living space, which has large double-glazed French doors that open to a Juliet balcony, allowing plenty of natural light in and creating an airy, open feel. The second double bedroom is a good size with a double glazed window allowing plenty of natural light in. Meanwood Park and the surrounding green spaces provide a welcome balance of nature and leisure right on your doorstep. For families and professionals alike, the area is well served by a range of highly regarded schools, leisure facilities, and everyday conveniences. Leeds City Centre is easily accessible by car or public transport, making this an ideal location for commuters, while still enjoying the benefits of suburban living. results.summary: A stunning two-bedroom first floor apartment set within a characterful period building, beautifully renovated to an exceptional standard and offered to the market with no onward chain. Enjoying a delightful rural setting while remaining highly convenient, the property is located within a five-minute drive of Oakwood and approximately six miles from Leeds Railway Station. The apartment is immaculately presented and truly ready to move into, combining contemporary finishes with retained period charm. Notable features include bespoke wall panelling, open fire and cast-iron traditional-style radiators. Internally, a private inner reception hall leads through to a generous lounge featuring a striking open fireplace, large window and elegant built-in glass display shelving. The kitchen is sleek and modern in design, fitted with white gloss units complemented by wooden work surfaces, an electric hob and oven, plumbing for a dishwasher and space for both fridge and freezer. Adjacent to the kitchen is a stunning exposed brick fireplace, now cleverly repurposed to house a stylish wine rack, adding both character and practicality. A separate utility area provides plentiful built-in storage along with plumbing for a washing machine and space for a dryer, thoughtfully keeping laundry facilities out of the kitchen while offering excellent additional storage. There are two well-proportioned double bedrooms, both exquisitely presented with stylish décor. The bathroom is light and bright, fitted with a white suite comprising a bath with shower over, wash basin and WC, and benefitting from windows to two sides allowing for excellent natural light and ventilation. Externally, the property is set within beautifully maintained landscaped communal grounds, offering parking and generous lawned areas, providing a peaceful and attractive outdoor setting. results.summary: A particularly spacious penthouse retirement apartment offering beautifully appointed accommodation with a private balcony and enjoying long distance views over the valley. The apartment incorporates a large hallway, a generous sitting room, fitted kitchen, three bedrooms a bathroom and shower room. The Spindles offers a remarkable range of facilities to its residents including an Activities Studio, Coffee Lounge, Hairdressing Salon, Residents Lounge, Restaurant, Therapy Suite, Cinema and a Mobility Scooter Store. Ground Floor - General Reception - The general reception area is accessed via a key fob for added security and leads to the extensive ground floor shared facilities available to residents of The Spindles together with the administrative offices for the building. There is a staircase and lift access to the upper floors. Second Floor - Communal Landing - A bright and smartly presented area giving access to individual apartments. Private Reception Hall - 6.02m x 2.13m (19'9" x 7'0") - A spacious hallway with a deep store cupboard and recessed spotlights. Sitting Room - 4.78m x 4.11m plus 3.12m x 2.95m (15'8" x 13'6" pl - With an attractive contemporary fireplace housing an electric fire. Glazed double doors lead onto a private balcony. Kitchen - 3.35m x 3.05m (11'0" x 10'0") - With an inset sink unit and an extensive range of fitted base and wall units with cupboards, drawers and granite work surfaces. Integrated appliances include an electric cooker and hob with a filter hood over, microwave oven, fitted fridge, freezer and dishwasher. Recessed spotlights and a tiled floor. Utility Room - 2.44m x 1.83m (8'0" x 6'0") - With plumbing for an automatic washer and space for a dryer. Dining Room/Bedroom Three - 4.98m x 2.82m (16'4" x 9'3") - Principal Bedroom - 5.72m x 4.72m (18'9" x 15'6") - With a range of fitted and recessed wardrobes and a Juliet balcony. En Suite Shower Room - 2.54m x 1.83m (8'4" x 6'0") - With a large walk-in shower, low suite wc and a pedestal wash basin. Chrome heated towel rail and recessed spotlights. Mirror fronted medicine cabinet. Ceramic tiled walls. Bedroom Two - 5.03m x 3.40m (16'6" x 11'2") - With recessed wardrobes. Bathroom - Fitted with a suite comprising a panelled bath and shower over, pedestal wash basin and a low suite wc. Chrome heated towel rail and a mirror fronted medicine cabinet. Outside - Car Parking - There is a large car park for the use of residents of The Spindles. Gardens - The Spindles stands within communal grounds which are maintained as an amenity for the residents. Residents Facilities - The Spindles offers a remarkable range of facilities to its residents including an Activities Studio, Coffee Lounge, Hairdressing Salon, Residents Lounge, Restaurant, Therapy Suite, Cinema and a Mobility Scooter Store. Maintenance Charge - An annual service charge in respect of building maintenance is not collected. A Communal Facilities Fee is charged on the resale of the apartment. The fee is 4% per annum, capped at 5 years (maximum 20%) of the achieved market price per year or part year of occupation. Wellbeing Charge - There is a weekly Well-Being charge which covers the running of The Spindles on a day to day basis for the benefit of the residents. This is currently set at £189.86 per week. Tenure - We are advised that the property is held on the balance of a 250 year lease from 1 January 2023 at a peppercorn ground rent. Menston - Menston village has a thriving community and is conveniently positioned on the edge of Leeds. The village is on the Wharfe Valley Line and therefore enjoys excellent rail links to Leeds and Bradford. It has retained a good selection of amenities over the years from cafes to public houses. More recently the village store has re-opened and offers an excellent range of produce. The village has its own primary school and is within the catchment area for Ilkley Grammar and Prince Henry’s secondary school. It benefits from a substantial park area with tennis courts, churches of several denominations and a community centre. Menston is well situated for access to the Moors meaning wonderful hiking/running/cycling territory is on the doorstep. In summary, Menston gives residents the opportunity to live in an area surrounded by natural beauty while also taking advantage of the wider amenities offered by the neighbouring towns and the City of Leeds. results.summary: THIS FIVE BEDROOM FAMILY HOME WITH AN ANNEX IS SITUATED IN A POPULAR LOCATION WITHIN THE HIGHLY SOUGHT AFTER VILLAGE OF BRAMHAM - DON'T MISS THE CHANCE TO VIEW!! Hunters Wetherby are proud to present this incredible detached five bedroom, York Stone family home in an exclusive street location in Bramham. This property boasts versatile accommodation, perfect for families, those looking for extra space to entertain or seeking multi-generational living. As you enter the property, the spacious entrance hall immediately sets the tone for the home and houses two well sized storage cupboards. The downstairs wc is conveniently located to the rear of the hallway and is comprised of a low level wc and wash hand basin. To the right of the hallway is the lounge, set in cool blue tones with dual aspect windows, this space is adaptable to airy daytime lounging and cosy nights in front of the TV. A gas fire set on a marble hearth is the perfect focal point and adds to the cosy atmosphere. The heart of this home is the kitchen diner, which was designed with culinary ease in mind. The kitchen features a range of wood wall and base units with solid Oak work surfaces and benefits from a range of integral appliances such as oven, microwave, fridge freezer, induction hob and dishwasher. Oak flooring flows seamlessly from the kitchen space, past the breakfast bar and into the dining area which is flooded with natural light by the large bay window overlooking the front gardens. Set aside the kitchen is the utility, featuring the same wall and base units as the kitchen and space for a washing machine. To the first floor, the principal bedroom is nothing short of impressive with ample space on offer, a fitted dressing area and en suite. Dual aspect windows allow scenic views over the picturesque countryside that surrounds the property, and for natural light to fill the space. The en-suite is comprised of low level wc, wash hand basin and double walk in rainfall shower with an additional handheld shower attachment. Part tiled walls and a heated towel rail complete this room. The second bedroom is another well sized double room, with ample space for bedroom furniture and additional space which is used as an office by the current owners. The layout here provides versatility for home working, or a teenagers sanctuary to relax and unwind. Bedrooms three and four are both spacious with windows overlooking the countryside beyond. The house bathroom is partially tiled and is comprised of a three piece white suite including a vintage style wash hand basin, low level wc and tiled bath with shower over. This bathroom also benefits from a heated towel rail. The property also benefits from an annex which is accessed via stairs from the utility. The annex features two large rooms which are currently used as a family room and home work space by the current owners, however the work space could also become a generous fifth bedroom. A wc which is comprised of a low level wc and wash hand basin completes the annex. The versatility this additional accommodation offers is second to none for the modern family or for those seeking office space separate to the main household. Externally, the grounds of this property have been beautifully landscaped creating the perfect space for families and those with green fingers. To the front, an extensive block paved driveway provides ample off street parking and leads to the double garage, which benefits from electric roll over door. Mature shrubs, flowers and a tree border along the driveway and high hedge boundaries allow for additional privacy. To the rear is a paved patio area, ideal for entertaining in those warmer summer evenings, with a raised ornamental pond with water feature being a scenic focal point within the extensive lawned areas. Mature plans, shrubs, bushes and trees fill the grounds with colour and light making it the perfect outdoor sanctuary. Bramham is a highly popular village with its local village amenities and being close to Boston Spa which has a delightful selection of shops, schools, public houses and restaurants. The market town of Wetherby is approximately five miles away and the well-established commuting links provide access to Leeds, York and Harrogate. A viewing is highly recommended! Outside, the home enjoys a mature WRAPAROUND garden plot, extensive DRIVEWAY parking, and an alarmed GARAGE, with scope to EXTEND to the side or rear (STPP) to create an impressive open-plan family space. An elegant and CHARACTERFUL property that perfectly balances traditional charm with modern living. Thoughtfully updated throughout, this stylish residence offers bright, neutral décor, impressive proportions, and the flexibility to further EXTEND if desired. With three generous bedrooms, a reconfigured LUXURY bathroom, a FULLY ALARMED home and garage, and a WRAPAROUND private garden, it is an exceptional home with far-reaching VIEWS suited to growing families and professional buyers alike. Step inside through the LIGHT and airy PORCH, featuring frosted glass panels and arch detail, which opens into a spacious ENTRANCE HALL with original balustrade and engineered OAK parquet flooring, a welcoming introduction to the home’s quality and character. The LIVING ROOM enjoys natural light from a large bay window and showcases a striking exposed brick fireplace housing a LOG-BURNING STOVE set upon a slate hearth, complemented by two arched alcoves and oak-style flooring. The adjacent DINING ROOM exudes elegance with decorative plaster ceiling detailing, another feature fireplace, and a pleasant outlook across the garden, an ideal space for family gatherings or entertaining guests. The KITCHEN sits to the rear, bright and functional with fitted wall and base units, ample workspace, and a sink and drainer. A rear-facing window allows light to flow through, while the wood flooring ties the space seamlessly into the rest of the home. There is also huge potential to EXTEND to the side or rear, subject to planning permission, offering the exciting future opportunity to create a much larger OPEN PLAN kitchen and living space to suit a growing family’s needs. Upstairs, a spacious landing with large side window leads to THREE well-proportioned bedrooms. The main bedroom features a beautiful bay window with far-reaching VIEWS, finished with neutral plastered walls and oak-style flooring. The second double bedroom overlooks the rear garden and is fully replastered, carpeted, and READY to move into, while the third bedroom offers flexibility as a HOME OFFICE or guest room, again with elevated views and quality finishes. The LUXURY BATHROOM has been cleverly reconfigured to create a standout space, fully tiled and featuring a four-piece suite with a walk-in shower, large bathtub, WC, and wash basin. Chrome period-style fittings, dual frosted windows, and a traditional three-column radiator with heated towel rail complete this HIGH END finish. OUTSIDE, the property is SET BACK and screened from the road, creating a private and peaceful first impression. It enjoys an enclosed, mature WRAPAROUND garden with a high degree of PRIVACY, offering a low-maintenance haven with patio space for outdoor dining, and well-established planting that creates a tranquil setting. To the front, a LANDSCAPED garden with gravelled and planted areas provides an attractive approach, with hedged and walled borders and gated access to both sides of the home. A LARGE DRIVEWAY provides off-street PARKING for multiple vehicles, leading to an integrated, fully alarmed GARAGE with power, lighting, and a recently updated consumer unit from 2021, offering excellent utility, storage, or workshop potential. This is a RARE opportunity to acquire a STRIKING DETACHED home on one of Pudsey’s most well-regarded locations, combining space, CHARACTER, and modern comfort in equal measure. Early viewing is highly recommended. At the next roundabout take the first exit onto York Road. After 0.2 of a mile turn right at the traffic lights onto Oak Tree Lane, follow the road, turn right at the roundabout and follow the road where Maple Court can be found on the right. results.summary: Tucked away in this highly sought after cul-de-sac is this beautiful detached family home. Boasting four generous bedrooms, a double garage and fantastic rear garden, call now to book your viewing! The accommodation boasts, spacious entrance hallway with ample space for coat and shoe storage and a downstairs W.C perfect for guest use. The kitchen faces the rear of the property, with plenty of room for everyday dining, making this an excellent space for family life. Fitted with neutral wall and base units, the kitchen has integrated appliances such as double oven, fridge, freezer, washing machine, hob and dishwasher. The lounge stretches the length of the property, benefitting from dual aspect windows and a beautiful feature hearth. A door leads to the conservatory which offers tranquil views of the garden, a lovely space to enjoy in the summer months with French doors opening out. The ground floor also enjoys a seperate dining room with further dual aspect windows to allow in ample sunlight. This is an excellent space for hosting family and entertaining, while also offering a variety of uses such as a home office, guest room, playroom or snug. To the first floor, there are four excellent sized bedrooms. The master benefits from neutral fitted furniture, and each room is tastefully decorated with additional built-in storage. The house bathroom has been upgraded to feature a modern three-piece suite including corner shower, sink and W.C with a useful storage cupboard Externally, the property occupys a fantastic size plot. The garden is beautifully landscaped with a well-maintained lawn, two patio areas for outdoor dining and an array of established plants and shrubbery to create a lovely green space. Off-street parking is available for multiple cars via the driveway, which stretches from the front of the property all the way through to the rear, up to the detached double garage. Benefitting from an electric garage door, there is ample space for the housing of cars or household storage. Situated in one of North Leeds most exclusive residential areas, the property has the immediate quality shopping facilities of Slaid Hill including a general store and public house, however the extensive amenities of Moortown corner including Marks & Spencers food hall, the Sainsburys complex at the Ring Road are within easy vehicular access. The Grammar School at Leeds is situated at the end of Wigton Lane, only an 8 minute drive from Shadwell Park Close and there are numerous golf courses within the area. results.summary: A TWO BEDROOM SECOND FLOOR FLAT in a purpose-built development located a short walk from both Meanwood and Headingley’s vibrant centres. LEASEHOLD for a term of 999 years from 1982. Service Charge: £125pcm. Ground Rent: Nil. Council Tax Band B. A TWO BEDROOM SECOND FLOOR FLAT in a purpose-built development located a short walk from both Meanwood and Headingley’s vibrant centres. This is a great opportunity to purchase in a well-regarded purpose built development located in the Far Headingley Conservation Area. Brought to the market with the benefit of NO ONWARD CHAIN and a LONG LEASE, the property has been rented to professional tenants for many years In brief, the property comprises: a private entrance hall with airing cupboard, a generous reception room with lounge, dining and kitchen areas, a northeast facing balcony, two bedrooms and a bathroom with over bath shower. Masham Court is set within very well maintained grounds and gardens, and there is some off road parking along with unrestricted on street parking on Moor Road. We’ve no doubt the flat will appeal to both first time buyers and landlord investors, keen to personalise to their own tastes, and AN EARLY VIEWING IS HIGHLY RECOMMENDED. AREA Headingley is a vibrant suburb of north Leeds, located approximately 3 miles out of the city centre. The property is tucked away off Shaw Lane and is equidistant of Headingley and Meanwood centres; with a diverse mix of shops, bars, and restaurants. Transport links are a 10-minute walk away. The open spaces of Meanwood Park, Meanwood Valley Trail, Beckett Park and Woodhouse Ridge are also close-by. SECOND FLOOR PRIVATE ENTRANCE HALL Having a built-in airing cupboard with hot water storage tank, and access to all rooms. RECEPTION ROOM A spacious open plan reception room having lounge, dining and kitchen areas and benefiting from large picture windows and a northeast facing aspect. A lovely home in a sought-after location, offering a great balance of space, comfort and convenience. Early viewing is highly recommended! results.summary: Nestled on the desirable Tinshill Road in Leeds, this charming semi-detached bungalow offers a perfect blend of comfort and modern living. With three generously sized bedrooms, this property is ideal for a growing family or anyone in need of extra space. The interiors are bright and airy, creating a welcoming atmosphere that invites relaxation and enjoyment. The spacious garden serves as a tranquil retreat, perfect for outdoor entertaining or simply unwinding in a natural setting. Additionally, the property features off-street parking and a garage, providing practicality and convenience for residents. results.summary: A stunning and immaculately presented cosy cottage, in the heart of Harewood. Benefitting from newly fitted double glazed timber windows, roof, renovated outhouse, allocated off street parking and a sunny secluded south facing garden. An impressive and beautifully presented Grade II listed stone-built home. Boasting an excellent position with a newly restored outhouse, off street parking, south facing garden, and open countryside on your doorstep. During the current ownership, great efforts were made to preserve and upgrade the property, both externally and internally with no expense spared, inclusive of newly fitted double glazed windows, roof and renovated outbuilding - perfect for storage - the attention to detail is superb and quality has been at the heart of everything they’ve done. Dating back to the late 1800’s and originally forming part of the village’s working cottages. The property now boasts a wonderful mix of contemporary charm and character throughout, including high ceilings, original features and window shutters, whilst being perfectly placed within one of the region’s most sought-after villages. Within striking distance of a renowned primary and private secondary school, village hall, local pub, excellent road transport links to Leeds, Harrogate, the A1 (M) and Leeds Bradford Airport (8.6miles). Property Description. This charming home combines period character with modern comfort and in brief comprises; a spacious sitting room, with stone fire surround, original wooden flooring and a large window that floods the room with natural light. The modern shaker-style kitchen offers, ceramic hob and ample space for a large dining table. Adjacent is a utility/pantry with generous storage and plumbing for a washer/dryer. Upstairs, the master bedroom enjoys views to the front, with two sliding sash windows. There is also a second double bedroom and modern house bathroom. Outside and to the front of the property is a beautiful garden with mature hedges, providing a sense of privacy and kerb appeal, well landscaped lawn area and patio seating - creating a welcoming entrance to the cottage. To the rear of the property is a privately enclosed south facing garden, a perfect place to enjoy the sun with friends and family. Private parking and a recently renovated and fully watertight outhouse, great for storage or an exciting opportunity for any new buyer to develop further, making it a perfect home office/ studio, *subject to planning permission. Location. The property sits within highly sought-after village of Harewood which is conveniently placed between Leeds and Harrogate. Harewood village offers several local amenities that include a thriving village hall which hosts several social events, a bustling coffee shop, the renowned Harewood Arms, an excellent primary school, alongside the village tennis courts, outdoor gym and newly installed children’s play area. Village residents also benefit from annual membership to Harewood House Estate meaning access to the house gardens, Italianate terrace, Himalayan garden, adventure playground, several special event days and finally 1000 acres of grounds to explore, with a circular footpath for those who like to appreciate the outdoors; all on your doorstep. Services We are advised the property has gas central heating. Mains electric and mains drainage. results.summary: Nestled within a highly sought-after cul-de-sac in the heart of East Keswick, this beautifully presented home offers an exceptional standard of finish alongside picturesque views of the surrounding countryside. Combining modern comfort with timeless style, the property provides spacious and versatile accommodation ideal for both family living and entertaining. Upon entering, you are welcomed into a bright and inviting interior, where a generous open-plan living and dining area forms the hub of the home. Bathed in natural light and complemented by warm flooring and a charming feature fireplace, this space creates a perfect setting for relaxing evenings or hosting guests. French doors open onto the rear garden, seamlessly connecting indoor and outdoor living. The kitchen is thoughtfully designed with ample cabinetry, quality work surfaces, and integrated appliances, offering both practicality and style for everyday cooking. The property boasts four well-proportioned bedrooms arranged over the upper floors. Each room enjoys elevated views across the attractive village landscape and neighbouring countryside, while the principal and second bedroom benefit from the added luxury of an en-suite. A contemporary family bathroom serves the remaining bedrooms; all finished to a high specification. Externally, the home continues to impress. A west facing private rear garden provides a peaceful retreat, ideal for outdoor dining or simply enjoying the tranquil surroundings. The property also benefits from a garage and driveway parking, alongside a mature front garden. Perfectly positioned in the centre of the highly desirable village of East Keswick, the property enjoys the best of semi-rural living while remaining conveniently connected with excellent bus services to Leeds and Wetherby. East Keswick is renowned for its strong sense of community, attractive surroundings, and excellent local amenities, including well-regarded schooling, village butchers, welcoming pubs, beauty salon, sports facilities and village hall – all adding to the community spirit. Surrounded by beautiful Yorkshire countryside, the area offers an abundance of scenic walks and outdoor pursuits right from the doorstep. Despite its peaceful setting, the village provides straightforward access to Leeds, Wetherby, and Harrogate, making it an ideal choice for commuters seeking a balance between countryside tranquillity and urban convenience. Homes in this location are consistently in high demand, reflecting both the charm of the village and the exceptional quality of life it offers. This is a rare opportunity to acquire a superbly finished home in one of East Keswick’s most popular locations - early viewing is highly recommended. Quiet, cul-de-sac position (away from flight path) with gardens to the front and rear and parking for two cars. Briefly comprises, entrance hall, beautiful lounge with many features including open fireplace, dining room, modern fitted kitchen. Upstairs are three double bedrooms and a spacious dual aspect house bathroom. Easy access to Yeadon's amenities with good transport links. Make an apointment to view today - call . LOCATION This property is situated in a very enviable location close to access routes yet retaining a semi-rural feel. Yeadon town centre has many amenities including a wide range of shops and recreational facilities with excellent local schools and is close to the neighbouring town of Guiseley and Rawdon where there are further shops and restaurants. The A65 goes directly into Leeds City centre with access routes to Bradford City centre. There is a rail link from Guiseley station and Horsforth stations to Leeds. For the more travelled, Leeds/Bradford Airport is a short drive away. GROUND FLOOR A welcoming hallway offers traditional features giving access to a good size lounge at the front of the house with feature open fireplace, original stripped and stained floorboards and delightful period features. Also from the hallway is a generous dining room, ideal for both day to day living and for when entertaining. Great versatility of use here with central stone fireplace, wood effect flooring and useful understairs storage. There are lovely rear garden views too. Opens through to the kitchen with a Range style oven, gas stove and space for a tall fridge freezer. Plumbing for a washing machine and a dishwasher. Dual aspect windows flood the room with natural light and there is a door out to the garden. FIRST FLOOR There's useful fitted storage up on the landing with doors through to the three well appointed bedrooms and the impressive, house bathroom with dual aspect to the rear and side elevations. The main bedroom is at the rear of the house, the second to the front and the third double, also at the front of the house. The bathroom is so spacious with a four piece suite incorporating a bath tub, separate shower enclosure, WC and pedestal wash hand basin. The floor is tiled and tiling continues to the wet areas. There is a chrome heated towel rail. OUTSIDE The property is situated down a private road (shared maintenance) in a quiet cul-de-sac position with allocated parking spaces for two vehicles. There is a nice size garden to the front, mainly laid to lawn with pathway leading up to the front door. The rear garden is low maintenance with a flagged courtyard, field views and fully enclosed with walled and fenced boundaries. A lovely spot to sit out and relax. The dining room is bright and airy with ceiling coving, and a ceiling rose, windows to the rear, and patio doors leading to the rear garden. The modern house bathroom is a wet room with a shower, a sink with vanity unit, an enclosed cistern W.C., and a window to the rear. There are also a window and a door to the rear. There are two double bedrooms. The main bedroom has fitted wardrobes, ceiling coving and window to the front. Outside, to the front of the property there is a lawned garden. To the rear is a garden laid to lawn with a flagged patio and a brick-built outhouse. There is also a flagged driveway to the rear which leads to the garage, complete with an up and over door, power, and light. results.summary: Positioned back from the road behind secure electric gates, this detached home has a lovely sense of retreat as you approach. A generous driveway leads you towards the house, where the front garden is framed by a variety of mature trees, most notably a striking monkey puzzle tree that gives the setting real character from the outset. West Park Road is ideally situated just off the vibrant Street Lane, with many amenities within easy reach, and a short drive from the ever-popular Roundhay Park. Step through the front door and into a spacious entrance hallway where beautifully patterned tiles create a memorable first impression. Underfloor heating beneath the hallway tiles adds a welcome touch of comfort, setting the tone for the quality found throughout the home. To the right sits the reception room, a bright and inviting space centred around a beautiful bay window that draws in natural light and offers a lovely outlook towards the front garden. Continuing through the hallway, the home opens into a wonderfully generous open-plan kitchen, dining and living space that forms the true heart of the property. A large central island anchors the kitchen area, surrounded by contemporary grey cabinetry that offers both style and practicality. The kitchen is particularly well equipped, featuring two Neff slide-and-hide ovens alongside two large built-in fridge and freezer units, creating a space that is as functional as it is sociable. Wooden flooring runs underfoot, enhancing the sense of warmth and flow throughout the space, while mirrored detailing on the wall behind the kitchen worktops reflects light beautifully and amplifies the sense of space. Practicality has been thoughtfully considered, with a separate utility room and a convenient downstairs WC accessed off the main living space. Just off the kitchen is an additional room, currently used as a home office, offering a flexible space that could easily adapt to suit a range of needs, whether as a workspace, snug or playroom. With such a sociable and well-designed layout, this space lends itself perfectly to both everyday living and entertaining. Beyond the kitchen, the room naturally extends into a relaxed living area and a dedicated dining space, making it ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Sliding patio doors open directly onto the decking outside, creating a seamless connection between the indoor and outdoor spaces. The decking area has been thoughtfully arranged with seating, offering the perfect setting for summer evenings spent hosting friends or enjoying quiet time outdoors before stepping down onto the expansive garden beyond. Stairs lead up to a spacious, carpeted landing on the first floor. Here you'll find a beautifully finished four-piece bathroom featuring both a bath and separate shower, complemented by stylish tiling and carefully considered design details. Underfloor heating provides additional comfort in this space. Also on this level is a well-proportioned double bedroom positioned at the rear, enjoying a lovely outlook across the garden. To the front of the home sits an additional room currently used as a home office, with views towards the distinctive monkey puzzle tree and the greenery that surrounds the front garden. Next door is a further double bedroom, featuring a beautiful bay window that draws in natural light and gives the room a wonderful sense of openness. The second floor continues the sense of space, where another generous double bedroom enjoys a large picture window looking out across the surrounding treetops. Elevated above the garden, the outlook from here feels wonderfully leafy. This bedroom also benefits from its own en-suite bathroom, finished with elegant tiling and a spacious his-and-hers style shower. Adjacent to the bedroom is a fitted walk-in wardrobe, illuminated by large skylights that fill the space with natural light. Outside, the garden stretches an impressive distance, creating a wonderful sense of space and privacy. A paved pathway runs through the lawn, bordered by established flower beds that add colour and structure throughout the seasons. The garden has been well maintained and offers plenty of room for relaxing, entertaining, or simply enjoying the outdoors. Finished with contemporary décor throughout, subtle staircase lighting and thoughtful modern touches such as underfloor heating and a remote-controlled gas fireplace, the home is ready to move straight into. Combining generous living spaces with a strong connection to the garden and a sense of privacy from the moment you arrive, it offers a fantastic setting for both everyday living and entertaining. This property is the perfect option for families, with a selection of well-regarded local schools nearby, adding to the overall sense of convenience and lifestyle this location offers. Local transport links on Street Lane, along with proximity to the Ring Road, provide convenient access to the A58, A61, and A64 for car users.
