results.summary: Tucked away in a highly sought-after area of Yeadon, this deceptively spacious four-bedroom townhouse is beautifully arranged over three floors and enjoys a peaceful cul-de-sac setting—ideal for modern family living. The ground floor welcomes you with an inviting entrance hallway, providing access to the integral garage, which offers excellent potential for conversion subject to the necessary permissions. Also on this level is a convenient guest W.C. and a versatile second reception room/bedroom four, featuring patio doors that open directly onto the rear garden—perfect for guests, a home office, or additional living space. To the first floor, the heart of the home unfolds with a stunning open-plan lounge, dining, and kitchen area, designed to create a seamless flow ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The modern dining kitchen is positioned to the rear and boasts integrated appliances, a stylish breakfast bar, and pleasant open views overlooking a green space. To the front, the light-filled lounge benefits from a Juliet balcony, adding to the sense of space and natural light. The second floor hosts three well-proportioned bedrooms, with the master boasting a contemporary en-suite shower room. A modern house bathroom, fitted with a sleek three-piece suite in white, serves the remaining bedrooms. Externally, the property continues to impress with off-street parking to the front, including an electric vehicle charging point. To the rear, is a fully enclosed, low-maintenance garden with a patio seating area providing the perfect setting for relaxing or entertaining outdoors. This superb home combines style, space, and practicality in a desirable location, making it an excellent choice for a wide range of buyers. Yeadon's wealth of local amenities include highly regarded schools, local shops on the high street, including Morrisons Supermarket, pleasant walks around Yeadon Tarn which is also a boating lake, Nunroyd Park and other recreational facilities. There is also neighbouring Horsforth and Guiseley town centres with an array of shops, businesses and retail parks. Yeadon is sandwiched between two railway stations which offers link to Leeds, Bradford, Ilkley and Skipton. Further, for the commuter, there is the A65, Harrogate Road (A658), and Leeds Bradford Airport. results.summary: A charming two bedroom character stone terrace in the centre of Otley town . Set over four floors, the property is well proportioned throughout. The living room on the ground floor has a beautiful feature fireplace, the kitchen is located on the lower ground floor, the style is simple and timeless and the window to the front allows for some natural light. Upstairs there are two double bedrooms, the first is on the first floor as well as a generous family bathroom and the second double bedroom is on the top floor. Outside there is an enclosed low maintenance garden and on street parking. Overall this is a great opportunity for anyone looking to buy in a sought after location and with the significant benefit of NO ONWARDS CHAIN. Otley is a thriving market town in the Wharfe Valley offering a wide range of amenities, shops, supermarkets and traditional pubs. The town centre bus station has regular bus services to Leeds, Bradford and Harrogate, and in addition, there is a railway station at nearby Menston offering mainline links. For those further afield, Leeds/Bradford International Airport is in nearby Yeadon. Directions - From our Hunters Otley offices in Kirkgate, proceed along Bondgate which becomes Gay Lane. Turn right onto Cambridge Street and Carlton Street is the second turning on the right, where the property can be clearly identified by our Hunters For Sale board. Agents

This extended three-bedroom semi-detached house is for sale in a sought-after residential area of Pudsey, close to Stanningley, offering convenient access to local amenities, schools and transport links. The main RECEPTION room features an exposed brick chimney, front bay window and log burner, creating a comfortable living space. Whether you’re a commuter, a growing family, or someone who loves a vibrant town with a friendly, close-knit feel, Pudsey is a place that truly feels like home. results.summary: A substantial four-bedroom end townhouse arranged over three spacious floors and offered to the market with no onward chain. Featuring a separate single garage, a front room that could be converted into a fifth bedroom, and fully vacant possession, this property offers excellent potential for families or investors looking to create a flexible home. To the front is a versatile room, currently a lounge space, this could easily be used as a fifth bedroom for elderly relatives or larger families. The remaining two bedrooms are well-proportioned, suitable for children, guests, or home office use, and are served by a family bathroom if needed. Exterior Externally, the property benefits from a low-maintenance rear garden, ideal for seating, outdoor dining and entertainment. The garden shed is also included within the sale. results.summary: A charming two/three bedroom semi detached cottage with modern kitchen, garage, and gardens in Middleton. VIEWING ESSENTIAL. EPC rating D59. Situated on the outskirts of Leeds in Middleton, this charming two/three bedroom semi detached cottage offers a fantastic opportunity for buyers seeking a well proportioned home with modern features. Boasting a modern fitted kitchen and bathroom, generously sized bedrooms, front and rear gardens, and off road parking, this property is certainly not to be missed. The accommodation briefly comprises an entrance hall leading to an inner hallway, which provides access to the living room, kitchen/diner, and staircase to the first floor. The kitchen/diner benefits from an understairs storage cupboard. To the first floor, the landing gives access to two double bedrooms and a modern bathroom. Bedroom one includes a walk-in wardrobe, additional storage cupboard, and loft access. Bedroom two leads to a versatile room, ideal for a dressing room, home office, or additional sleeping accommodation. Externally, the front garden is attractively laid with a mix of paving and pebbled areas, mature shrubs and trees, and an outbuilding. The rear garden is low maintenance, featuring an artificial lawn, paved and pebbled seating areas, space for two timber sheds, and access to a tarmac driveway leading to a single detached garage with power and light. The garden is fully enclosed with walls, fencing, and an iron gate providing secure access. Middleton is a highly desirable location, ideal for first time buyers, small families, or professional couples. Local shops, schools, and the popular Middleton Park are within walking distance. Excellent transport links include local bus routes, nearby Morley train station, and quick access to Leeds city centre, White Rose Shopping Centre, and major motorway connections including the M1 and M62, with wider links to Manchester and London. A full internal inspection is essential to fully appreciate the accommodation on offer, and early viewing is highly recommended to avoid disappointment. Accommodation - Entrance Hall - A frosted UPVC double glazed entrance hall door leading into the entrance hall with a central heating radiator and doors leading to the living room, corner kitchen diner and stairs to the first floor landing. Living Room - 4.00m x 4.22m (max) x 3.36m (min) (13'1" x 13'10" - A UPVC double glazed window to the front elevation, central heating radiator, and a decorative fireplace with tiled surround and wooden mantle. Kitchen Diner - 5.72m x 2.85m (18'9" x 9'4") - Fitted with a range of wall and base shaker style units with laminate work surfaces, ceramic 1.5 bowl sink and drainer with mixer tap, tiled splashbacks, a four ring gas hob with extractor above, and an integrated oven. Space and plumbing for a washing machine, tumble dryer, and space for a fridge freezer, as well as an integrated dishwasher. UPVC double glazed windows to the rear and side elevations, access to an understairs storage cupboard, spotlighting to the ceiling and a central heating radiator. First Floor Landing - Doors to two bedrooms and the bathroom. Bedroom One - 3.20m x 3.25m (max) x 2.60m (min) (10'5" x 10'7" ( - Loft access, a door to a storage cupboard, fitted wardrobes with sliding partially mirrored doors, a central heating radiator, and a UPVC double glazed window to the front elevation. Open through to the walk-in wardrobe. Walk In Wardrobe - 3.20m x 1.63m (10'5" x 5'4") - A UPVC double glazed window to the side elevation, a range of fitted storage units, and a central heating radiator. Bedroom Two - 3.08m x 2.85m (10'1" x 9'4") - A UPVC double glazed window to the side elevation and a central heating radiator. Office/Dressing Room - 2.52m x 2.87m (8'3" x 9'4") - A UPVC double glazed window to the rear, central heating radiator, and a decorative cast iron fireplace. Fitted units beside the chimney breast within the alcoves. Bathroom/W.C. - 1.60m x 3.20m (5'2" x 10'5") - An extractor fan, central heating radiator, frosted UPVC double glazed window to the side, low flush w.c., wash basin with mixer tap and storage below, a panel bath with mixer tap and shower attachment, and a separate shower cubicle with electric shower, glass screen and full tiling. Outside - To the front of the property, the garden is tiered with paved and pebbled areas, mature trees, shrubs, and access to an outbuilding. The garden is fully enclosed with walls and iron fencing, including an iron gate. The rear garden is low maintenance and mainly artificially lawned with paved and pebbled areas with a tarmac driveway providing off road parking for one vehicle, and a single detached garage with an up-and-over door, power, and light. results.summary: Situated in the heart of sought-after Farsley, this beautifully presented ground floor apartment offers a fantastic opportunity for first-time buyers, downsizers, or investors alike. Ready to move straight into and offered with no onward chain, the property forms part of a modern development set within well-maintained communal gardens, complete with secure intercom entry, allocated parking, visitor spaces, and a communal bike store. Combining convenience, comfort and location, this home truly ticks all the boxes. This spacious and light-filled ground floor apartment features two generous double bedrooms, a stylish modern Shaker kitchen with integrated appliances, and a bright lounge/diner with Juliet balcony. Externally, residents benefit from allocated parking, visitor parking and attractive communal gardens, all within walking distance of excellent local amenities, transport links and countryside walks. Offered with no chain, this is a superb home is ready-to-move-into. LOCATION Farsley has been named as an up-and-coming area to watch in the The Sunday Times Best Places to Live 2021 guide. It is a small but increasingly popular Village from which commuting is straightforward, either by private or public transport The A6120 and A647 are both on hand and provide major links to the motorway networks. Just a short distance away is the popular Owlcotes Centre at Pudsey offering a Marks & Spencer store, Asda superstore, and there is a train station adjacent. In addition, the bus services are frequent from the village, getting you into Leeds & Bradford City centres. There is a good selection of shops, pubs and eateries in Farsley and schools are also popular. The neighbouring villages of Pudsey and Horsforth are only a short distance away and also offer a comprehensive range of facilities. A recreation/playground is within a short walk, ideal for children and pets. GROUND FLOOR Accessed via a secure intercom entry system, the apartment opens into a welcoming entrance hallway providing access to all rooms and creating a practical and well-laid-out living space. The lounge/diner is a bright and spacious reception room, enhanced by a Juliet balcony that allows natural light to flood the space. Generous in size, it offers ample room for both relaxing and entertaining. The modern Shaker kitchen is beautifully presented and enjoys dual aspect windows to the side and rear elevations, creating a wonderfully light environment. Fitted with contemporary grey Shaker-style units and wood-effect work surfaces, the kitchen includes an integrated electric oven, four-burner gas hob with canopy extractor, integrated dishwasher and washing machine, plus space for a tall fridge freezer. A fitted breakfast bar provides casual seating — perfect for morning coffee — and the layout has previously accommodated a dining table. A stainless steel sink with mixer tap and tiled splashbacks complete this stylish and functional space. Bedroom one is a generous double room featuring a side elevation window and bespoke Shaker fitted wardrobes to one wall, offering excellent storage. Bedroom two is another well-proportioned double bedroom, also with a side elevation window and attractive wood-effect flooring. The modern bathroom is spacious and well-appointed with a three-piece suite comprising a ‘P’-shaped bath with mixer shower over, WC and vanity basin. Stylish herringbone tiling to the wet areas, wood-effect flooring and a front elevation window add to the contemporary finish. OUTSIDE Externally, residents enjoy beautifully maintained communal gardens, allocated parking, visitor parking spaces, and a communal bike store — ideal for those embracing the excellent nearby cycle routes and countryside. With superb road, rail and bus links close by, alongside vibrant local amenities and scenic walks right on the doorstep, this impressive apartment offers both lifestyle and practicality in equal measure. LEASEHOLD & RELATED CHARGES We understand that the property is leasehold and may there fore carry an annual charge for maintenance/ground rent. We are advised that the following applies. Length of Lease 125 years - with 103 remaining as of 2026 - Ground Rent £150 P.A. , doubling every 25 years: £300 from 2029, £600 from 2054, £1,200 from 2079, £2,400 from 2104, and £4,800 from 2129 onwards. Maintenance charge of £1178 Pa Clarification regarding lease terms, length and any charges should be sought via the vendors solicitors. BROCHURE DETAILS Hardisty and Co prepared these details, including photography, in accordance with our estate agency agreement. SERVICES – Disclosure of Financial Interests Unless instructed otherwise, the company would normally offer all clients, applicants, and prospective purchasers its full range of estate agency services, including the valuation of their present property and sales service. We also intend to offer clients, applicants and prospective purchasers' mortgage and financial services advice through our association with Mortgage Advice Bureau. We will also offer to clients and prospective purchasers the services of our panel solicitors, removers, and contactors. We would normally be entitled to commission or fees for such services and disclosure of all our financial interests can be found on our website. results.summary: This charming, stone, 2 bedroom end terraced house is offered for sale CHAIN FREE and is situated in the popular residential area of Bramley. Set over 4 floors, the property has undergone recent improvements to include new carpets and re-decoration throughout. Internally it comprises a generous cellar, spacious living room with adjoining kitchen, 2 double bedrooms and a well-proportioned bathroom – all within walking distance of Bramley Railway Station, a stones throw of Bramley Baths and Bramley Park and easy access of the major road links such as the M62 and A647. Bramley itself is highly popular among families, benefitting from a selection of reputable schools such as Bramley St. Peter’s CE Primary and Intake High School, alongside a number of local amenities including Bramley Shopping Centre, Bramley Falls Woods and Gotts Park. Leeds city centre is just 4 miles to the west of here and is easily accessed via car, bus, or rail. There is a recently fitted gas combination boiler, electric cooker and hob plus an integrated fridge. Lower Ground Floor Stairs from the rear of the kitchen descend to a spacious CELLAR with very useful dry storage or workspace with ample head height and boarded ceiling. It has been finished to a fantastic standard with modern Karndean flooring. results.summary: An immaculately presented contemporary home with westerly facing enclosed gardens in an exclusive and convenient location for local primary and secondary schooling. 25 Mellor Close is a modern terrace house constructed by PJ Livesey and Son, a well-respected Yorkshire builder in 2016. As the photographs show, the living space is immaculately presented and well-designed with an open plan living area to the ground floor split into kitchen, living and dining portions together with a downstairs WC. To the upper storey are three bedrooms of varying sizes and the house bathroom. The master bedroom has the added benefit of an en suite. There is also access to a partially boarded and lit loft via a retractable ladder. The property benefits from all mains services and sealed unit double glazing. There is allocated parking to the property’s front, whilst to the rear are westerly facing enclosed level gardens and a flagged sitting out area. The property forms part of the Wharfedale Park development offering a blend of new and converted dwellings of interesting and individual designs. The location is excellent, schools for all ages are located nearby including the highly regarded Prince Henry’s Grammar School. Otley’s popular and historic market town offers excellent shopping facilities with many recreational and sporting facilities, and a central bus station. The town is ideally placed for commuting into Yorkshire’s key industrial centres including Leeds, Bradford, Harrogate and York, and the national motorway network (A1/M1/M62) is nearby at Wetherby making areas further afield more accessible by road. There is a railway station at nearby Menston and Leeds/Bradford International Airport is again nearby in Yeadon. results.summary: CHAIN FREE This beautifully presented home offers spacious and versatile living accommodation ideal for modern lifestyles. The property features a bright bay-fronted living room, an extended kitchen and dining area perfect for family life and entertaining, and a superbly converted garage now serving as a flexible garden room with electrics and heating. Upstairs are two generous double bedrooms with fitted wardrobes and a modern family bathroom, while a fully boarded and plastered loft provides excellent additional storage. Externally, the home benefits from a generous driveway providing parking for up to four vehicles and a low-maintenance front garden enjoying morning and early afternoon sunshine. LOCATION Kirkstall is a popular residential area, with easy access into the City Centres of both Leeds & Bradford, via Kirkstall Forge train station, bus & road links. The A65 is close by and connects to major links and the motorway network. Kirkstall Abbey and the refurbished museum offer interesting & green spaces where you can enjoy a pleasant walk or family days out. The Savins Mill Way shopping complex is on hand, providing a Morrisons Superstore, Boots and various other shops, with Kirkstall Bridge Shopping Centre across the road where there is a gym and a further array of shops. Along the A65 you can find the Kirkstall Warner Village with a wide selection of leisure facilities including gym, bowling alley, cinema, and various restaurants. The neighbouring village of Horsforth is within easy reach, Leeds - Bradford Airport, again only a short drive away and a dedicated airport bus service runs from the city centre through Kirkstall. Vibrant Headingley is a walk away where you can enjoy extensive bars, eateries, shops and restaurants, along with the Headingley Stadium where international cricket and rugby can be enjoyed. GROUND FLOOR The ground floor welcomes you with a wonderfully airy front living room, generously proportioned and centred around a large bay window that fills the space with natural light throughout the day. The room provides an inviting setting for both relaxing and entertaining, with ample room for a range of furnishings while retaining a bright and open feel. Following on there is a second lounge space, currently a games room. To the rear, a well-planned side galley kitchen flows seamlessly into a thoughtfully designed rear extension, creating a spacious and sociable kitchen and dining area. The layout offers excellent worktop and storage space, while the wrap-around design naturally opens into the dining area, providing plenty of room for a full dining table and enjoying a pleasant outlook towards the garden. Completing the ground floor is the superbly converted garage (with WiFi internet installed), now a versatile garden room fitted with electrics and heating, making it suitable for comfortable year-round use as a home office, gym, studio or hobby space. FIRST FLOOR Upstairs, the property offers two well-proportioned double bedrooms, both bright and spacious with fitted wardrobes providing excellent built-in storage. These rooms offer flexible accommodation suited to family living, guest rooms or home working arrangements. There is also a third smaller bedroom that is perfect for a child or office. The family bathroom is fitted with a modern suite comprising a panelled bath with shower over, wash hand basin and WC, finished in a clean and practical style. The property further benefits from a fully plastered and boarded loft space, providing excellent additional storage and the potential for a variety of uses. Easily accessed via a convenient drop-down ladder, this well-prepared area offers a tidy and practical solution for keeping household items organised while presenting scope for further enhancement, subject to the necessary consents. OUTSIDE Externally, the property offers a generous driveway to the front providing off-road parking for up to four vehicles, offering convenience for both residents and visitors. The remainder of the frontage is laid to low-maintenance astro turf, creating an attractive and usable lawn area that enjoys pleasant morning and early afternoon sunshine — ideal for relaxing or placing outdoor seating with minimal upkeep required. results.summary: A beautifully refurbished four-bedroom semi-detached home in the highly sought-after Primley Park area of LS17, offering spacious, high-spec family accommodation with landscaped gardens, underfloor heating, and superb open-plan living. The entire ground floor benefits from underfloor heating, creating a luxurious and comfortable living environment. results.summary: This stunning two-bedroom, two-bathroom, ground-floor apartment has been completely refurbished and is perfectly positioned in a leafy and tranquil corner of the highly sought-after Alwoodley Chase development. Offering over 960 square feet of living space, a private patio, a fob-operated garage and off-street parking, this home is ideal for those looking to downsize without compromising on space or quality. Upon entering, the communal entrance features a secure intercom entry system leading to a well-presented private hallway. This space includes a WC, a storage cupboard and a cloakroom for added convenience. The first of the two generously sized bedrooms is located to the left, featuring built-in wardrobes that provide ample storage. A beautifully tiled en-suite shower room boasts a heated towel rail and a walk in shower for a touch of luxury. This stunning bedroom also benefits from direct access to a private patio area, nestled within the beautifully maintained gardens. Shielded by hedges and backing onto the recreational ground, it offers both privacy and serenity. The spacious living room is bathed in natural light, thanks to two well-proportioned windows. The living area seamlessly flows into a dedicated dining space, where double doors open to a Juliet balcony gate that opens, providing access to the communal grounds at the front of the property. The well-appointed breakfast kitchen is fitted with a quartz worktop, gas hob, an integrated fridge-freezer, a double oven, a washer dryer, a dishwasher and a microwave—perfect for modern convenience and functionality. The second bedroom is equally impressive, offering ample built-in storage and an en-suite bathroom complete with a large walk in shower and beautiful none slip tiles. Externally, the property benefits from a generously sized garage with a fob-operated electric door, a designated parking space, and a private patio area. Alwoodley Chase is a prestigious residential development renowned for its beautifully maintained gardens and excellent location. Residents enjoy easy access to major transport links, a wealth of local amenities and recreational facilities, including the David Lloyd Leisure Centre and some of the areas top golf courses. PROPERTY OVERVIEW This impressive and exceptionally well-proportioned detached home is the perfect choice for growing families seeking flexible living space and a modern layout. Ideally situated in a quiet residential area close to local schools, shops, and commuter links, the property offers over 1,700 sq. ft. of accommodation arranged over three floors. Highlights include a stunning master suite with dressing area and en-suite, three further double bedrooms, multiple reception rooms, and a generous rear garden. GROUND FLOOR A welcoming entrance hallway provides access to a modern guest WC and the integral garage, which offers secure storage or parking. To the front, the spacious lounge features solid oak flooring, a large front window, and double doors that lead through to the dining room - perfect for entertaining and family gatherings. French doors open onto the rear garden, flooding the room with natural light. The kitchen is fitted with a range of contemporary wall and base units, integrated appliances, and ample worktop space. It flows seamlessly into a bright dining area overlooking the garden, ideal for everyday family meals. FIRST FLOOR The first floor offers three well-proportioned bedrooms. Bedroom two benefits from an en-suite shower room, while bedrooms three and four are both comfortable doubles, ideal for children or guests. The family bathroom is modern and partly tiled, fitted with a bath, separate shower, hand basin, and WC. SECOND FLOOR Occupying the entire top floor, the master suite is a true retreat. This expansive bedroom features a spacious dressing area, three skylight windows allowing natural light to pour in, and a private en-suite shower room with a modern three-piece suite. A walk-in storage room provides additional functionality, ideal for seasonal wardrobes or a home office. OUTSIDE To the rear, a large enclosed garden provides plenty of space for outdoor entertaining and family activities. The area is mainly laid out to lawn with a patio seating space ideal for summer dining. To the front, a driveway offers off-street parking and leads to the integral garage. LOCATION Situated in a popular development close to Rothwell town centre, this family-friendly area offers a wealth of local amenities, reputable schools, and superb transport connections via the M1, M62, and Leeds Ring Road. The nearby Rothwell Country Park and surrounding green spaces offer fantastic walking and leisure opportunities. Ideally situated in a quiet residential area close to local schools, shops, and commuter links, the property offers over 1,700 sq. ft. of accommodation arranged over three floors. Highlights include a stunning master suite with dressing area and en-suite, three further double bedrooms, multiple reception rooms, and a generous rear garden. GROUND FLOOR A welcoming entrance hallway provides access to a modern guest WC and the integral garage, which offers secure storage or parking. To the front, the spacious lounge features solid oak flooring, a large front window, and double doors that lead through to the dining room - perfect for entertaining and family gatherings. French doors open onto the rear garden, flooding the room with natural light. The kitchen is fitted with a range of contemporary wall and base units, integrated appliances, and ample worktop space. It flows seamlessly into a bright dining area overlooking the garden, ideal for everyday family meals. FIRST FLOOR The first floor offers three well-proportioned bedrooms. Bedroom two benefits from an en-suite shower room, while bedrooms three and four are both comfortable doubles, ideal for children or guests. The family bathroom is modern and partly tiled, fitted with a bath, separate shower, hand basin, and WC. SECOND FLOOR Occupying the entire top floor, the master suite is a true retreat. This expansive bedroom features a spacious dressing area, three skylight windows allowing natural light to pour in, and a private en-suite shower room with a modern three-piece suite. A walk-in storage room provides additional functionality, ideal for seasonal wardrobes or a home office. OUTSIDE To the rear, a large enclosed garden provides plenty of space for outdoor entertaining and family activities. The area is mainly laid out to lawn with a patio seating space ideal for summer dining. To the front, a driveway offers off-street parking and leads to the integral garage. The nearby Rothwell Country Park and surrounding green spaces offer fantastic walking and leisure opportunities. results.summary: Guide Price £340,000 - £355,000 Situated in a highly convenient and well-regarded area of Kirkstall, this unique detached family home offers a rare opportunity to acquire a property of this size and flexibility. Having been extended over time, the home provides well-balanced accommodation ideally suited to modern family life, with further potential to enhance or reconfigure if desired. The property is entered via a porch into a central hallway, creating a welcoming first impression and giving access to the main living spaces. To the front, the lounge is a bright and comfortable room, enhanced by a bay window that allows for plenty of natural light, making it a perfect space to relax or entertain. To the rear, the property opens up into a spacious dining kitchen — undoubtedly the hub of the home. Fitted with contemporary high-gloss units, the space comfortably accommodates a range-style cooker and American-style fridge freezer, with ample room for dining. Patio doors lead directly out to a sheltered eating are and out to the rear garden, creating an ideal setup for indoor-outdoor living. Upstairs, the standout principal bedroom is an impressive dual-aspect room, offering generous proportions and excellent natural light, with clear scope to introduce an en-suite if required. Two further double bedrooms, both with fitted storage, provide comfortable accommodation for family or guests, while the fourth bedroom offers flexibility as a nursery, dressing room, or home office. The house bathroom is fitted with a modern three-piece suite, complemented by stylish tiling and practical storage solutions. Externally, the property occupies a generous plot with gardens wrapping around three sides. The rear garden has been designed with entertaining in mind, featuring a tiered layout with covered patio seating areas, while the side garden adds further usable outdoor space. To the front, a driveway provides ample off-street parking and leads to a garage equipped with power and lighting. The location is particularly appealing, offering excellent access to local amenities and transport connections. Kirkstall Forge railway station is within easy reach, providing convenient links into the city centre, while nearby bus routes along the A65 offer additional connectivity. The scenic grounds of Kirkstall Abbey are close by, along with a range of shopping facilities and leisure amenities. The vibrant areas of Horsforth and Headingley are also just a short distance away. results.summary: Tucked away at the head of a quiet cul-de-sac and set within attractive communal grounds, this light and spacious three bedroom first floor apartment offers ready-to-move-into accommodation and is available with the advantage of no onward chain. Accessed via a secure communal entrance with intercom system, the apartment opens into a welcoming and generously proportioned central reception hall, which provides access to all principal rooms. The sitting room is a lovely size living space, flooded with natural light and enjoys a pleasant outlook over the rear gardens. The room flows seamlessly into the dining area, which also benefits from excellent natural light and attractive garden views, creating a sociable and versatile living environment. Partially open to the dining area is the well-appointed kitchen, which offers a good range of fitted units and ample working space. A window to the front provides a pleasant outlook along the street, while a door leads directly onto the private balcony, which enjoys views over the communal rear gardens – an ideal spot for a morning coffee or evening relaxation. The apartment provides three well-proportioned bedrooms, all offering comfortable accommodation, with one benefitting from a fitted wardrobe. The bathroom is fitted with a white suite comprising a panelled bath with shower over, wash basin and WC. Externally, the communal gardens are a particular feature of the development. Maintained as part of the management arrangements, the grounds are well cared for and bordered by mature hedging and trees, providing a pleasant and peaceful environment for residents to enjoy. results.description: A fantastic opportunity to acquire this three bedroom detached property, offering huge potential to create a superb family home tailored to your own tastes. Requiring updating throughout, the property has been priced to reflect its current condition and presents an exciting chance for buyers to add significant value. With the need for a new kitchen, bathroom and overall refurbishment, the home is ready for transformation, while retaining the generous room proportions typical of its era—providing the perfect canvas for modernisation. The accommodation begins with a welcoming entrance hallway leading into an impressive open plan lounge diner. This spacious ground floor layout offers excellent versatility, with the lounge providing a comfortable space to relax and the dining area easily accommodating a family dining table and chairs—ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. From here, access is gained to the kitchen, a space that clearly requires updating but offers ample room for redesign. With thoughtful planning, this area could be transformed into a stylish and functional family kitchen, with access to the rear garden. To the first floor, the property offers three well-proportioned bedrooms, including two generous doubles and a good-sized single, making it ideal for families or those needing additional workspace. The layout is completed by a bathroom and separate WC. Externally, the property occupies an enviable, slightly elevated position within a quiet cul-de-sac, enjoying a good degree of privacy. To the front, a driveway provides off-street parking and leads to a single garage. To the rear, an attractive enclosed garden features both lawn and patio areas—perfect for outdoor entertaining or family enjoyment. Located in the popular area of Churwell, within Morley, the property benefits from a highly convenient setting. There are a range of local amenities including shops, supermarkets and cafes, while nearby White Rose Shopping Centre offers extensive retail and leisure facilities. Well-regarded local schools are within easy reach, making the area particularly attractive to families. For commuters, there are excellent transport links including nearby motorway access via the M62 and M621, as well as rail connections from Morley station, providing straightforward access to Leeds city centre and beyond. results.summary: This fantastic, three bedroom detached home enjoys an impressive plot on the hugely popular Redrow Homes development in Morley offering fabulous links to the nearby Newlands Academy and to Morley train station. Sure to appeal to a mixture of buyers, this fabulous modern home is presented to a high standard with a range of upgrades and offers solar panels & a beautiful South-facing garden which has been landscaped. Internally, the layout comprises; entrance hall with stairs rising to a first floor landing and storage built-in understairs & a storage cupboard. Leading off the entrance hall there is a pleasant guest WC with two piece suite. To the front is a generous formal lounge, offering a comfortable formal reception space with plenty of room for entertaining guests or a large family. Completing the ground floor is an impressive dining-kitchen, offering a stylish range of wall & base units with a suite of fitted appliances with the kitchen fronted in an attractive dual fronted finish with glass splashbacks and four pane glass at the rear having central sliding doors opening into the rear garden. The rear garden is a brilliant space, professionally landscaped to create a large Indian Sandstone patio perfect for summer BBQs and a lawned garden which is all enclosed by boundary fencing as well as having side access to the tarmac driveway which leads to the detached single garage. Having a total of three bedrooms, all of a good size the property offers a great master bedroom suite with fitted wardrobe including a built in dresser & an en-suite shower room having a three piece suite and part-tiled finish. To the rear is a second good-sized double bedroom whilst the third bedroom sits alongside and would make a pleasant bedroom but is currently enjoyed as a home office / study. The property boasts a 96 square foot loft which is fully boarded and equipped with a loft ladder. The layout is completed upstairs by a modern house bathroom positioned at the front and having a part-tiled finish with a three piece bath suite having shower over the bath. Having a remarkable 'A' rated EPC and complete with solar panels and off-peak compatible EV charger included, this generously proportioned home would be perfect for families given the ease of access to the highly regarded Newlands Primary School and well placed for access into Leeds City Centre & the M62 Motorway. To arrange your viewing, please call our Morley Office! results.summary: Located in this highly regarded area of Horsforth, minutes from the extensive amenities on New Road Side and an easy walk to the Forge train station, is this double storey extended four bedroom 1920's semi detached residence. Having undergone some recent refurbishments, the property has been priced to reflect the modernisations still required and a viewing is essential to fully appreciate the potential this fantastic fasmily home has to offer. The property is accessed into the entrance hallway with the original wooden panelling and under stair storage with potential to create a guest w.c. To the front is the bay windowed lounge and to the rear is the extended dining/family room, a versatile reception room with French doors on to the rear garden. Also to the rear is the extended dining kitchen with a range of base & wall storage units, ceramic tiling, plumbing for a washing machine, built in double oven and laminate flooring. To the first floor are four well proportioned bedrooms, recently decorated in a contemporary style with useful fitted storage to two rooms. The bathroom has a three piece suite with bath & shower facilities, shower screen and ceramic tiling. Outside is a well maintained lawned garden to the front, an ample driveway and a single garage. To the rear is a good size lawned garden with paved patio, greenhouse and garden shed. The property sits in this sought after Horsforth location, a bustling town with a wide range of excellent amenities, including well regarded schools for all ages. The Forge train station is close by and Leeds/Bradford airport is a ten minute drive away. There are extensive shopping facilities close by on New Road Side & Town Street, along with a Post Office, a bank, chemists, gift shops and indeed Morrisons supermarket. There is a good bus service along the A65 into Leeds city centre and easy access to the Leeds outer Ring Road. Horsforth Hall Park is a fantastic space at the heart of the community hosting summer events and having a cricket pitch, skate park and playground. Also, within easy reach, a short drive away are the busy towns of Otley & Harrogate. Located close to Leeds city centre, the apartment sits within a well-established residential development surrounded by a mix of townhouses and contemporary apartments, benefiting from residents’ parking and secure underground parking available by separate negotiation. The location offers strong appeal to professional occupiers, with easy access to Leeds city centre, the financial and business districts, St James’s Hospital, and key employment hubs. Excellent transport links are available via regular bus routes, nearby road networks including the A64 and M1, and Leeds railway station within convenient reach. A wide range of local amenities are close by, including supermarkets, independent shops, cafes, leisure facilities, and green spaces, supporting consistent rental demand. Internally, the apartment is well presented and designed for modern living, being offered fully furnished and inclusive of all white goods, allowing for immediate occupation or letting with minimal setup costs. The accommodation includes two double bedrooms, with the principal bedroom benefitting from an ensuite shower room, alongside a contemporary main bathroom. The open-plan living and kitchen area provides a bright, versatile space and leads directly onto a private balcony, enhancing both lifestyle and rental appeal. The entrance hall offers useful built-in storage cupboards, maximising functionality and space. From an investment perspective, the property is particularly attractive as the building benefits from established Airbnb management contracts, offering the potential for a guaranteed income of £1,500 per month, making it a compelling hands-off investment option. Combined with the fully furnished specification and strong location fundamentals, this apartment is ideally suited to both short-term and long-term rental strategies. This is a strong investment or owner-occupier opportunity in an area experiencing ongoing regeneration, high tenant demand, and excellent connectivity. Early viewing is advised. results.summary: *** STUNNING DUPLEX APARTMENT WITH TWO PRIVATE TERRACES & TWO ALLOCATED PARKING SPACES *** Tudor Sales & Lettings are delighted to present to the market this exceptional two-bedroom duplex apartment set within the beautifully converted Boyd’s Mill, located just outside Leeds city centre. Boyd’s Mill is a Grade II listed former mill, sympathetically converted into just ten distinctive apartments, each finished to an outstanding standard. This particular home boasts a high-specification interior, including a luxury fitted kitchen, integrated SONOS sound system, and impressive floor-to-ceiling windows with bi-folding doors that flood the space with natural light. The spacious and thoughtfully designed accommodation briefly comprises: a private entrance, a superb open-plan kitchen, dining and living area, and a mezzanine snug overlooking the main living space. There are two generous double bedrooms, including a principal bedroom with en-suite, alongside a stylish house bathroom. Externally, the property truly stands out, offering two fantastic private terraces, ideal for entertaining or relaxing, as well as the rare benefit of two allocated parking spaces. This is a truly unique home of character and quality, and early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate what is on offer. Private Entrance Accessed via intercom, featuring engineered solid oak flooring and a useful storage cupboard with plumbing for a washing machine. Tenure: Leasehold. Ground Rent - one annual payment by Dec 31st of £300 Service Charge - monthly payment of £294.72 Length of Lease left - 240 years (250 years from 2016) Property additional info Lounge/diner/kitchen: 9.16m x 6.64m (30' 1" x 21' 9") Open plan living at it's finest! Featuring four panel double glazed folding doors. Further double glazed windows to dual aspect. Hard wood flooring and spotlighting to ceiling. Island breakfast bar, a range of wall and base units and integrated appliances to kitchen with double oven and microwave and sink with mixer tap. Mezzanine living space: 4.48m x 3.88m (14' 8" x 12' 9") Spacious living area that could be used as a third bedroom if required. Master bedroom suite: 3.38m x 3.96m (11' 1" x 13' ) Double bedroom with Double glazed window, electric heater and sliding doors to en-suite shower room featuring WC, Sink and shower with surround. Bedroom 2: 4.74m x 2.80m (15' 7" x 9' 2") Double bedroom with double glazed window and electric heater. Bathroom: Fully tiled modern bathroom with white three piece suite comprising of bath, WC and hand basin. results.location: Hilton Grange, Bramhope, Leeds, West Yorkshire
results.summary: A most outstanding opportunity to purchase this superb, mid-town house property which enjoys far reaching views across lower Wharfedale towards Harewood and York, and has well planned accommodation to suit a family buyer. Located on the fringe of Bramhope, yet within walking distance of the picturesque village centre, as well as nearby countryside walks on the famous Chevin, the property has been tastefully presented throughout in light modern decor, providing a ready to walk into environment which is a credit to our client, and is worthy of an immediate viewing appointment! The arrangement of the accommodation can be flexible to meet the needs of interested applicants, to the extent that the ground floor space could even accommodate a dependent relative or an independent young adult or teenager. The Reception Hall provides a welcoming environment and the ground floor also incorporates a Family Snug or Bedroom 4 which has an adjoining Conservatory with access and an outlook on to the rear garden, Downstairs Shower Room fitted with a three-piece suite comprising a shower enclosure with a tiled interior, vanity wash basin and low suite WC, complemented by tiling to half level. There is also the benefit of a Utility Room which is fitted with a smart range of Shaker style, grey wall and base cabinets with a contrasting light working surface over incorporating a stainless steel sink and drainer, and there is plumbing for an automatic washing machine and a twin-pane door leading to the rear garden. A turned staircase with oak treads and spindled balustrade leads from the Reception Hall to the First Floor Landing which has attractive oak strip flooring that extends throughout the first floor, and there is a useful "Hall Robe" with double doors for storage. The very pleasant Lounge has a window to the front and French windows onto a small balcony overlooking the central green of Hilton Grange and this enjoys the evening sunshine! The Lounge also has the benefit of a log burning stove enhancing the atmosphere and warmth of the room. The Dining Kitchen is positioned to the rear of the house and through the window and French Doors revealing the Juliette Balcony, there are splendid far reaching views over the garden, across the valley and towards Harewood and York. The Kitchen is fitted with an attractive range of grey, Shaker style wall and base cabinets with contrasting light working surfaces over, incorporating and undermounted 1 1/2 bowl sink and integrated appliances include a dishwasher, electric oven, microwave, ceramic hob with an extractor filter hood above and a fridge/freezer. A further turned staircase with spindled balustrade leads from the First Floor Landing to the Second Floor Landing. The Master Bedroom is positioned to the rear of the house for the lovely views through two windows and has fitted wardrobes and an En-suite Shower Room which is fitted with a modern, white three-piece suite comprising a shower enclosure with tiled interior, vanity wash bowl with a storage cabinet beneath and a low-suite WC with a concealed cistern, complemented by an attractive tiled floor and window to the rear. There are two further bedrooms, both of which overlook the green to the front and the Family Bathroom is fitted with a modern, white three-piece suite comprising a panelled bath with a shower over, screen an tiling above, vanity wash basin with cabinet beneath and low suite WC with a concealed cistern and complemented by an attractive tiled floor. OUTSIDE The property has side bay side parking for two cars to the front on the drive which leads to the Single Integral Garage with has an up and over door, light, power and a personal door into the Reception Hall. The garden to the rear provides a pleasant environment for outdoor relaxation and is predominantly laid to lawn with borders either side. There is a patio area adjacent to the Conservatory which is ideal for BBQ's and a further, small patio at the far end of the garden enjoys the evening sunshine. AMENITIES BRAMHOPE is located approximately 8 miles north of Leeds off the A660 and is also within comfortable daily commuting distance of the other commercial centre of Bradford and the former spa towns of Harrogate and Ilkley. The historic, active market town of Otley is about 10-15 minute's drive and offers an excellent choice of shopping facilities including Waitrose and Sainsbury's supermarkets and other amenities. BRAMHOPE VILLAGE has a range of local shops including a chemist, a newsagent, a bakery and a greengrocers and there are also hair and beauty salons and a welcoming public house in the village centre. There is a butchers, a cafe and a dry cleaners, as well as another newsagent/small general store on Tredgold Avenue. 3D VITUAL TOUR Before arranging a full internal inspection of this home, we urge you to take a look at our state of the art 3D virtual tour of the property which gives you the opportunity to have an unrestricted viewing from a distance. There is even a tool which will allow you to take measurements! ACCOMMODATION The accommodation has the benefit of Gas Fired Central heating Radiators and uPVC Double Glazed Windows. All room sizes quoted are approximate. results.summary: NO fORWARD CHAIN. Situated in a highly desirable village location, this versatile detached family home has been much loved and adored by its current owners for the last 34 years and is now in search of a new family to love and appreciate it just as much and for those buyers looking for the larger family-sized property, something to put their own stamp on, then this lovely detached should tick all the boxes. Set in an exclusive private cul de sac of only four houses, the property sits proudly on a large corner plot with sizeable, landscaped gardens surrounding it. The owners clearly have green fingers and they have spent a lot of time and effort in creating something very special and with Temple Newsam House and grounds, literally at the end of the street, it is certain to attract those buyers who enjoy walking with pets and or children. The well-maintained accommodation is set over two floors and in brief comprises to the ground floor level, entrance hallway with door to the side and staircase rising to the first-floor accommodation. A guest cloakroom W.C. has part tiled walls, ceiling coving and a window. To the side. The welcoming entrance hall opens on to a reception room which has ceiling coving, window to the rear and fitted base cabinets for extra storage under the staircase. The pleasant tri-aspect living room has a feature fireplace with coal effect living flame gas fire, ceiling coving, a window to the front and side and patio doors leading to the rear garden. This relaxing space will prove the perfect to rest after a long day and the pleasant views over the garden and beyond offer a little bit of magic. The fitted kitchen has a good range of wall and base units with work surface over and ceramic tiled splash backs and incorporates a double bowl stainless steel sink unit with mixer tap, electric hob, oven and grill and offers space for an upright fridge freezer, ceiling coving, plumbing for automatic washing machine, built in pantry cupboard and a window to the front and rear. Set off from the kitchen is a third tri-aspect reception room which is used currently for dining and has windows to the front, side, and rear. This multi-functional room offers lovely views over the garden and has fitted wall and base cabinets, laminated flooring with under floor heating, ceiling coving and a door to the side. To the first floor, a sizeable landing has a window to the front, a built-in linen cupboard, gives access to the loft and leads to four good sized bedrooms, three are double, one is used as a dressing room and the master bedroom is en suite to a bathroom with a white three-piece suite with a chrome heated ladder towel rail, laminate flooring, and ceramic tiled walls. The family bathroom has a double step in shower with screen, sink over vanity unit, ceramic tiled walls, and floor with a window to the side. Light those candles and truly appreciate your time in this room. Outside, set on an enviable corner plot, this home has stunning gardens around it and with a walk-through private landscaped area to the side with patio area, you will feel like you have your own little piece of countryside. There is a generous block paved driveway to provide off street parking for multiple cars, this leads to an attached double garage which has up and over doors, power and light and a personal door to the rear garden. Gated access to the side of the property leads around to the rear garden via an Indian stone patio area/bin store with steps leading up to a garden shed and then onto the gorgeous enclosed rear garden. Being a particular feature, this stunning space has been a real labour of love for the owners, and they have established something special. Split level, there is a lawn area, with Indian stone flagged patio area, raised well stocked planted borders and rockeries and flagged patio areas. A sunken pond with water feature is the home for many fish and offers the perfect focal point when watching over the garden which also has a summer house. No photos could ever truly do this garden justice and surrounded by trees; this tranquil space will steal your heart. Viewing is of course highly recommended to appreciate all this lovely family home has to offer and viewing is strictly by appointment only. Externally to the front the home features a decorative front garden with path to the front door and long driveway leading to a detached garage. The rear features 2 patios including outdoor living room and manicured lawn. The vicinity plays host to a substantial range of world class amenities making this a highly sought after location. The property itself is well presented and perfect for a growing family, or those downsizing, offering well- proportioned and versatile accommodation throughout. This home is situated on a wonderful sized plot with potential (subject to planning) to extend to the land to the side if required, set back from the roadside, allowing a great deal of privacy and tranquillity The property is accessed via double gates leading down the long driveway to the double garage, which benefits from an electric roller shutter door. results.location: Ladywood Mead, Oakwood, Leeds, West Yorkshire
results.summary: Set along one of the area’s most highly regarded residential cul-de-sacs, a superb six bedroom detached family residence, with impressive, elevated tree-lined views to the rear. Within walking distance to Roundhay St John’s Primary School and Roundhay Park, this home is ideal for families and outdoor leisure. A gated driveway to the front of the house provides ample off-street parking and leads to a generous entrance hall with inset floor-lighting, which in turn leads into the reception area. The living and dining rooms have an open plan feel to them, being light and airy, with high quality laminate flooring, feature radiators and pleasant views over the terrace to the rear. There is a further reception room to the rear of the property which is a versatile room with central heating and access out onto the terrace. The kitchen is fitted with contemporary black high gloss fronted units and includes an integrated double oven, five ring gas hob and dishwasher and this leads into the integral garage which has light and power and plumbing for an automatic washing machine. To the first floor the main bedroom has a modern en-suite shower room and enjoys views to the rear. The guest bedroom also has an en-suite shower room, there are three further bedrooms, a study/sixth bedroom, and a stylish recently refitted house bathroom. The property occupies a generous plot which is set back from the roadside by an attractive front garden, and the rear garden has been much improved by the current owners, with a tiered terrace ideal for BBQ's and summer entertaining, lawn with central water feature and balustrade, and again enjoys pleasant woodland views beyond. This home also features uncommonly generous grounds: an almost one-acre south-facing private garden, offering abundant scope for outdoor living, landscaping, and family use. Ideally placed for access to local schools and amenities, as well as Roundhay Park, viewing comes genuinely recommended to fully appreciate the standard and versatility of accommodation on offer. The property is within access of extensive amenities on Oakwood Parade, including restaurants, a variety of shops, a library and a supermarket. Additional facilities on Street Lane include popular restaurants, cafe bars and designer boutiques. Leafy Roundhay Park offers many recreational amenities including parkland walks, the lakes, the sweeping lawns and sports grounds on Soldiers Field, pretty Canal Gardens and Tropical World which is a particularly popular attraction with children. Regular transport services are available which provide access to the city centre and surrounding areas and the outer Ring Road is also close by, providing access to the business centres of Harrogate, York and Bradford and the A1-M1 link road for those commuting further afield. There is a range of schools for all ages and grades in the area, together with a choice of highly regarded children's nurseries. results.summary: Starting bid - £325,000. A rare opportunity has arisen to acquire this charming, three bedroom, stone end terrace, tucked away in a particulary pleasant & private position on the edge of Cragg Hill & Woodside Conservations Area. Enjoying attractive open views & surround by greenery, the property combines delightful character features with deceptively spacious accommodation, all within easy reach of Horsforth excellent amenities, highly regarded schooling & great commuter links. Offered on the market with NO ONWARD CHAIN, this is a wonderful home, ready for the next chapter, briefly, useful cellar, two reception rooms, a dining kit., to the rear with access out to the garden, two double beds., a single/study & traditional 3 piece house bathroom. Early viewing essential, call us - . LOCATION Horsforth, named as one of the top 10 most desirable postcodes in England and is a prime residential location, popular with families and young professionals alike. The property is within easy reach of an array of excellent amenities including well regarded schooling for all ages, lovely canal & river walks, and the extensive shopping facilities found on New Road Side and Town Street including Morrisons supermarket. Horsforth Hall Park is a great addition to the community with a children’s playground, bandstand, cricket pitch, skate park and bowling green. For commuters, Horsforth Train Station provides services to Leeds, York and Harrogate. Kirkstall Forge Train Station is located down the A65 and offers further means of convenient access into the city (8 mins) and surrounding areas. The Ring Road (A6120) and the (A65) are nearby and provide main road links to the commercial centres of Leeds, Bradford, York and Harrogate, a regular bus service runs into the City Centre and, for the more travelled commuter, Leeds-Bradford Airport is a short drive away. All in all, this location is sought after by a wide variety of buyers and enjoys a strong sense of community and a thriving village atmosphere. GROUND FLOOR The property is entered via a useful entrance porch which leads to an entrance hall with staircase up to the first floor. To the front is a delightful sitting room, full of period charm with beautiful, period cast iron fireplace, bay window allowing in lots of light and feature dado rail to walls. This room is highly versatile, a second reception room, cosy snug, reading room or home office. The main lou nge is a particularly striking room, centred around an impressive, exposed stone chimney breast with log burning stove set within a traditional stone fireplace, creating a real focal point. The room is also flooded with light from the dual aspect windows to the front and rear elevations, enhancing the appeal of this delightful room. To the rear of the house is the dining kitchen, fitted with solid oak cabinetry providing ample storage and worktop space. Natural light enters the room from three sides, again beautiful, light and airy feel with space for family dining table and chairs. Ideal for everyday living and perfect for entertaining with French doors out to the rear garden. FIRST FLOOR The landing gives access to the three bedrooms and house bathroom. The Principal bedroom is a generous double and continues to charming feel with original cast iron fireplace, exposed brick chimney breast and stripped and stained floorboards, delightful! The 2nd bedroom is another well proportioned double, also at the front of the house with modern decor and useful dressing area. The third bedroom is at the rear with pleasant garden outlook, its a single room/study. The house bathroom is styled traditonally in keeping with the rest of the house and is fitted with a corner bath, pedestal basin and WC with cistern. Complementing these features is a column style heated towel rail and white tiling to wet areas. A window to the rear provides light and ventilation. LOWER GROUND FLOOR - CELLAR The useful cellar provides excellent storage and scope to create a utility space or workshop area. OUTSIDE This property enjoys a private gated rea garden with sunny aspect in the afternoon. There is a lawned area along with low maintenance block paved driveway/yard, providing useful off street parking. The setting is particulary attractive with the Cragg Hill and Woodside conservation areas and surrounding green spaces just moments away! A delightful semi rural retreat yet still so convenient for Horsforth Town Street, highly regarded schooling, the train station and excellent road and airport links. Interested parties personal data will be shared with the Auctioneer (iamsold). If considering buying with a mortgage, inspect and consider the property carefully with your lender before bidding. This is paid to reserve the property to the buyer during the Reservation Period and is paid in addition to the purchase price. This is considered within calculations for Stamp Duty Land Tax. Services may be recommended by the Agent or Auctioneer in which they will receive payment from the service provider if the service is taken. Payment varies but will be no more than £450.00. These services are optional. PLEASE NOTE The extent of the property and its boundaries are subject to verification by inspection of the title deeds. The measurements in these particulars are approximate and have been provided for guidance purposes only. The fixtures, fittings and appliances have not been tested and therefore no guarantee can be given that they are in working order. The internal photographs used in these particulars are reproduced for general information and it cannot be inferred that any item is included in the sale. MONEY LAUNDERING, TERRORIST FINANCING AND TRANSFER OF FUNDS REGULATIONS 2017 To enable us to comply with the expanded Money Laundering Regulations we are required to obtain identification from prospective buyers once a price and terms have been agreed on a purchase. The cost payable by the successful buyer for this is £50 +VAT per named buyer and is paid to the firm who administer the money laundering ID checks, being Iamproperty / Movebutler. results.summary: Manning Stainton are delighted to present this truly impressive two-bedroom semi-detached property, located within the highly sought-after ‘Bird Estate’ development. The property briefly comprises an entrance hallway leading through to a spacious lounge overlooking the front elevation. Recently renovated, the lounge features a bespoke media wall and new carpets, creating the perfect space for relaxation and entertaining. To the rear of the property, the newly renovated kitchen diner offers a range of modern wall and base units, along with fully integrated appliances including an oven, hob, extractor fan, and fridge/freezer. This bright and airy space provides an excellent setting for family living and comfortably accommodates a four-seater dining table. Externally, the fully landscaped tiered rear garden offers a safe and functional outdoor space for all to enjoy. A useful shed provides additional storage for garden tools and outdoor equipment. Upstairs, the landing leads to two well-proportioned double bedrooms, one overlooking the front elevation and the other the rear. Both rooms offer ample space for bedroom furniture. The family bathroom is fitted with a modern three-piece white suite, including an overhead shower, creating a tranquil and relaxing environment. Finished with modern décor throughout, the property also benefits from a generous driveway providing ample off-street parking for residents and visitors alike. Sure to appeal to a wide range of buyers, this property is not to be missed. Contact our Morley office today to arrange your viewing. Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Checks - As part of making an offer, we’re required by law to complete Anti-Money Laundering (AML) checks to confirm the identity of all purchasers. To cover the cost of this process, a fee of £48 inc VAT per buyer is payable when your offer is accepted. This is a standard requirement for all buyers and helps us ensure your offer can be progressed as quickly and smoothly as possible. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION Tenure Freehold. results.summary: • Service charge: £279 per month (£3,348 p.a.) • Ground rent: £263 per year A thoughtfully designed Grade II listed coach house that retains the original architectural layout intended for a stables conversion, with principal living spaces located upstairs. This elevated arrangement delivers exceptional natural light, enhanced privacy and open outlooks across the courtyard and landscaped grounds. A calm, authentic period home that retains its original architectural design. A rare opportunity to acquire a beautifully presented Grade II listed residence within the exclusive, gated Bardon Hall Mews. Importantly, the property retains the original upside-down living layout designed for this historic coach house conversion, with the principal living accommodation positioned on the upper floor to maximise natural light, privacy and outlook. Originally constructed between 1873 and 1875 as a coach house and stables, this remarkable home carries a legacy of elegance and prestige. In 1902, renowned Leeds architect Thomas Winn exquisitely remodelled the property under commission from celebrated racehorse owner Joseph Pickersgill. During Pickersgill’s ownership, the Bardon Hall Estate became a haven for distinguished guests, including the Prince of Wales. In 2002, the building underwent a sensitive and thoughtful conversion, transforming it into a collection of luxurious homes that artfully combine period charm with modern convenience. The current owners have maintained the property in impeccable condition, recently redecorating and styling it to create a truly warm, inviting sanctuary—perfect for discerning buyers seeking character, comfort, and exclusivity. The first-floor open-plan living, dining and kitchen space is flooded with daylight from a striking floor-to-ceiling window and multiple skylights, creating a bright, airy and uplifting environment throughout the day. Positioned above ground level, the living areas enjoy a calm, private feel with no overlooking and views across both the central courtyard and the mature communal gardens. The ground floor provides two generously proportioned double bedrooms and a stylish shower room, offering a quiet sleeping environment, well suited to modern living patterns. This layout reflects the building’s original design intent, resulting in more naturally proportioned rooms and light filled day-to-day living experience. The property is set away from communal access points and service areas, contributing to a peaceful atmosphere. Further benefits include an EPC rating of C, a comprehensive security system with gated intercom access, ample resident parking, and beautifully maintained communal gardens and grounds. Accessed via secure electric gates from Weetwood Lane, Bardon Hall Mews is part of an exclusive gated enclave. A picturesque private driveway winds through enchanting woodland and manicured gardens, leading to this tucked-away residence at the very end of the complex, offering exceptional peace, privacy and a sense of timeless elegance. Residents benefit from ample parking, beautifully tended communal gardens, and a charming courtyard, complete with trimmed hedges, flowerbeds, and a central stone sundial. This idyllic setting is enhanced by a warm community spirit. The property also boasts an EPC rating of C, offering excellent energy efficiency and lower running costs. This combines character with modern energy performance, ensuring comfort and cost-effectiveness. results.summary: A charming stone-built period cottage nestled in the very heart of East Keswick, offering beautifully presented accommodation arranged over two floors and blending character features with modern comfort. Approached via a charming courtyard setting, the cottage immediately impresses with its traditional stone façade and welcoming presence. Inside, the ground floor is centred around a generously proportioned lounge, flooded with natural light and full of character. Exposed beams, deep-set windows and a striking wood-burning stove set within a stone hearth create a warm and inviting focal point, ideal for both everyday living and cosy evenings in. To the rear, the fitted kitchen is thoughtfully designed, offering ample storage and worktop space while enjoying views over the courtyard. To the first floor, the property offers three well-planned bedrooms, including a spacious principal bedroom, alongside a modern house bathroom and a separate WC, providing excellent flexibility for families, guests or those working from home. Throughout, the cottage has been finished in a neutral, tasteful palette that enhances the sense of light and space while allowing the period features to shine. Modern fixtures and fittings sit comfortably alongside the home’s original charm. Perfectly positioned within the picturesque village of East Keswick, a highly desirable and thriving community nestled between the market town of Wetherby and the cosmopolitan city of Leeds. The village is renowned for its traditional stone-built homes, welcoming atmosphere, and beautiful countryside setting within the Wharfe Valley. East Keswick offers an excellent range of local amenities, including two popular pubs, a village hall, tennis courts, and numerous walking trails across surrounding farmland and riverside paths. For families, there are well-regarded primary schools in nearby Bardsey and Collingham, with easy access to outstanding secondary schools and independent schools in Leeds and Harrogate. The location also provides superb connectivity: Wetherby is just a few minutes’ drive away, Leeds and Harrogate are both within easy reach, and the A1(M) gives fast access to York, the Northeast, and further afield. Despite its accessibility, East Keswick retains a charming rural feel, making it one of Yorkshire’s most sought-after villages. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the charm, space and setting this lovely home has to offer. results.summary: A charming late Victorian cottage style terrace with enviable views across Chapel Allerton allotments to the rear. Conveniently placed for access to the vibrant amenities in the 'village' centre, the property is sure to appeal to young professional buyers and is offered for sale with the advantage of no onward chain. A front door opens into an entrance hallway with staircase to the first floor. There is a cosy living room to the front elevation and a dining kitchen to the rear. To the first floor is a double bedroom with an en-suite shower and wash basin, a single bedroom/home office and a house bathroom. The loft has been converted into an attic bedroom. The property also has a basement cellar. To the rear of the house is garden which backs onto the allotments. Popular Chapel Allerton Park and has tennis courts, a bowling green, a children’s play area and is well used and much loved by the local community. The property is a few minutes’ walk from the vibrant centre of Chapel Allerton which offers extensive local amenities including a range of cosmopolitan restaurants and cafe bars, small supermarkets, and various other specialist and independent shops including a popular fishmonger, cheesemonger, grocer and butcher. Regular public transport services are available on Harrogate Road which afford easy access to the city centre and surrounding areas. results.summary: If you are looking for a property that is ready to move straight into, look no further than this well presented two bedroom Semi-Detached bungalow. The property provides the perfect opportunity for buyers looking for a home that is ideal for easy access to local amenities and excellent transport links. The well-maintained accommodation in brief comprises to the ground floor an entrance porch with a hallway and door to the side. The modern bathroom is fitted with a white three-piece suite including a bath with shower and screen over. The room is finished with ceramic tiled walls and a window to the side. The bright and airy lounge has a feature fire surround as a focal point, ceiling coving, laminated flooring, and French doors to the front, creating a lovely place to unwind after a long day. The modern kitchen offers a range of wall and base units with underlighting, work surfaces over, and tiled splashbacks. It includes a stainless-steel sink unit with mixer tap, an integrated washing machine ,dryer and fridge freezer, along with a freestanding cooker with extractor hood over. The room is finished with ceiling spotlights and a window to the front. There are two double bedrooms. The main bedroom has ceiling coving and laminated flooring with patio doors leading to the conservatory. The conservatory has dual aspect windows, laminated flooring, and French doors opening out to the rear garden. Outside, to the front there is a raised garden with a gravel section and steps leading up to a lawned area. A driveway to the side provides off street parking for multiple vehicles and leads to a detached garage with an up and over door. To the rear there is a garden laid to lawn with a greenhouse and a further flagged patio area, creating an ideal outdoor space for pet owners and those who enjoy dining outdoors. Situated to the East of Leeds City Centre LS14 enjoys a good range of local amenities with convenient transportation links to the A58 Wetherby Road, A64 York Road, Leeds Outer Ring Road, the A1/M1 Link Road, and East Leeds Orbital Route. results.summary: Cornerstone are delighted to offer for sale this spacious and beautifully presented three-bedroom end-terrace home. The Introduction - The first viewings are on Saturday, 28th March 2026. Cornerstone are delighted to offer for sale this spacious and beautifully presented three-bedroom end-terrace home, located at 57 Farm Hill North, Meanwood, Leeds, LS7 2QE. Positioned in an elevated setting, the property enjoys impressive far-reaching views across Meanwood towards Headingley, while offering generous internal accommodation and a superb west-facing rear garden. The property occupies a highly desirable position within the ever-popular suburb of Meanwood, just a short walk from the vibrant centre. Meanwood continues to grow in popularity thanks to its excellent mix of independent businesses, green spaces and convenient access to the city centre, making it particularly attractive to professionals, couples and families alike. Only approximately two miles away, Leeds city centre provides an outstanding range of amenities. The city is home to extensive shopping, including Trinity Leeds, Victoria Leeds, and Leeds Kirkgate Market, along with a vast selection of restaurants, bars, theatres and cultural venues. Leeds also offers excellent employment opportunities, a thriving financial and professional services sector, and superb leisure facilities, all contributing to its reputation as one of the North’s most dynamic cities. Transportation links from Meanwood are good, with frequent bus services running along Meanwood Road and Potternewton Lane, providing easy access to the city centre and surrounding areas.
