results.summary: Monroe invites you to discover a residence of contemporary refinement and understated luxury. Behind private gates on a generous south-facing plot, this outstanding home blends modern sophistication, comfort, and style. Beautifully designed interiors showcase flowing proportions, bespoke finishes, and abundant natural light throughout. Three elegant reception rooms, including a formal lounge, TV lounge, and children’s den, create versatile spaces for family life and entertaining, while the south-facing conservatory opens onto a large decked terrace with stunning views. The bespoke German kitchen, featuring premium Miele appliances, forms the heart of the home and connects seamlessly to outdoor dining terraces and a well-equipped utility area. A versatile leisure wing offers space for wellness and creativity, with a pool, spa, games area, and a private studio and office suite. Upstairs, five beautifully proportioned bedrooms, four with en-suite bathrooms, include a showpiece primary suite with private lounge, balcony, dressing room, and spa-style bathroom. The gardens are elegantly landscaped, providing peace, privacy, and countryside views, a home of modern sophistication and timeless appeal. Monroe invites you to discover a residence of contemporary refinement and warmth. Set behind private gates on a south-facing plot of approximately 0.78 acres, this exceptional home offers an effortless blend of modern sophistication, comfort, and versatility, creating a property that feels expansive yet perfectly balanced. Every detail has been carefully considered, from the bespoke finishes and beautiful natural light to the seamless flow between formal and informal spaces. The interiors combine understated luxury with modern practicality, creating an atmosphere that is both impressive and inviting. The ground floor opens with an impressive entrance hall leading to three elegant reception rooms: a refined formal lounge, a comfortable TV lounge, and a bright, welcoming children’s den. The south-facing conservatory connects to a large decked terrace, filling the home with light and offering a perfect setting for relaxed living and entertaining. At the heart of the home lies a bespoke German kitchen equipped with premium Miele appliances, granite worktops, and a generous dining area. It opens onto a sunny terrace designed for alfresco dining, complemented by a well-appointed utility and laundry area. A highlight of the property is its versatile leisure wing, thoughtfully designed for relaxation and creativity. This area includes an indoor swimming pool and spa, a spacious games and TV lounge, and a private studio and office suite, all beautifully connected and illuminated by a glazed atrium. These spaces offer endless flexibility for wellness, work, or entertainment while remaining comfortably integrated into the home’s overall layout. The first floor features five generously proportioned double bedrooms, four of which have luxurious en-suite bathrooms. The primary suite is a statement of contemporary comfort and indulgence, featuring an illuminated feature wall, remote-controlled curtains and blinds, a private lounge, and a balcony with stunning countryside views. A striking glass atrium and mezzanine level provide the perfect space for a reading corner, art studio, or home office. The en-suite bathroom includes a Jacuzzi bath, steam shower, and a spacious dressing room with sleek sliding wardrobes. Bedrooms two and three are equally impressive, each with stylish en-suite bathrooms and their own dressing room space, while bedrooms four and five are beautifully finished and filled with natural light. Discreetly positioned to one side of the home, a self-contained suite with en-suite facilities provides privacy and flexibility, ideal for a live-in housekeeper, nanny, or independent teenager. Outside, the south-facing gardens are beautifully landscaped, capturing sweeping countryside views and creating a sense of calm and seclusion. Mature planting and elegant terraces make this an idyllic setting for outdoor living. Modern comforts include zoned heating, a recently upgraded boiler, smart home technology, and a comprehensive security system for complete peace of mind. This is a home of contemporary refinement, understated luxury, and perfect proportion, where every space feels beautifully designed, effortlessly livable, and truly one of a kind. For further details or to arrange a private viewing, please contact Monroe. The area is well-equipped with shopping and recreational facilities, including several excellent golf courses and the David Lloyd leisure centre. Both the Grammar School at Leeds in Alwoodley and Gateways in Harewood are within a 15-minute drive. Additionally, the main commercial centres of Leeds, Harrogate, and York are easily accessible. results.summary: Offered to the market with no onward chain, this well-presented four-bedroom detached home is situated within the highly popular area of Rothwell and would make an ideal purchase for a growing family seeking spacious and versatile accommodation. The property offers a thoughtful layout with a range of attractive features designed for modern family living. Externally, the property benefits from a block-paved driveway providing off-street parking, along with a neatly maintained lawned garden to the front which enhances the home’s kerb appeal. To the rear is a fully enclosed garden, predominantly laid to lawn and complemented by a patio seating area, creating an excellent space for outdoor dining, entertaining, or relaxing during the warmer months. In brief, the accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hall with stairs rising to the first-floor landing. To the front of the property is a useful study, complete with built-in bookshelves and desk space, making it ideal for home working. There is also a convenient downstairs WC with wash basin, along with access to a versatile storage room which could equally be utilised as a games room, hobby room, or additional family space. To the rear of the property is a particularly impressive open-plan kitchen, dining, and living area which forms the heart of the home. The kitchen is fitted with a range of units providing ample worktop and storage space, making it both practical for everyday use and well suited to cooking and entertaining. To the first floor, the landing provides access to a generous master bedroom which benefits from fitted wardrobes and bedside tables, along with a modern three-piece en-suite comprising a shower, wash basin, and WC. There are two further well-proportioned double bedrooms, both with fitted wardrobes, as well as a spacious single bedroom. The family bathroom is fitted with a three-piece suite in white, including a bath with overhead shower, wash basin, and WC. results.summary: Offered for sale with no onward chain and set back in a highly sought-after location, this charming two-bedroom Victorian terrace enjoys a south-facing garden and impressive far-reaching views. Situated in the heart of Rawdon village, the property has been a much-loved home for many years and would make an excellent purchase for first-time buyers or those looking to downsize. The accommodation is well presented and briefly comprises a kitchen diner and a spacious, light and airy lounge to the ground floor, with patio doors opening directly onto the rear garden. To the first floor are two bedrooms and the house bathroom, with the principal bedroom benefiting from stunning open views across the Aire Valley. Externally, the property offers off-street parking and a south-facing tiered garden to the rear. The garden includes a patio seating area which takes full advantage of the elevated position and open outlook, creating an ideal space for relaxing or entertaining. The property is ideally located for access to a variety of local amenities and leisure opportunities. Scenic countryside walks can be found nearby at Rawdon Billing and Cragg Wood, while Rawdon village offers well-regarded schools, shops and services along Town Street. Excellent transport links are available, including regular bus services along the A65 into Leeds city centre, with Leeds Bradford Airport also within easy reach. Further amenities, restaurants and rail connections can be found in the neighbouring centres of Horsforth and Guiseley, with Horsforth and Apperley Bridge train stations providing direct links to Leeds, Harrogate, Ilkley, Saltaire and the Yorkshire Dales. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the location, views and character this property has to offer. The property benefits from three good-sized bedrooms, a spacious lounge diner, large kitchen and a generous rear garden, along with the added advantage of off-street parking. Situated in a popular residential area of Morley, the home is conveniently located close to a range of local amenities, excellent schools and motorway links, making it ideal for commuters and families alike. The accommodation briefly comprises an entrance hall leading into a spacious lounge diner, featuring patio doors opening onto the rear garden, creating a bright and welcoming living space. The fitted kitchen offers a range of wall and base units with work surfaces over and benefits from a large utility room providing practical everyday space. To the first floor are three well-proportioned bedrooms, including two generous double bedrooms and a good-sized single bedroom, each offering ample space for bedroom furniture. To the rear is a generous enclosed garden, offering tiered patio areas, creating an excellent outdoor space for families, relaxing or entertaining. Gated access is also available to the side. The property further benefits from central heating and double glazing throughout. The property is ideally positioned within walking distance of Morley town centre, which offers a wide range of shops, supermarkets, cafés and restaurants. results.summary: A superb through terraced property located in the heart of Chapel Allerton, offering 2 receptions, 2 Bathrooms and 4 good sized bedrooms the property is move in ready condition. Viewing Advised. A Beautiful Mid-Through Terraced Character Home in the Heart of Chapel Allerton Ideally positioned in the very centre of vibrant Chapel Allerton, this charming mid-through terraced home offers the perfect blend of character features and modern living. With an enviable location just moments from the area’s celebrated independent shops, boutiques, restaurants and bars, and with excellent bus links providing easy access into Leeds city centre, this is a property that truly embraces convenience and lifestyle. Presented in excellent decorative order throughout, the home provides stylish, ready-to-move-into accommodation. A composite entrance door opens into a welcoming reception hallway showcasing mosaic tiled flooring, dado rails, doors to the ground floor rooms and a staircase rising to the upper floors. To the front, the lounge enjoys a large double-glazed window, a wooden-effect fireplace with tiled hearth and open fire, picture rails and a warm, inviting ambience. To the rear, the superb open-plan kitchen/diner creates a wonderful social space. The dining area features a log burner, useful fitted cupboards and a double-glazed window overlooking the garden. An opening leads into the kitchen, which is fitted with a range of modern wall and base units with complementary work surfaces, a double-glazed side window, Velux roof light, sink unit, range-style cooker with extractor hood, integrated dishwasher and space for a fridge/freezer. A door leads out to the rear garden, while another provides access down to the cellar. The cellar is split into two generous areas, both with power and lighting and good head height, offering valuable and versatile storage opportunities. To the first floor, the landing provides access to two bedrooms and a shower room, with stairs continuing to the second floor. The main bedroom sits at the front of the house and features a double-glazed window, fitted wardrobes, and a sliding door into a spacious en-suite bathroom. The en-suite includes a panelled bath, vanity unit with hand basin, WC, a double step-in shower cubicle with rainfall shower, and built-in storage. The second bedroom on this floor is a further double with a feature fireplace and views over the rear. The shower room comprises a step-in shower cubicle, vanity hand basin, WC, heated towel rail, extractor fan and cupboard housing the combi boiler. The second floor landing offers a small storage cupboard and leads to two additional well-proportioned double bedrooms, positioned to the front and rear respectively. One having a cupboard and provisions for the washing machine and tumble dryer for extra convenience. Externally, there are low-maintenance courtyard gardens to both the front and rear, each laid to gravel and enclosed by low brick walls and fenced boundaries. The rear garden also provides access to a service lane. Street parking is available to the front of the property. This is a fantastic opportunity to acquire a beautifully presented, deceptively spacious character home in one of North Leeds’ most sought-after districts. Early viewing is highly recommended. results.summary: DPSH PROUDLY PRESENTS THIS EXCEPTIONAL FIVE DOUBLE BEDROOM DETACHED FAMILY HOME AT THE HEAD OF A QUIET CUL-DE-SAC OVERLOOKING PLANTATION GREEN IN NEW FOREST VILLAGE, WITH A SOUTH-FACING ASPECT, FOUR BATHROOMS PLUS DOWNSTAIRS WC, LARGE CONSERVATORY, GATED DOUBLE DRIVEWAY & DETACHED DOUBLE GARAGE. **GUIDE PRICE £500,000 - £525,000** PROPERTY OVERVIEW Occupying one of the most desirable plots within the development, this substantial detached home enjoys an enviable position on the edge of Middleton's sought-after New Forest Village. Facing south over Plantation Green, the property benefits from open outlooks to the front and a peaceful cul-de-sac setting, making it ideal for growing families seeking both space and location. New Forest Village is a popular and well-established residential development known for its green spaces, tree-lined walks and community feel, while offering excellent commuter access to Leeds City Centre, the motorway network and nearby amenities including Middleton Park. GROUND FLOOR A composite front entrance door opens into a welcoming central hallway, with staircase rising to the first floor and a useful guest cloakroom positioned beneath. To the left, a snug/reception room features a front-facing bay window, allowing natural light to pour in while enjoying views across the green. This versatile space is ideal as a second sitting room, playroom or home office. To the right, double doors open into a spacious through lounge. This impressive reception room benefits from a feature fireplace and a large front aspect bay window overlooking Plantation Green. To the rear, French doors lead directly into the conservatory, creating a superb flow for entertaining. The dining kitchen is accessed from the hallway to the rear of the property and is well-proportioned, with multiple rear-facing windows providing garden views. The layout allows ample space for a family dining table. A door leads through to the separate utility room, which in turn provides access to the rear garden. The conservatory spans the rear width, with full-height glazing and French doors opening out onto the garden, creating an excellent additional reception space with year-round versatility. FIRST FLOOR The first-floor landing provides access to three bedrooms and the family bathroom. The master bedroom is a generous double positioned to the front, benefitting from pleasant open views and its own en suite shower room. Two further double bedrooms are located on this floor, both well-proportioned and served by a modern house bathroom fitted with bath, wash basin and WC. SECOND FLOOR A staircase rises to the second-floor landing, which features a Velux roof window allowing natural light to flood the space. From here, two substantial double bedrooms are accessed, each enjoying front-facing dormer windows that enhance head height and space. These rooms are ideal for older children, guests or home working. A contemporary shower room with Velux window completes the second floor, making this level perfect as a semi self-contained guest or teenager suite. OUTSIDE The property sits on a prime plot at the head of the cul-de-sac and directly faces south over Plantation Green, creating an open and attractive outlook rarely available within the development. To the front, a large gated tarmac driveway provides off-street parking for multiple vehicles and leads to a substantial detached double garage. The garage offers generous internal space and excellent versatility, suitable for secure parking, storage, workshop use or potential conversion (subject to necessary consents). To the rear, the garden is fully enclosed and mainly laid to lawn, offering a safe and private outdoor space ideal for families and entertaining. LOCATION Woodside View forms part of the highly regarded New Forest Village development in Middleton, known for its landscaped green areas, children's play spaces and proximity to Middleton Park - one of Leeds' largest green spaces with woodland walks and recreational facilities. The area provides excellent transport links into Leeds City Centre, as well as convenient access to the M62 and M1 motorway networks. EXPLORE MORE Offering nearly 2,000 sq ft of versatile accommodation, five double bedrooms, multiple reception spaces and one of the best positions within the development, this is a rare opportunity for families seeking space, outlook and convenience. A virtual tour is available to fully appreciate the layout, proportions and setting of this outstanding home - contact DPSH today to arrange your viewing. results.summary: A four bedroom detached property situated in a quiet cul de sac location. With well proportioned rooms and lawned gardens to front and rear, this property makes an ideal family home. The accommodation to the ground floor briefly comprises a welcoming entrance hall with cloakroom and study, dining room, kitchen and dual aspect living room with wood burning stove and bi-folding doors leading out to the rear garden. To the first floor there are four bedrooms, three of which are doubles and a contemporary bathroom with walk in shower. Externally the property has lawned gardens to front and rear and an asphalt driveway leading to the detached double garage. The rear garden is arranged over two levels with mature shrubs and a fence border. Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the accommodation being offered. Pool-in-Wharfedale is a charming little village known for its character and community spirit. Located along the River Wharfe the area is renowned for its scenery, countryside walks, cycling and inclusive sports opportunities. From grassroots football for both girls and boys, an excellent cricket and tennis club and other activities such as Yoga and Pilates held in the village hall. In the heart of the village is the popular country pub and restaurant The White Hart, a pharmacy offering NHS and private health services, a post office with Golocal convenience store, Shell petrol station and a very popular farm and café shop in nearby Leathley. The village is serviced by local bus routes and whilst there is no railway station, Weeton Station is just a short drive away and provides services through to Leeds, Harrogate, and York. In addition, Leeds and Bradford airport is just six miles away with a direct Flyer bus running hourly. The local primary school is well regarded and Prince Henry’s Grammar School in Otley has been recognised by Ofsted as an outstanding school across the board. Directions - From our Hunters Otley offices in Kirkgate, proceed towards Pool In Wharfedale along Pool Road (A659). At the junction by the petrol station, turn right onto Main Street. Proceed along Main Street until you get to the mini roundabout (The White Hart is on your left), taking the second exit right onto A658. Turn right into Old Pool Bank then take the first turning into Willow Court. Shortly after joining Willow Court and the property can be found on the right hand side. Agents

Haighfield Holiday Park is set within around 5 acres of beautifully maintained green spaces, offering a peaceful rural setting with open countryside views and a designated dog walk, ideal for those who enjoy the outdoors and a relaxed pace of life. Located in Bardsey, West Yorkshire, the park is perfectly positioned between Wetherby, Harrogate, and Leeds, allowing owners to enjoy the tranquility of the countryside while remaining within easy reach of excellent local amenities, attractions, and main transport routes. Set within the immaculate and impressive grounds of our 5-star rated park, Haighfield Holiday Park offers a quality selection of both brand-new and pre-owned static holiday homes, thoughtfully positioned on spacious plots as standard. The park has been designed with the discerning customer in mind, providing fresh air, open green spaces, and a calm, welcoming environment that makes it one of the most desirable holiday home ownership locations in the area. As a family-run business, we are committed to continually investing in and enhancing the park to ensure the highest standards are maintained. Owners can take advantage of the many nearby attractions or simply enjoy a peaceful walk around the park and surrounding countryside, escaping the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Haighfield Holiday Park is a holiday home and lodge park only, ensuring a quieter, more exclusive atmosphere without touring caravans, tents, or campers. The park is owners-only, with no sub-letting permitted, although close family members are welcome to enjoy your holiday home. If you are drawn to the charm of this beautiful area and would like to view one of our holiday homes, we invite you to contact us to arrange an appointment and discover everything Haighfield Holiday Park has to offer. There’s plenty of space to relax in the Malton’s cosy lounge, whether you want to put your feet up in front of the telly or chill out with friends or family. Those big patio doors are great for enjoying the views of your holiday park. And with comfy, freestanding furniture you can even rearrange it to suit you. There’s even a pull-out sofa bed as standard for when you have extra folk stopping over. The colour scheme is nice and calming too - cashmere furniture and pink cushions contrast beautifully with the grey carpet and oak highlights. The open-plan kitchen and living room make the most of the Malton’s space. There’s all the room you need to cook up a treat, with a cooker and fridge-freezer as standard, and an integrated microwave. You also get a freestanding dining table and plush, upholstered chairs. That means you’ll eat in comfort, and you can shuffle things around to suit you. The bedroom is one of the most important rooms in your holiday home. Haighfield Holiday Park is a beautifully maintained, five-star, owners-only holiday park set within five acres of landscaped green space and open countryside, offering a peaceful setting with stunning Yorkshire views. Designed for relaxation and privacy, our small, quiet park provides a friendly, family-run atmosphere where owners can truly feel at home. Ideally located between Wetherby, Harrogate and Leeds, you can enjoy the tranquillity of the countryside while benefiting from excellent nearby amenities and transport links. Open 12 months of the year, you can make the most of your holiday home in every season. Owners enjoy secure gated access, spacious plots, low pitch fees, on-site facilities including a laundry, and a designated dog walking area. Unlike larger or busier parks with bars, entertainment venues, touring caravans, tents or pods, Haighfield is exclusively for holiday home owners only. results.summary: This stunning three bedroom family home is beautifully presented and offers well-proportioned accommodation that will appeal to a range of buyers. The dining room is equally impressive, boasting a large bay window and a log burner inset in to exposed brick fireplace, making it the perfect space for entertaining guests. The modern dining kitchen is a highlight of the property, with plenty of space to cook and dine. The kitchen also benefits from a utility room, which provides additional storage space and a convenient laundry area. Upstairs, you will find the master bedroom, which features a range of fitted wardrobes that provide ample storage space. There are also two further double bedrooms, a contemporary fitted family bathroom, and a useful separate shower room. Externally, the property enjoys a good-sized rear garden that is overlooked from the dining kitchen. The detached single garage and large block paved driveway provide ample parking for multiple vehicles. Located within walking distance of the popular Tranmere Park Primary Schools, this property is perfect for families with young children. The town centre of Guiseley is a short drive away and provides a broad range of shopping and recreational facilities as well as a railway station. MODERN, WELL-PRESENTED AND READY TO MOVE INTO - THIS THREE-BEDROOM HOME OFFERS GENEROUS LIVING SPACE, A PRIVATE GARDEN, AND OFF-STREET PARKING IN A POPULAR MORLEY LOCATION! PROPERTY OVERVIEW Located in a quiet and sought-after development just off Dartmouth Park in Morley, this three-bedroom end terrace home is ideal for first-time buyers, young families or downsizers. The home benefits from a well-balanced layout with a spacious lounge/diner, guest cloakroom, private garden, and a block-paved driveway for two vehicles. GROUND FLOOR Step into a welcoming entrance hall with stairs rising to the first floor and doors leading to the guest cloakroom, lounge, and kitchen. The kitchen sits at the front of the home and is fitted with a range of modern units and worktops, providing excellent cupboard and prep space. To the rear, the spacious lounge offers ample room for both a dining table and lounge furnishings. A large rear window and French patio doors flood the room with natural light and open directly onto the garden - perfect for summer entertaining or keeping an eye on children playing outdoors. FIRST FLOOR Upstairs, the landing gives access to three well-sized bedrooms and the family bathroom. The master bedroom is positioned at the front and includes built-in wardrobes. Bedrooms two and three overlook the rear garden, with the third bedroom ideal as a nursery, guest room or home office. The house bathroom is finished in a neutral style and includes a bath with overhead shower, wash basin and WC. OUTSIDE To the front, a low-maintenance garden with shrub borders gives a welcoming kerb appeal. A block-paved driveway to the side of the house offers parking for two cars. The rear garden is fully enclosed, mainly laid to lawn with a patio seating area and secure fencing - an ideal outdoor space for families and pets. LOCATION Dartmouth Mews is a tucked-away cul-de-sac close to the amenities of Morley town centre. You'll find local schools, shops, supermarkets and parks within easy reach. Excellent road links via the M62 and M621 make this a great spot for commuters heading into Leeds, Wakefield or Bradford. The private and enclosed rear garden is a delightful oasis, featuring a paved seating area surrounded by raised borders, an artificial lawn, a tranquil pond, and a storage shed. This home is not just a property; it is a lifestyle choice, perfect for families seeking a blend of modern amenities and a peaceful village atmosphere. results.summary: Welcome to Haven Chase, Cookridge, where you will find a delightful three-bedroom detached bungalow offered for sale chain-free. This charming property, set on a generous corner plot, boasts 872 square feet of well-maintained living space, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a comfortable and inviting home. As you enter, you are greeted by a practical entrance porch, perfect for storing coats and shoes, ensuring the main living areas remain tidy. The bright and spacious lounge/diner is a standout feature, with large bay windows that flood the room with natural light. This L-shaped living area is perfect for entertaining guests, adorned with neutral décor and a stylish electric fire that adds a touch of warmth. The well-equipped kitchen offers a range of neutral eye and base level units, providing ample work surface area and convenient side door access. An inner hallway connects all rooms and includes a useful storage cupboard and loft access, with the loft being boarded for additional storage potential. The bungalow features three generous bedrooms, each well-proportioned, with the master and second bedroom benefiting from fitted wardrobes. The spacious bathroom is designed with a large four-piece suite, offering both functionality and comfort. Externally, the property is set on a sizable corner plot, featuring a charming front rockery, a driveway, and a larger-than-average garage equipped with power and water. The rear garden is low maintenance and paved, providing an ideal space for outdoor furniture and flowerpots, surrounded by hedge boundaries and a walkway that encircles the bungalow. Haven Chase is perfectly positioned close to a wealth of local amenities, including shops, gyms, a golf course, doctors' surgeries, and reputable schools and nurseries. With excellent transport links to Leeds City Centre and scenic walks right on your doorstep, this property offers the best of suburban living with easy access to the city. Call the Pudsey office today to book a viewing! Overview This stunning terrace period property, built in 1790, is situated in the charming village of Calverley. With three spacious bedrooms, two versatile reception rooms, and newly renovated kitchen and bathroom, this home seamlessly combines historical charm with modern comforts. Additionally, it offers off-street parking for up to 3 cars. Living Room This elegant living room exudes a sense of comfort and style, perfectly blending modern amenities with period charm. The room is bathed in natural light from the large window, providing a bright and airy atmosphere. The room features beautiful wooden flooring, adding warmth and character and the sleek, contemporary fireplace serves as a focal point, offering both aesthetic appeal and functional warmth. Dining Area The second reception room is currently utilized as a dining area. This room offers ample space for a large dining table, perfect for family meals and entertaining guests. A striking feature of this room is the stone fireplace with a wood-burner, and the traditional stone flooring which adds warmth and character. Kitchen Newly renovated to a high standard, this modern kitchen blends seamlessly with the property's historical character. The kitchen is equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, ample storage, and sleek countertops. This space is designed for both functionality and style, making it a joy for any home chef. Bathroom This newly renovated bathroom combines modern design with functional elements to create a sleek and comfortable space. The room features contemporary fixtures, including a modern toilet and a stylish vanity with a sleek sink and ample storage below. This bathroom also features a spacious bathtub with an overhead shower. The wall-mounted towel radiator ensures warm towels and additional heating, adding to the comfort of the space. Bedrooms This property boasts two double bedrooms and a single room, which could also be used as a home office/study space. All 3 bedrooms have large windows which floods the rooms with plenty of natural light. Each bedroom is tastefully presented and have plenty of potential. Additional Information This property comes with convenient off-street parking, which is a rare and valuable feature in the Calverley area.The property has also recently had a new central heating boiler installed along with 5 new radiators. There is also ample cellar storage, which is a huge benefit. Agents notes We are advised this property is Freehold and will be sold as such. The EPC is a band E with the potential to be a C. The Council Tax is a band B. results.summary: A FANTASTIC RENOVATED THREE BEDROOMED DETACHED PROPERTY WITH OFF STREET PARKING AND LOVELY LEAFY VIEWS TOWARDS PARKLAND TO THE REAR, OFFERED WITH NO CHAIN, SITUATED IN THIS HIGHLY CONVENIENT LOCATION, JUST A FEW MINUTES WALK TO EXTENSIVE SHOPS, BARS & RESTAURANTS IN HORSFORTH, CLOSE TO LOCAL SCHOOLS, AMENITIES AND WITH EXCELLENT ACCESS ONTO THE OUTER RING ROAD AND LEEDS BRADFORD AIRPORT. This stunning well presented property would make a great starter home for a young family or professionals, or perhaps those looking to down size. The well planned and modern accommodation comprises an entrance hall, a lounge with feature electric fire and a recess for a wall mounted flat screen TV, a fantastic spacious open plan modern dining kitchen with built-in appliances and shaker style units, a breakfast bar style island and large fully glazed windows and doors opening onto the paved terrace to the rear. The three additional ceiling skylights add extra light making this a lovely bright, welcoming and generously proportioned room. There is a very useful utility room off the kitchen and a separate w/c. The entrance hall, kitchen, utility and w/c room all feature attractive oak effect LVT flooring. Upstairs, there are two double bedrooms, a third single bedroom or study and a stylish fully tiled bathroom w/c with shower over the bath. Outside, there is a good sized block paved drive providing off street parking, a lawned garden and some planted borders. The drive extends down the side of the property, leading to a lovely fully enclosed terraced rear garden with a paved patio and lawned areas over two levels. The terrace provides leafy views and with some strategic planting, could offer a good degree of privacy. Internal viewing is strongly advised of this attractive & modern, ready to walk into home. results.summary: Situated in a popular residential area of LS26, this well-maintained mid-terrace family home on Woodland Crescent offers generous and well-balanced living accommodation, making it an ideal choice for first-time buyers, small families, or investors seeking a property with excellent local amenities and strong transport links. Upon entering, you are welcomed into a bright and inviting living room that provides a comfortable space for both relaxing and entertaining. The room is well proportioned and neutrally presented, offering a blank canvas that can easily be styled to suit individual tastes and lifestyles. To the rear of the property is a modern fitted kitchen/diner, designed with practicality in mind and offering ample cupboard and worktop space. There is room for a dining table, making it perfect for everyday meals or hosting friends and family. The kitchen enjoys good natural light and benefits from direct access to the rear courtyard, creating a seamless flow between indoor and outdoor living. The first floor comprises two well-sized bedrooms, including a generous master bedroom that spans the full width of the property. The second bedroom is versatile and would work equally well as a guest room, nursery, or home office. The accommodation is completed by a neatly presented family bathroom fitted with a three-piece suite and tiled finishes, providing a clean and functional space. Externally, the property features a private rear courtyard garden that is low maintenance and ideal for enjoying warmer months, relaxing with a morning coffee, or adding potted plants for a touch of greenery. The space is secure and easy to manage, making it particularly appealing for those with busy lifestyles. The location offers excellent connectivity, with a range of local shops, schools, parks, and public transport options close by. Convenient access to the M1 and M62 motorways ensures straightforward commuting to Leeds, Wakefield, and surrounding areas, further enhancing the appeal of this attractive home. Triple-aspect lounge with log-burning stove and re-lined flue The heart of the home is a bespoke open-plan living kitchen, seamlessly flowing into a cosy snug area — perfect for family gatherings, casual dining, or quiet evenings in Twin Belfast sinks, integrated dishwasher, and Rangemaster cooker Peninsula breakfast bar, walk-in pantry, and cleverly concealed storage Open-plan dining area with aluminium bi-fold doors to decked terrace Utility room, shower room with WC, and a quiet home office tucked to the rear First & Second Floors First Floor: Ensuite bedroom with electric shower Two additional double bedrooms Family bathroom Bedroom five currently used as a single bedroom Second Floor: Large principal bedroom with bespoke fitted wardrobes Landing with additional built-in storage Luxury four-piece bathroom including freestanding bath, walk-in double shower, and twin Velux windows providing natural light and ventilation Multiple eaves storage cupboards Created via a full roof-raise (approx. 15 years ago), offering generous head height without dormers and a sense of open, secluded comfort Outdoor Space & Garage Large driveway for 3–4 vehicles Detached garage/workshop (approx. 958 sq ft) with: Double Hörmann automatic roller doors (front) Power, lighting, and mezzanine level/workshop accessed via timber stairs Service door to rear at ground floor level. travellers Leeds Bradford Airport is also within easy reach for domestic and international travel School Catchment Located within easy reach of a wide selection of highly regarded state and independent schools, including: Lawnswood School (state secondary) St Chad’s C of E Primary Holy Name Catholic Academy Iveson Primary Abbey Grange Church of England Academy (state secondary) The results.summary: Preston Baker are delighted to offer this beautifully presented three-bedroom semi-detached home on Kedleston Road, just off Street Lane in North Leeds. "This is a lovely, sunny and bright house with wonderful neighbours. We've loved being walking distance to all the shops and bars nearby" - the current owners. Step through the front door into a bright, welcoming hallway where newly installed wooden flooring flows across the entire ground floor. To your right, the bay-fronted lounge provides a relaxing retreat, centred around a feature fireplace. To the rear of the home lies the spacious, open-plan kitchen/dining room. The stylish new kitchen is finished with elegant quartz worktops, sleek handle-less cabinets and integrated appliances, with social breakfast bar seating around the peninsula. The open space easily accommodates both formal dining and relaxed seating, perfect for entertaining family and guests. Patio doors allow plenty of natural light and open onto the rear garden. A useful understairs storage cupboard houses the newly installed combi boiler (Dec 2025). Upstairs, the recently refitted house bathroom is in pristine condition and features a w/c, wash hand basin with storage vanity, electric mirror, bath tub, and a large, luxurious walk-in shower cubicle. Also to this level are two good-sized double bedrooms, the front with a bay window, and a further single bedroom, perfect as a child’s room or home office. Neighbouring properties have successfully completed loft conversions, meaning there is excellent potential to create an additional bedroom and bathroom on the second floor (STPP). The home has good energy efficiency with an EPC rating of C. Externally, the property benefits from gardens to both the front and rear, a detached garage and a large driveway. The rear garden is mainly laid to lawn, ideal for pets and children to play, and enjoys a private outlook. The size of the plot presents strong potential to extend the ground floor (STPP). Kedleston Road enjoys close proximity to a vibrant selection of cafés, bars, shops and restaurants on Street Lane. Within close reach is the famous Roundhay Park with its expansive green spaces, lakeside and woodland walks plus festivals and events. There are great public transport links and commuter links through Leeds and to Harrogate. Families are drawn to the area by the choice of highly regarded schools. Please head to our website to use our online viewing booking tool, or contact our office on to book your viewing appointment! This immaculate three-bedroom home is offered for sale within a quiet cul-de-sac in Wortley, Leeds, presenting a stylish and well-presented property that will particularly appeal to first-time buyers and couples seeking a home that is ready to move straight into. The property is well placed for local amenities including nearby schools and shops, along with excellent transport links for commuting into Leeds. results.summary: This beautifully presented and thoughtfully renovated three-bedroom period stone terraced home offers stylish and spacious accommodation arranged over three floors, including a well-designed loft conversion. The property has been carefully maintained and upgraded by the current owners, creating a move-in ready home that blends character features with modern comforts. Recent improvements include a new bathroom installed in 2023, replacement windows, composite doors and new flooring throughout, while the roof was replaced in 2004 when the loft conversion was completed. Outside, the property enjoys a small enclosed front yard and a generous, established rear garden with patio and lawn, along with on-street permit parking. LOCATION Horsforth, named as one of the top 10 most desirable postcodes in England and is a prime residential location, popular with families and young professionals alike. results.summary: A traditional three bedroom semi detached offering lots of scope and potential for buyers to modernise and update the accommodation to suit their own tastes and requirements, available for sale with the advantage of NO ONWARD CHAIN. The accommodation has a ground floor entrance hall with staircase to the first floor, living room with a spay bay window to the front elevation, to the rear is a dining room overlooking the rear garden, separate kitchen with useful pantry storage cupboard. A first floor landing gives access to two double bedrooms, a small bedroom/nursery/study, a wetroom with separate W.C. Outside, to the front of the property is a small garden area with driveway providing off street parking leading to garage, to the rear is a lovely garden area mainly laid to lawn. The property is a few minutes from extensive amenities on Oakwood Parade, including restaurants, a variety of shops, a library and a supermarket. Additional facilities on Street Lane include popular restaurants, cafe bars and designer boutiques. Leafy Roundhay Park offers many recreational amenities including parkland walks, the boating lake, the sweeping lawns and sports grounds on Soldiers Field, pretty Canal Gardens and Tropical World which is a particularly popular attraction with children. Regular transport services are available which provide access to the city centre and surrounding areas and the outer Ring Road is also close by, providing access to the business centres of Harrogate, York and Bradford and the A1-M1 link road for those commuting further afield. There is a range of schools for all ages and grades in the area, together with a choice of highly regarded children's nurseries. results.summary: Positioned within the heart of Thorner, this detached bungalow occupies an exceptionally generous plot and presents a rare and exciting opportunity for buyers seeking a home with significant potential. Set back from Station Lane and surrounded by mature trees and established boundaries, the property enjoys a high degree of privacy along with expansive gardens that wrap around the bungalow. The grounds provide ample space for landscaping, outdoor entertaining, or further development, subject to the necessary consents. Internally, the bungalow offers well-proportioned accommodation arranged on one level. While the property is now in need of full modernisation, it provides a solid and versatile footprint that lends itself perfectly to refurbishment, reconfiguration, and possible extension. Buyers will appreciate the scope to create a contemporary home tailored to their own tastes, or to enhance and enlarge the existing accommodation to maximise the size and setting of the plot. The property is situated on Station Lane in the highly sought-after village of Thorner, a picturesque and well-regarded community renowned for its semi-rural charm, strong sense of village life and excellent accessibility. Thorner combines the appeal of a traditional Yorkshire village with the convenience of being within easy reach of Leeds and Wetherby, making it particularly popular with families and professionals alike. The village itself offers a range of local amenities including a popular village pub, café, cricket club and a highly regarded primary school, all contributing to a vibrant and welcoming community atmosphere. Surrounded by rolling countryside, Thorner is ideally placed for outdoor pursuits, with an abundance of scenic walks, bridleways and cycle routes right on the doorstep, offering open views across the surrounding landscape. Despite its tranquil setting, the village is exceptionally well connected. Nearby road links provide straightforward access to the A58, A64 and A1(M), offering convenient commuting into Leeds and beyond. Leeds city centre is within comfortable driving distance, providing an extensive range of shopping, dining, cultural and employment opportunities. Overall, this is a rare opportunity to acquire a detached bungalow in a substantial plot, in one of the area’s most desirable village locations, with enormous potential for improvement and future growth. results.summary: Dacres Son & Hartley are delighted to bring to market this VERY IMPRESSIVE AND SUBSTANTIAL BARN CONVERSION, Sure to appeal to familes and couples looking to acquire their 'forever home' the property is something truly stunning. It has the best of both worlds rural but yet only a few minutes from Horsforth and amenites. MAGNIFICENT DETACHED FOUR BEDROOM barn conversation RESIDENCE Offered to the market with NO ONWARD CHAIN, this impressive home is full of character and charm and provides flexible accommodation of more than 3000 sq.ft. This beautifully layered home blends timeless charm with modern versatility, offering character features alongside bright, open spaces perfect for entertaining or unwinding. With four bedrooms, multiple reception areas, and a walled garden and patio, it’s a sanctuary designed for both family life and quiet luxury. Every detail invites comfort, personality, and the freedom to truly make it your own. The ground floor is a haven of space and light, at the heart of the home, a substantial kitchen-living/dining area is designed with both style and practicality in mind. With extensive fitted storage in the kitchen, a breakfast bar with seating, it’s a true showstopper. A large dining area and ample space for a living space, bright airy arch double height stable window, creating a perfect setting for dinner parties or family gatherings, with access to the garden. The main lounge is rich in character, log burner and double doors opening into the kitchen/dining family room and access outside, an ample room to curate a cosy yet spacious feel all year round. Also on the ground floor is a wc, utility room, drying room and a large luxurious bedroom with its size and natural light. It benefits from fitted wardrobes/ storage and a stunning en-suite shower room. There is two staircase's one which to the principal bedroom, it benefits from a walk-in wardrobe with fitted storage and a stunning en-suite bathroom, featuring a freestanding bath, walk-in shower a stunning space. The second staircase has a gallery landing and a mezzanine living room, the aspect, views and light are sure to wow you. The landing leads to an office area, two further double bedrooms with a jack and gill house bathroom with separate shower and bath, one of the bedrooms has a walk in wardrobe/storage space also. Externally, the property is accessed by private gates on Scotland lane which leads down a private road past open green fields and equestrian stables, which leads to the courtyard via a second set of gates. These four properties were all converted around 2017 a lovely private development. This exceptional property offers spacious accommodation, elegant interiors, and a wealth of features, making it a truly special home in a highly desirable location. Scotland lane remains a prime address and sought after location within Horsforth North Leeds locale. results.summary: NEW PHOTOS - An individual and attractive THREE BEDROOM SEMI DETACHED house located in the ever popular residential area of Woodhall, close to excellent transport links, amenities and schools. The property showcases stunning, ready to move into accommodation throughout which has recently been refurbished to an impressive standard and benefits from high quality fixtures and fittings throughout. Boasting a fabulous KITCHEN/DINER, two reception rooms, a LUXURIOUS BATHROOM and externally a large DRIVEWAY and enclosed GARDEN. This beautiful home is sure to appeal to a range of buyers in particular PROFESSIONAL COUPLES and YOUNG FAMILIES. With the benefit of GAS FIRED CENTRAL HEATING and PVC DOUBLE GLAZING, the accommodation briefly comprises: ENTRANCE HALL with stairs rising to the first floor and beautiful 4 ft hanging chandelier. The LIVING ROOM is a light and airy reception room with a dual aspect, wall mounted remote control electric fire, flat screen TV and hanging LED feature light. The DINING ROOM is another good sized reception room which has a large understairs storage cupboard, door to the rear and leads through to an impressive KITCHEN/DINER which showcases an excellent range of wall and base units with Quartz worktops. There is an integrated NEFF electric oven, hob, grill, microwave and extractor hood, space for an American style fridge/freezer, a breakfast bar and sliding patio doors to the garden. In addition, to the ground floor, there is a useful GUEST W/C with low flush toilet and heated towel rail. Upstairs, there are THREE bedrooms, two of which are double sized rooms, and bedroom one provides access to a partially boarded loft space with light and power.(with the possibility of converting the loft space into a bedroom, subject to planning permission) The BATHROOM features a LUXURIOUS FOUR PIECE SUITE and includes a freestanding bathtub, shower cubicle with black fittings and overhead mains powered rainfall shower, floating style vanity style sink unit, ‘Vessini’ taps, heated towel rail, wall mounted LED mirror, wall mounted 22 inch smart TV screen with apps including Netflix and YouTube, tiled flooring and fully tiled walls. Outside, to the front, there is a large DRIVEWAY with double metal gates, allowing for plenty of off street parking. To the rear, the garden is fully enclosed and is mainly lawned, ideal for sitting out and relaxing. There is a wooden shed for storage purposes, a patio area to the bottom of the garden and to the side, another patio area, perfect for sitting out in the shade. The property is located in a desirable and well regarded residential area, situated between Pudsey and Calverley Village. Calverley and Woodhall Hills golf club are within half a mile of the address and there are well regarded schools within 800 metres. There are excellent transport links via road and railway to Leeds and Bradford situated, within 1 mile of the property. results.summary: The Property * No Chain* Situated in a quiet cul-de-sac in the ever-popular Woodhall Park Grove, Pudsey, this well-presented detached family home offers spacious and versatile accommodation, ideal for modern family living. With a flexible layout, attractive gardens, and a desirable location close to local amenities, this home is perfect for families looking to settle in a welcoming and well-connected community. The property is entered via a practical entrance porch leading into a bright and welcoming hallway. To the front of the home is a spacious living room, ideal for relaxing or entertaining, which flows seamlessly into the conservatory—a light-filled space that offers delightful views over the private rear garden, perfect for enjoying all year round. A stylish fitted kitchen sits at the heart of the home and opens into a spacious dining area, creating a fantastic open-plan layout for everyday family life. Just off the dining area is a flexible family room or fourth bedroom, offering excellent versatility for use as a guest room, playroom, or home office. A modern ground floor shower room adds additional convenience, ideal for guests or multi-generational living. Upstairs, the landing features an attractive arched window, adding natural light and a touch of character. There are three generously sized bedrooms, all well-presented. Notably, bedroom two benefits from a private balcony—a rare and appealing feature offering a pleasant outdoor space to enjoy your morning coffee or evening breeze. The family shower room is well-appointed with a contemporary suite, catering comfortably to family needs. Externally, the property enjoys a driveway leading to a detached garage, providing ample off-road parking. The front garden is well maintained, while the rear garden is a standout feature—not overlooked and offering a peaceful, private space to relax, entertain, or let children play safely. Located close to a range of local schools, shops, parks, and excellent transport links. results.summary: | NO CHAIN SALE | A superb opportunity to acquire a well proportioned home set on a generous plot, offering bright open plan living, two excellent double bedrooms & a fantastic bespoke garden room. With exciting scope to modernise & personalise, this is a property full of potential, both inside & out - ready for its next owner to truly make it their own. Sitting in this popular & sought after Cookridge position, excellent amenities, schooling, the train st., & great road & airport links are all on your doorstep. Currently comprises, entrance hall, open kitchen, dining & living space with access out to the rear garden, two good size double beds., the main with fitted storage & a two piece house bathroom with separate WC. Such an exciting opportunity to make your own, sure to appeal, early viewing is essential - call us - . LOCATION Cookridge is a popular village with a good mix of accommodation and amenities available, along with reputable schools, a recently re-designed and re-furbished sports club/swimming pool, Asda superstore and a Health Centres at Holt Park. Ideally situated for access to Otley Road (A660) and the Ring Road (A6120) thus making commuting straight forward. Public transport facilities are good by bus or alternatively by railway from the Horsforth Train Station located at the bridge on the Horsforth/Cookridge border. Horsforth village is just next-door where a vast range of shops, supermarkets, pubs and restaurants can be found. Beautiful countryside can be found within a short distance and the Cookridge Hall Golf Course and Bannatyne health club are on the doorstep. Headingley is a short distance away with a vibrant mix of shops and restaurants, plus the renowned Headingley Stadium for rugby & Cricket. GROUND FLOOR A welcoming hallway provides space for coats, bags, shoes, etc., with a tiled floor which continues through to the kitchen. There's also useful under stair storage. The kitchen continues through to the rear with pleasant garden views and opening through to a dining and living space, well planned with entertaining in mind. The open aspect from the kitchen into the dining/living space creates a sociable layout with patio doors leading out to the garden and windows flooding the space with natural light. The kitchen is fitted with a range of cream, high gloss units with complementary worksurfaces, integrated electric oven, gas hob, extractor fan over and space for a tall fridge freezer. While perfectly functional as is there is clear opportunity here to update and redesign to suit modern tastes, creating a stunning, contemporary family space. FIRST FLOOR The landing is bright and airy with windows to the side elevation and doors to two generous double bedrooms, a real advantage for buyers seeking space and flexibility. The main bedroom is at the front of the house and has fitted furniture and useful over stair storage. The second is at the rear, looking over the garden with private outlook. From the landing there is access to an airing cupboard, separate WC and two piece bathroom with shower over the bath and basin. The layout present excellent potential to open up to create a modern family bathroom, a simple change that would significantly enhance the first floor. OUTSIDE The property stands on a generous plot with lawned front garden, gravelled driveway to the side and gated side access to useful outbuilding/store room fitted with utility units and a sink, ideal as a dedicated laundry space or workshop area. To the rear is a large, enclosed garden offering fabulous outside space. A substantial decked area providing the perfect setting for entertaining whilst the extensive lawn is ideal for the children to play. The size of the plot also gives future owners exciting scope to enhance, landscape or even extend, subject to the necessary consents. A real highlight though, is the bespoke garden room/summerhouse, allowing more versatility out here, ideal for a home office, gym, studio or relaxation space. Combined with the generous plot and internal potential, this property represents a fantastic opportunity for buyers looking to modernise and create long term value. results.summary: Nestled in the charming area of Cotswold Drive, Garforth, Leeds, is this delightful two-bedroom link detached bungalow. Upon entering, you are welcomed by a spacious entrance hall that leads into a generous lounge, ideal for relaxation or entertaining guests. The modern fitted kitchen is equipped with a built-in oven, hob, and extractor, making it a joy for any home cook. The bungalow features two well-proportioned double bedrooms, providing ample space for rest and personalisation. The bathroom is conveniently located, ensuring ease of access for all residents. With gas central heating powered by a combination boiler that is just 12 months old, you can enjoy warmth and comfort throughout the year. The property benefits from PVCu double glazing, enhancing energy efficiency and noise reduction. Outside, you will find a driveway and carport, offering convenient off-street parking. The low maintenance gardens to both the front and rear provide a lovely outdoor space without the burden of extensive upkeep, perfect for those who prefer to spend their time enjoying the surroundings rather than tending to them. results.summary: A unique opportunity to own this distinctive Gothic-Victorian Stone Lodge House dating back to the mid-1800’s, conveniently located on the Moortown, Chapel Allerton border. This is a distinctive three-bedroom detached house with a ground-floor shower room and first-floor WC. Modern UPVc double-glazed windows and modern gas ‘combi’ central heating. Accommodation includes a stable door to a stone porchway leading to the hallway, a fitted kitchen, a spacious lounge and a dining room. Three first-floor bedrooms and a landing with a WC. Outside is an enclosed lawned garden, a carved stone pillared gated entrance to a spacious forecourt for off-street parking and a garage. results.summary: A four-bedroom detached family home which occupies an enviable position within the heart of East Keswick and is offered to the market with NO ONWARD CHAIN! Offered to the market with no onward chain is this four-bedroom detached family home. The property is situated within a prime location in the centre of East Keswick. Now requiring general upgrading and modernisation, the property offers the potential purchaser the opportunity to incorporate their own requirements through a program of refurbishment. The property is approached via a private driveway. The formal entrance opens onto the inner hallway, providing access to all the ground floor accommodation. Comprising a through living room, a separate dining room, a breakfast kitchen, study and guest w.c. Stairs from the entrance hallway lead to the first floor landing which provides access to all the first-floor accommodation. There are four good size bedrooms – one of which offers an en-suite shower room which is accessed via the adjoining dressing room, and a house bathroom. The grounds of this home are well enclosed and provide an excellent degree of privacy. The driveway provides ample off-street parking for several vehicles and in turn leads to a double garage. The walled gardens to the rear of the property have been carefully planned for ease of maintenance, along with block paved patio areas that provide an ideal space for all the family to enjoy. Situated within the highly regarded village of East Keswick which is serviced by a good variety of local butchers, public houses, beauty salons and churches, East Keswick also enjoys a thriving community spirit. The immediate area is further well served by numerous sporting facilities including golf courses and swimming pool, sports clubs, shops and schools for all age groups, whilst providing easy access to Wetherby, Harrogate and Leeds, with the national motorway network also within easy reach. results.summary: A superb 2 bedroom end terraced home in a sought after Chapel Allerton location, on a generous plot with huge potential for extending to the side rear and attic (subject to planning permissions etc being obtained) Driveway, Garage and No Onward Chain – Viewing Advised. Situated in a highly sought-after location in the heart of vibrant Chapel Allerton, this superbly presented two-bedroom end-terraced home occupies a generous plot and offers ready-to-move-into accommodation with excellent potential to extend (subject to the necessary planning permissions and building regulations). The property is offered to the market with no onward chain and represents an outstanding opportunity for buyers seeking a home with both immediate comfort and future potential. Conveniently positioned just moments from Chapel Allerton’s renowned selection of independent shops, cafés, restaurants and bars, the property also benefits from excellent public transport links, providing swift and easy access into Leeds city centre. Tucked away towards the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, wrought iron double gates open onto a gravelled driveway providing off-road parking for at least three vehicles. The generous plot features lawned garden areas to both sides of the property and a pathway leading to the main entrance. A glazed wooden door opens into the entrance hallway, which includes a staircase rising to the first floor, an alarm control panel, and access to the lounge. The lounge is a bright and welcoming space, featuring a large double-glazed square bay window to the front that allows an abundance of natural light to fill the room. The space is finished with low-maintenance laminate flooring and a recessed fireplace providing a focal point, with a door leading through to the kitchen/diner. Located to the rear of the property, the kitchen/diner is another light-filled space, benefitting from double-glazed windows to both the side and rear, along with French doors from the dining area opening directly onto the rear garden. A glazed wooden door also provides access to the side entrance. The kitchen is fitted with a range of modern wall and base units with work surfaces over, incorporating a sink unit and a selection of integrated appliances including an oven, hob, extractor hood, fridge and washing machine. A combi boiler is neatly concealed within one of the units. The dining area offers ample space for dining furniture and continues the laminate flooring found throughout the kitchen/diner. A recessed fireplace adds character, while the French doors provide a pleasant connection to the garden. To the first floor, the landing benefits from a double-glazed window to the side and provides access to the loft space. Doors lead to two well-proportioned double bedrooms and the family bathroom. The main bedroom is located to the front and features a double-glazed window and plenty of space for bedroom furniture. Bedroom two, positioned to the rear, also offers ample room for furniture and enjoys pleasant views over the garden through a double-glazed window. The family bathroom is located at the rear and includes a double-glazed window, along with a suite comprising a bath with electric shower over, WC, and wash hand basin. Additional features include tiled walls, a mirrored cabinet, extractor fan, and heated towel rail. Externally, the property enjoys gardens to the front, side, and rear, offering exceptional potential to extend either to the side, rear, or into the loft space without compromising the generous plot (subject to permissions). A detached garage with an up-and-over door is situated towards the rear of the driveway, and a useful external storage cupboard is located at the side of the property. The rear garden features a decked seating area directly accessible from the kitchen/diner, ideal for outdoor dining and entertaining. The remainder of the garden is mainly laid to lawn with additional rockery and gravelled areas to the rear, all enclosed by wooden fencing and hedging to provide privacy. Offered for sale with no onward chain, this attractive home combines a fantastic location, generous outdoor space, and significant potential for future development, making it an excellent opportunity in one of North Leeds’ most desirable neighbourhoods. results.description: A superb 2 bedroom end terraced home in a sought after Chapel Allerton location, on a generous plot with huge potential for extending to the side rear and attic (subject to planning permissions etc being obtained) Driveway, Garage and No Onward Chain – Viewing Advised. Situated in a highly sought-after location in the heart of vibrant Chapel Allerton, this superbly presented two-bedroom end-terraced home occupies a generous plot and offers ready-to-move-into accommodation with excellent potential to extend (subject to the necessary planning permissions and building regulations). The property is offered to the market with no onward chain and represents an outstanding opportunity for buyers seeking a home with both immediate comfort and future potential. Conveniently positioned just moments from Chapel Allerton’s renowned selection of independent shops, cafés, restaurants and bars, the property also benefits from excellent public transport links, providing swift and easy access into Leeds city centre. Tucked away towards the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, wrought iron double gates open onto a gravelled driveway providing off-road parking for at least three vehicles. The generous plot features lawned garden areas to both sides of the property and a pathway leading to the main entrance. A glazed wooden door opens into the entrance hallway, which includes a staircase rising to the first floor, an alarm control panel, and access to the lounge. The lounge is a bright and welcoming space, featuring a large double-glazed square bay window to the front that allows an abundance of natural light to fill the room. The space is finished with low-maintenance laminate flooring and a recessed fireplace providing a focal point, with a door leading through to the kitchen/diner. Located to the rear of the property, the kitchen/diner is another light-filled space, benefitting from double-glazed windows to both the side and rear, along with French doors from the dining area opening directly onto the rear garden. A glazed wooden door also provides access to the side entrance. The kitchen is fitted with a range of modern wall and base units with work surfaces over, incorporating a sink unit and a selection of integrated appliances including an oven, hob, extractor hood, fridge and washing machine. A combi boiler is neatly concealed within one of the units. The dining area offers ample space for dining furniture and continues the laminate flooring found throughout the kitchen/diner. A recessed fireplace adds character, while the French doors provide a pleasant connection to the garden. To the first floor, the landing benefits from a double-glazed window to the side and provides access to the loft space. Doors lead to two well-proportioned double bedrooms and the family bathroom. The main bedroom is located to the front and features a double-glazed window and plenty of space for bedroom furniture. Bedroom two, positioned to the rear, also offers ample room for furniture and enjoys pleasant views over the garden through a double-glazed window. The family bathroom is located at the rear and includes a double-glazed window, along with a suite comprising a bath with electric shower over, WC, and wash hand basin. Additional features include tiled walls, a mirrored cabinet, extractor fan, and heated towel rail. Externally, the property enjoys gardens to the front, side, and rear, offering exceptional potential to extend either to the side, rear, or into the loft space without compromising the generous plot (subject to permissions). A detached garage with an up-and-over door is situated towards the rear of the driveway, and a useful external storage cupboard is located at the side of the property. The rear garden features a decked seating area directly accessible from the kitchen/diner, ideal for outdoor dining and entertaining. The remainder of the garden is mainly laid to lawn with additional rockery and gravelled areas to the rear, all enclosed by wooden fencing and hedging to provide privacy. Offered for sale with no onward chain, this attractive home combines a fantastic location, generous outdoor space, and significant potential for future development, making it an excellent opportunity in one of North Leeds’ most desirable neighbourhoods. results.summary: This delightful two-bedroom detached Victorian property offers a perfect blend of classic charm and modern convenience, making it an ideal choice for professionals commuting to Leeds and Bradford City Centres. Situated near the serene green spaces of Bramley Fall Woods, Rodley Nature Reserve, and Stanningley and Bramley Parks, the location provides a harmonious balance between urban accessibility and natural tranquility. The property showcases quintessential Victorian design elements, including high ceilings, large sash windows, and ornate detailing, which contribute to its spacious and airy ambiance. The ground floor features original timber flooring, adding character and warmth to the living spaces. These floors have been well-maintained, preserving their historical charm while offering durability. Both the front and rear gardens are enclosed, providing privacy and a safe environment for outdoor activities. The rear garden, in particular, offers a secluded retreat with ample space for relaxation or gardening. The property comprises an entrance hall, a cozy lounge with feature fireplace, a versatile workroom/office/playroom, and a kitchen diner, all designed to accommodate modern living needs. Convenient features include a downstairs WC and a utility room, enhancing functionality and convenience. The addition of a conservatory further extends the living space, creating a bright and airy area to enjoy the surrounding views. Upstairs, two double bedrooms provide comfortable accommodation, complemented by a house bathroom featuring a three-piece suite. With the benefit of gas-fired central heating and PVC double glazing, the property ensures warmth and energy efficiency throughout. Externally, the south-facing gardens to the front and rear offer a sunny aspect, ideal for outdoor entertaining or simply enjoying the sunshine. This property seamlessly combines the timeless appeal of Victorian architecture with the practicalities required for contemporary living. Its proximity to local amenities, transport links, and green spaces makes it a desirable choice for those seeking a blend of urban and rural lifestyles. results.summary: The Tivoli - A home that has space for everyone. 1767 sq ft, large open plan kitchen/diner overlooking private garden, snug/home office, spacious bedrooms, two ensuites and a family bathroom. Key features Large farmhouse style kitchen Utility room Snug or home office Spacious bedrooms 2 ensuites Family bathroom Downstairs wc Private off-road parking outside home Garage The Tivoli is a classic townhouse, designed with large windows throughout to maximise the natural light, and create a feeling of space and calm. At the heart of its spacious farmhouse style kitchen there is room for a table big enough for the whole family to enjoy time together, and its French doors open out to the private garden, making alfresco lunching easy and providing a safe spot for the kids to play whilst you cook, work or relax. Upstairs, the lounge is a bright and airy space, where you can offer a warm welcome to friends or draw the curtains for cosy nights in. The master bedroom on this floor has its own ensuite and overlooks the garden. The second floor also has a guest bedroom with ensuite which offers a light filled place to prepare for the day ahead and a restful spot to wind down at night. results.summary: The Property Set within an enviable residential setting and occupying a substantial corner position, this impressive four-bedroom detached home offers beautifully proportioned accommodation designed for modern family living. Combining elegant reception spaces with a thoughtfully designed layout and private landscaped gardens, the property presents an outstanding opportunity to acquire a distinguished family home in a highly desirable location. The accommodation is introduced via a welcoming entrance hall that provides access to the principal living spaces. The dual-aspect sitting room is particularly impressive, flooded with natural light and offering a refined yet comfortable space ideal for both relaxation and entertaining. A separate formal dining room, currently used as an office is perfect for hosting family gatherings, while the contemporary dining kitchen forms the true heart of the home. Thoughtfully designed with an extensive range of wall and base units and generous preparation surfaces, the kitchen offers both functionality and style, with ample space for everyday family dining. The principal bedroom enjoys the added luxury of a modern en-suite shower room, creating a peaceful private retreat. There are two further well-proportioned double bedrooms and a spacious single bedroom, all served by a well-appointed family bathroom. Externally, the property continues to impress. The home sits within a generous corner plot, offering a sense of space and privacy rarely found. The beautifully private rear garden is predominantly laid to lawn and framed by mature trees and established shrubs, creating a tranquil outdoor environment. A substantial timber pergola provides an attractive focal point and an ideal setting for outdoor seating, al fresco dining, and summer entertaining. Further enhancing the appeal of the property is a large double garage together with off-road parking for two vehicles, ensuring both convenience and practicality for modern day family living. results.summary: Situated on the ever-popular Park Road in the heart of Guiseley, this generously proportioned four-bedroom mid-terrace offers a rare opportunity to secure a home with both space and potential. We believe this this home would make the ideal purchase for the growing family and an internal viewing is highly reccommended to appreciate the size of accommodation that is on offer. The ground floor briefly comprises a welcoming entrance hallway, a lounge, a spacious kitchen diner perfect for family meals and entertaining, and a bright conservatory that floods the home with natural light. One of the standout features of this property is the stunning, fully converted basement, accessed internally and via its own private entrance. This stylish self-contained space offers a contemporary open-plan kitchen diner with high-end integrated appliances, a cosy lounge area complete with built-in bed, storage cupboards and drawers, and patio doors that open onto a private seating area. A sleek shower room completes this floor, making it an ideal granny annex or guest suite. To the first floor, you’ll find two generously sized double bedrooms and a well-appointed house bathroom. The second floor offers two further double bedrooms and a separate W.C., making it perfect for larger families or those needing extra home office or guest space. Externally, the front of the property boasts charming patio seating areas—perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation—while to the rear there is off-street parking for two vehicles, a rare and valuable asset in such a central location. Situated just moments from Guiseley’s local amenities, excellent schools and train station, this unique and versatile home must be viewed to fully appreciate the space and lifestyle on offer. Guiseley has a wealth of local amenities which include highly regarded schools for all ages, an abundance of small shops, retail parks offering Marks and Spencer Food Hall, Next, and Argos, amongst others. An assortment of restaurants for varying tastes, wine bars, Nuffield Leisure complex, Aireborough Sports Centre and other recreational facilities. For the commuter there is a bus service, Guiseley railway station which offers links to Leeds and Bradford and the A65 and the Harrogate Road (A658). The Leeds & Bradford Airport is approx. 10 minute drive away.
