results.summary: INTRODUCTION *Reference: Nicola Ramsden* Welcome to 40 Hammerton Street - a distinctive 19th-century stone-built cottage that forms part of Pudsey’s rich architectural heritage. Occupying a tucked-away side position within a quiet cul-de-sac, the home enjoys a pleasant outlook and an enviable location just moments from the heart of Pudsey town centre. Beautifully renovated and thoughtfully enhanced by the current owner, the property has undergone a comprehensive programme of refurbishment, blending historic character with modern design and high-quality finishes. The result is a home of genuine warmth, personality and style that presents a rare opportunity for first-time buyers, professionals or those seeking a unique and characterful property. DESCRIPTION The property is entered via a charming entrance porch with tiled flooring and a recently replaced roof, providing a practical and welcoming introduction to the home before leading into the main living space. The heart of the property is the bright and spacious open-plan kitchen and living area, beautifully enhanced by dual aspect double-glazed windows to the front and side elevations. Two striking arched windows fitted with Hillarys wooden shutter blinds create a distinctive architectural feature and allow natural light to fill the room. The living space has been thoughtfully restored to celebrate the home’s heritage, with plaster carefully removed to reveal the original brickwork, which has been repointed using traditional lime mortar and finished in a soft off-white tone. A recessed fireplace houses a HETAS registered panoramic log burner, installed two years ago, creating a cosy focal point and adding warmth and character to the room. New wooden flooring and traditional cast iron radiators further complement the property’s period charm. The recently installed kitchen (approximately six months old) has been designed with both style and practicality in mind. A range of contemporary sage green base units is complemented by wood-effect worktops and glossy metro tiling in mixed white and subtle grey tones, creating a fresh and light-reflecting backdrop. Integrated appliances include a built-in electric oven, gas hob and under-counter fridge, along with a stainless steel sink with mixer tap and plumbing for a washing machine. A full-height cupboard neatly houses the boiler, maintaining the kitchen’s clean and uncluttered appearance. There is also space for a small dining table, perfect for morning coffee, casual meals or hosting friends. From the kitchen area, steps lead down to a useful cellar with light and power, where a newly installed ventilation system has been added. The space is currently used for additional storage and houses a tumble dryer. Upstairs, the property continues to impress with a generously sized double bedroom, bright and welcoming thanks to two elegant arched windows with wooden shutter blinds which frame the pleasant outlook to the front. The room offers ample space for bedroom furniture and is finished with carpeting and ceiling spotlights, creating a calm and restful retreat. Leading directly from the bedroom is a luxuriously appointed en-suite shower room, newly installed within the last six months. The suite features a rainfall shower with double base, enclosed by a striking black grid Crittall-style reinforced glass screen, alongside a stylish wash basin with vanity unit and w/c, creating a boutique-style space. Complemented by quality wall tiling, tiled flooring, ceiling spotlights, an extractor fan and fitted shelving providing elegance and practicality. The property also benefits from double glazing and gas central heating throughout. The current owner has also carried out several practical improvements, including a new roof installed in 2023 and additional loft insulation added approximately two years ago, further enhancing the comfort and efficiency of the property. One of the home’s greatest attractions is its setting. Pudsey town centre is just a short stroll away, offering independent cafés, shops, restaurants and everyday amenities, while excellent transport links provide easy access to Leeds and the surrounding areas. A home that feels quietly tucked away yet wonderfully connected. Blending historic character, thoughtful renovation and an enviable location, this charming cottage offers a rare opportunity to own a beautifully individual home that feels effortlessly stylish and truly special from the moment you step inside. OUTSIDE Externally, the property benefits from a desirable west-facing aspect, perfect for enjoying afternoon and evening sunshine. The outdoor space currently provides a blank canvas, offering exciting potential for the next owner to create their own outdoor retreat. With some existing paving, high fencing for privacy and a gate providing access to the front of the property, the garden is ready to be styled to suit individual tastes. There is also on-street parking available, with a residents’ parking permit in place. LOCATION Situated in a prime location within walking distance of Pudsey Town Centre, an historic market town boasting a vast range of eateries, bars, weekly market, local shops, boutiques, cafe’s, gyms, swimming pool and larger shopping complexes including Owlcoates Shopping Centre as well as walks in the local countryside. Pudsey Park is centrally located with a children's playground and fabulous gardens. Healthcare is equally well catered for, with a doctors surgery, dentists, pharmacy and opticians all close by. The property offers excellent transport links to the Ring Road giving easy access to Leeds City Centre and surrounding areas. There is also a central Bus station nearby and Bramley/Pudsey train station are both within easy reach. Leeds-Bradford Airport is just a short drive away. ACCOMMODATION - GROUND FLOOR Entrance Porch A welcoming entrance porch with tiled flooring and recently replaced roof, providing a practical space for coats and shoes. Open Plan Kitchen / Living Room 15'9" x 15'2" (4.81m x 4.63m) The living space showcases beautifully restored exposed brickwork, re-pointed using traditional lime mortar, creating a striking character feature. A recessed fireplace houses a HETAS registered panoramic log burner, installed two years ago. Finished with new wooden flooring and two traditional cast iron radiators. dual aspect double-glazed windows to the front and side elevations along with two distinctive arched windows fitted with Hillarys wooden shutter blinds. The contemporary kitchen (approx six months old) comprises a range of sage green base units complemented by wood-effect worktops and glossy metro tiling in mixed white and subtle grey tones. Integrated appliances include a built-in electric oven, gas hob and under-counter fridge, along with a stainless steel sink with mixer tap and plumbing for a washing machine. A full-height cupboard houses the combi-boiler. Cellar 11'10" x 5'3" (3.60m x 1.60m) A useful cellar space with light and power, currently used for storage and housing a tumble dryer. A newly installed ventilation system has been fitted. FIRST FLOOR Double Bedroom 15'9" x 12'3" (4.80m x 3.73m) A generously sized double bedroom featuring two attractive arched windows with wooden shutter blinds, providing plenty of natural light and a pleasant outlook. The room offers ample space for bedroom furniture and is finished with carpeting and ceiling spotlights. Radiator. En-suite Shower Room 7'5" x 6'0" (2.27m x 1.82m) A luxury en-suite shower room comprising a rainfall shower with double base, enclosed by a striking black grid Crittall-style reinforced glass screen. Also featuring a wash basin with vanity unit, low level w/c, chrome tower radiator, tiled flooring, ceiling spotlights, extractor fan and fitted shelving for additional storage. results.summary: CHAIN FREE Set within a peaceful cul-de-sac in the highly desirable area of Rawdon, this two-bedroom semi-detached bungalow presents a rare and exciting opportunity for full modernisation. Offered with no onward chain and positioned on a generous plot with gardens to the front and rear, ample driveway parking and a detached garage, the property is perfect for buyers seeking a renovation project with excellent potential. Ideally located for access to Rawdon village, Horsforth, Yeadon and superb transport links, this is an exceptional chance to create a bespoke home in LS19. LOCATION Rawdon is a much sought after, extremely pleasant residential Village, conveniently situated just off New Road Side (A65). Commuting is straight forward; both the A65 and the Ring Road (A6120) are on hand providing major links to the motorway networks and the centres of Leeds and Bradford. There is a choice of two train stations at Horsforth or Apperley Bridge being just a few minutes’ drive away and offering services to Leeds, York and Harrogate. For the more travelled commuter, Leeds & Bradford Airport is also close by. There are many facilities on offer in the 'village' including local shops, a tearoom, public house and take-away, along with excellent local schools as well as the renowned private schools of Woodhouse Grove and Bronte House. This area is perfect for purchasers wanting to live in a popular situation with every convenience close by. Rawdon Billing a popular landmark is within a short walk and here you will find a lake and beautiful scenery with lots of space to enjoy a good walk with views of Rawdon from the top. Micklefield Park and Rawdon Golf and Lawn Tennis Club are both a short walk away. Close to hand are also the villages of Yeadon, Horsforth and Guiseley. GROUND FLOOR The property opens into a central entrance hallway, providing access to all rooms and offering a blank canvas for new décor, flooring and storage upgrades. The spacious lounge/diner enjoys a large front-facing window that fills the room with natural light. With its gas fireplace, classic surround and retro wall panelling, this generous reception space holds superb potential to be reimagined as a contemporary open-plan living area. The kitchen is ready for complete modernisation and currently features laminate worktops, freestanding appliances and housing for the boiler. This well-proportioned space offers great scope for designing a stylish dining kitchen tailored to modern needs. Both bedrooms are comfortable double rooms overlooking pleasant aspects. Bedroom One includes built-in wardrobes and garden views, while Bedroom Two provides excellent versatility as a guest room, home office or second double bedroom. The bathroom comprises a traditional brown suite with bath and overhead shower, WC and wash basin—an ideal area to redesign into a sleek, modern bathroom. OUTSIDE The property enjoys a lawned front garden with established shrubs and a driveway accommodating two to three vehicles, leading to a detached garage. The rear garden is a private and generous outdoor space featuring a lawn, patio, hedges and mature planting—offering superb potential for landscaping, entertaining or relaxation. results.summary: Enjoying a private large corner southerly facing garden, an attractively presented three bedroom semi-detached house in a popular residential area. An excellent opportunity to acquire a well-presented semi-detached home which enjoys a sought-after cul-de-sac type location featuring an enclosed private good sized corner garden, in one of North Leeds most sought-after residential areas. The front entrance hall has a guest cloaks/WC and leads to the rear south facing full width lounge having a stone feature fireplace with a coal effect gas fire. Offering dining space, this room has a sliding patio window opening to the private block paved patio and lovely garden. The kitchen has fitted wall and base units, integral oven/hob and plumbing for both dishwasher and washing machines. There are three reasonable sized bedrooms on the first floor, two with built-in wardrobes and the local landmark Almscliffe Crag can be seen from the front bedroom window. The house bathroom with a white four-piece suite, tiled walls and floor has a step-in shower as well as a bath. There is drop down ladder access to the boarded loft. The accommodation with some exposed internal stone features has a gas-fired heating system and the windows are UPVC sealed double glazed. It is important to appreciate the size and layout of the corner garden which as well as proving ample off-street parking could offer extension potential subject to necessary local authority consents being obtained. Compulsory Anti Money Laundering (AML) checks must be carried out on all potential buyers once an offer has been agreed on a property, as per HMRC requirements. The cost payable by the buyer(s) is £20 (inc VAT) per individual check. These checks are carried out via Thirdfort Group. We are also required to obtain identification and proof of funding from all prospective buyers. Please note that the property will not be marked as Sold STC until these checks have been completed. Adel is considered a very sought-after residential area in North Leeds, close to the Outer Ring Road, approximately 5 miles from the city centre and yet only minutes driving distance from spectacular Yorkshire countryside. Local amenities include a variety of shops including a co-op and Asda Supermarket, restaurants, schools for all age groups, Doctors, Dentists, leisure facilities including Cookridge Hall Gym and Health Spa with its state-of-the-art fitness centre and golf course with 18 holes. Adel is home to Headingley Golf Club, the oldest in Leeds. The Outer Ring Road provides access to Leeds, Bradford, York, Harrogate and the national motorway network (M1/A1/M62) providing access to areas further afield by road. Adel has good vehicular access to the cosmopolitan amenities of Cookridge and Horsforth, which has a railway station approx. 2 miles away with regular links to Leeds, Harrogate, York and beyond. The Leeds Bradford International Airport at Yeadon is only approximately 10 minutes away by car. Other recreational facilities nearby include 130 acres of gardens and woodland at Golden Acre Park, Otley Chevin Park and the Yorkshire Dales beyond. Eccup reservoir is also popular with walkers. Leeds–5 miles, Bradford–10 miles, Harrogate–14 miles, Motorways-11 miles (Approx.). results.summary: This impressive family home offers a wonderful blend of contemporary style and high-quality fixtures throughout, with well-proportioned accommodation arranged over three floors, in addition to a spacious cellar currently used as a utility room and excellent storage space. Ideally positioned for those seeking village living while remaining close to local amenities, the property is within easy reach of Shadwell Primary School, the village Post Office and pub, as well as the range of shops and services on Slaid Hill. Leeds City Centre lies just six miles away and provides an extensive selection of shops, restaurants, bars and leisure facilities. The property briefly comprises a warm and welcoming entrance hallway. To the right is a bright sitting room, filled with natural light from a large window overlooking the private front garden. The room features solid wood flooring and a charming feature fireplace. To the rear of the property is the kitchen/diner, fitted with shaker-style units, integrated appliances and feature cast iron baking stove. There is ample space for a four-seater dining table, with direct access to the rear courtyard garden. A staircase from the kitchen leads to the lower ground floor/ cellar, currently used as a utility room and storage space. Subject to the necessary planning permissions, there is excellent potential to convert this area into additional living accommodation. On the first floor, the spacious landing leads to a beautifully fitted house bathroom featuring stylish tiling, twin sinks, a walk-in shower and a separate bath. The impressive master bedroom spans the full width of the property, enjoys views over the front garden and benefits from its own en-suite shower room. The second floor offers a generous landing area that could also serve as a home office or reading space, filled with natural light, along with two further double bedrooms. To the front of the property is a gated garden with a pathway leading to the entrance. The garden is mainly laid to lawn with enclosed fencing, well-stocked borders and mature hedging, providing excellent privacy and attractive kerb appeal. The west-facing aspect makes it an ideal place to enjoy morning sunshine. To the rear is a private and fully enclosed courtyard garden, enjoying uninterrupted afternoon sun until late evening. This peaceful space provides an ideal setting for outdoor entertaining and relaxing with family and friends. The property is situated at the boundary between Shadwell village and Alwoodley near to Slaid hill parade which is only some 6 miles from Leeds city centre. Despite the peaceful location the property is ideally placed for access to other Yorkshire commercial centres including Harrogate and York together with excellent road access to the region and motorway infrastructure. The area is well served with good shopping and sporting facilities together with most denominations of schools including the renowned Grammar School at Leeds some 2 miles away. Services We are advised that the property has gas central heating, mains water and mains drainage. results.summary: A stunning concept home, enjoying superb contemporary design and extensive inside / outside reception areas making the most of views over the large rear garden, but also keeping the stone and character of the original cottage to the front. This home must be viewed, to fully appreciate such a unique property in the heart of Menston. Ground floor: entrance hall; lounge / snug; sun terrace; bedroom two; bedroom three; bathroom. Lower ground floor: living dining kitchen; cinema room; utility room; shower room. First floor: master bedroom; dressing room; en-suite. Outside: generous garden with stream, mature trees and original stone wall; floating staircase to resin driveway. We are delighted to introduce you to this exciting new instruction, a hidden gem in the very heart of Menston. 75 Cleasby Road is a superb, recently constructed concept home designed for modern family living. This stunning property seamlessly fuses an elegant interior with bespoke contemporary outside space ideal for entertaining, hidden behind a characterful stone cottage frontage. The vendors have designed the property with meticulous attention to detail and to the highest specification to include underfloor heating on all levels, polished porcelain flooring to the ground floor, bespoke concept German kitchen by Intoto, Porcelanosa bathrooms, and wiring for a Sonos sound system throughout. The property welcomes you into a light and airy entrance hall which has wood effect ceramic tiling to the floor and a view straight out towards the rear garden. The open lounge has stunning views, with windows and doors opening to an extensive sun terrace. This lovely contemporary space is over 30 feet wide, with glass balustrade and screening, porcelain tiled flooring and elaborate lighting. Also on this floor are two double bedrooms and the luxury house bathroom. From the lounge, a glass and oak floating cantilever staircase leads down to the lower ground floor and the incredible open plan living dining kitchen. The living area has oversized triple sliding anthracite patio doors which open onto the rear garden. The focal point of this area is the floating gas fire by ‘Element Four’. Turning to the kitchen, a most impressive space, there is a vast range of contemporary high gloss white wall, base and drawer units providing superb storage. Integrated appliances include three ovens, one of which is a combination microwave, as well as a warming tray, dishwasher, larder fridge and larder freezer. Over the double stainless steel sink is a Quooker instant hot water tap. A large central island unit houses the ceramic hob with an extractor over and provides further storage as well as seating room under. A wonderful feature on this floor are the two ‘secret’ rooms concealed behind the kitchen doors. Double doors lead through to the utility room which in turn leads to the luxury downstairs shower room with wc, vanity unit and double shower enclosure. results.summary: An immaculately presented and extended three-bedroom semi-detached family home located in the highly sought-after suburb of Alwoodley. Ideally positioned close to local shops, well-regarded schools, excellent transport links and the open spaces of Roundhay Park. The property has been modernised to a high standard and offers stylish, ready-to-move-into accommodation with a superb open-plan kitchen/breakfast room and sun room. Externally, there is off-road parking and a beautifully arranged garden with multiple seating areas and a versatile summer house. An immaculately presented and extended three-bedroom semi-detached family home, situated in the highly sought-after suburb of Alwoodley, North Leeds. The property enjoys a convenient location close to a range of local shops, highly regarded schools and everyday amenities. Regular bus services provide excellent access into Leeds city centre, while the nearby ring roads allow easy travel to destinations further afield. The popular districts of Roundhay, Moortown and Meanwood are also within easy reach, as is Roundhay Park, offering beautiful lakes, cafés and scenic walking routes. The property has been modernised and upgraded to an excellent standard throughout, offering stylish, ready-to-move-into accommodation that is ideal for modern family living. A composite entrance door with glazed panels and side windows opens into a welcoming entrance hallway, featuring laminate flooring for practicality, a designer radiator and a staircase leading to the first floor. Doors provide access to the shower room and lounge. The ground floor shower room is superbly presented and includes a double-glazed window to the side, a step-in shower cubicle with rainfall shower, WC and wash hand basin set within a vanity unit. The room is finished with tiled walls and flooring, a heated towel radiator and an extractor fan. The lounge is a comfortable and inviting reception room with a double-glazed bay window to the front, allowing plenty of natural light. A recessed fireplace with a feature log burner set on a tiled hearth creates a focal point, while laminate flooring and a designer radiator complete the space. A door leads through to the kitchen/breakfast room. The extended kitchen/breakfast room forms the true heart of the home and provides a fantastic space for both everyday family living and entertaining. It features double-glazed windows to the side and rear, a uPVC double-glazed door to the side, and an opening into the adjoining sun room. The kitchen is fitted with an extensive range of modern wall and base units with coordinating work surfaces over. results.summary: This attractive part stone-built home has been thoughtfully and significantly extended over the years and, in our opinion, offers an excellent opportunity for a growing family seeking both character and convenience. Retaining a wealth of original features, including stained glass windows, stripped wooden floorboards, decorative covings and cornices, the property blends period charm with versatile modern living space. Ideally positioned within a short walk of Guiseley train station, the property is perfectly placed for commuters requiring easy access to Leeds city centre or Ilkley. Further transport links are readily available, with Leeds Bradford Airport and Bradford city centre both within close proximity, making this a superb location for a range of buyers. The accommodation briefly comprises a welcoming entrance hall featuring a striking stained glass window, setting the tone for the rest of the home. There is a comfortable lounge, ideal for relaxing, along with a spacious dining kitchen which provides an excellent hub for family life and entertaining. To the first floor are two generous double bedrooms, both well presented, alongside a stylish four-piece house bathroom. The original third bedroom has been reconfigured to allow access to the second floor, where the impressive third bedroom now occupies the roof space. This room is a further double and offers a pleasant sense of privacy, making it ideal as a principal bedroom, guest room or home office. Externally, the property benefits from gardens to both the front and rear, providing pleasant outdoor space for a variety of uses. There is also off-street parking to the side, complemented by the addition of an electric vehicle charging point. Further features include gas central heating and double glazing throughout. This part stone built property which has been significantly extended over the years in our opinion would be well suited to a growing family. results.summary: Located in the extremely sought after area of Horsforth, within walking distance of the Forge train station is this most impressive two bedroom upper floor apartment, forming part of the stunning Horsforth Mill development. Steeped in local history and enjoying secured gated living, a viewing is an absolute must of this lovely home to fully appreciate the size and quality of accommodation. This particular apartment enjoys one of the best positions, backing on to woodland with lift access and no chain. The property which has double glazing and electric heating, is accessed into the entrance hallway with video intercom, useful storage and engineered wooden flooring. The open plan lounge is a fabulous space of excellent proportions, neutrally decorated with woodland backdrop, ceiling inset spotlighting and a double glazed door leading out to the balcony. The open plan dining kitchen has an attractive range of base & wall storage units, integrated dishwasher, built in AEG microwave, oven & hob, integrated fridge/freezer, ample dining space and a utility cupboard with plumbing for a washing machine. The master bedroom is a generous double room with a woodland outlook and ceiling inset spotlighting. The ensuite shower room has a modern three piece suite with separate shower cubicle, chrome heated towel rail, vanity mirror with inset lighting, shaver point and ceramic tiling. There is one further bedroom. The house shower room has a three piece suite with shower cubicle, attractive tiling, shaver point, vanity mirror and lighting. The development is accessed via coded security gates with a video/fob entry system, well-lit communal areas with movement sensors, allocated parking, ample visitor spaces and secure bike shed. There is also storage available under the mill, available for an extra fee on application. Horsforth Mill backs on to quiet woodland and is within easy reach of a wide range of excellent amenities including the Leeds outer Ring Road, two train stations, Leeds/Bradford airport, the extensive shopping facilities on New Road Side, a great bus service, local bars and restaurants. results.summary: Situated in a peaceful and well-established residential development, this well-proportioned two-bedroom apartment offers comfortable living space and excellent access to Wetherby town centre and local amenities. The property briefly comprises an entrance hallway leading to a spacious and light filled living room, featuring a large window that overlooks the surrounding development and provides plenty of natural light. The separate kitchen is fitted with a range of wall and base units, offering practical workspace and room for appliances. There are two well-sized bedrooms, both enjoying pleasant outlooks and good natural light. The principal bedroom benefits from extensive built-in wardrobes, providing generous storage. The second bedroom offers flexibility and could equally serve as a guest room, home office or dressing room. The apartment also includes a house bathroom fitted with a three-piece suite comprising a bath with shower over, wash basin and WC. Externally, the property sits within attractive communal grounds with well-maintained lawns, mature trees and hedging, creating a quiet and leafy setting. Residents benefit from the convenience of nearby parking and easy access to local road links. North Grove Court occupies a pleasant and established position in a quiet residential setting on the edge of Wetherby, a highly regarded and historic market town in West Yorkshire. Known for its charming character and strong sense of community, Wetherby offers an excellent range of amenities including independent shops, cafés, restaurants, supermarkets and popular weekly markets. The town centre is within easy reach of the property and provides a vibrant yet relaxed atmosphere, with attractive riverside walks along the River Wharfe and green open spaces such as The Ings and Wetherby Racecourse nearby. The area is also well known for its excellent leisure facilities including golf courses, gyms and scenic countryside walks. Wetherby is particularly popular with commuters thanks to its excellent transport links. The nearby A1(M) provides convenient access to Leeds, Harrogate, York and further afield, making it an ideal location for those seeking a balance between town and countryside living. Leeds city centre and Leeds Bradford Airport are both easily accessible by car. results.summary: A beautifully presented three-bedroom terraced home arranged over three floors, offering stylish, versatile living space in the popular Bramley area. Recently refreshed and ready to move into, the property combines modern interiors with charming character features, including a bright lounge with feature fireplace, a contemporary dove grey kitchen with oak laminate flooring, and well-proportioned bedrooms filled with natural light. The home also benefits from a useful cellar, a modern family bathroom with white ceramic tiling, and a private courtyard garden, perfect for outdoor seating or practical use. With excellent transport links and easy access to Leeds City Centre, this property is ideal for first-time buyers, professionals, or investors. LOCATION A fast changing suburb with a great community spirit. Conveniently placed for the Ring Road (A6120), with good bus services to Leeds/Bradford and a local train station getting you into Leeds in ten minutes. Bramley Shopping Centre forms the hub and offers a good selection of shops/amenities, Bank, Post office, Costa Coffee etc. Green spaces include Bramley park & Bramley Fall park, (from where it is only a short walk to the Leeds-Liverpool canal), where you can explore lovely scenic pathways. The privately run Bramley baths has been in-situ since 1904, swimming and fitness classes can be enjoyed here. Local supermarkets include Aldi & Tesco, whilst Morrisons & Lidl are super close in nearby Stanningley, where there is also a Home Bargains store. A short car journey away you will find the popular Owlcotes Centre at Pudsey offering a Marks & Spencer, a Walmart/Asda superstore & B & M, with New Pudsey train station adjacent. Rodley is close, with a further selection of amenities and of course the Millennium Trail, a popular local beauty spot. A short distance away in Kirkstall you will find a leisure centre, Kirkstall Bridge retail park which boasts a gym and an array of shops, with a further shopping centre across the road with a Morrisons supermarket, Boots, Matalan etc. GROUND FLOOR The property opens into a welcoming and spacious lounge, a bright reception room centred around an attractive feature fireplace which creates a cosy focal point. Large windows allow plenty of natural light to fill the room, while oak laminate flooring and modern décor add a contemporary feel. To the rear sits the fitted kitchen, finished in a stylish dove grey with a practical layout that includes a range of base and wall units, generous worktop space, a sink with drainer, and an integrated oven with hob. The kitchen also provides access down to a useful cellar, ideal for additional storage. FIRST FLOOR The first floor hosts Bedroom One, a generous double bedroom with fitted wardrobes providing excellent storage. The room is well presented with modern décor and enjoys plenty of natural light, creating a bright and comfortable space. results.summary: This beautifully presented two-bedroom terraced house seamlessly blends classic period charm with contemporary finishes, offering an ideal home for modern living or serving as a profitable rental property. The property features a spacious open-plan reception area, highlighted by a welcoming fireplace, stylish solid wooden flooring, and built-in shelving for both function and aesthetic appeal. The heart of the home is the modern kitchen, which boasts sleek grey cabinetry, a chic mosaic tile backsplash, integrated appliances, and a practical kitchen island with seating - perfect for casual dining or entertaining guests. Large windows and a glass door invite abundant natural light, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere throughout. Two cosy bedrooms offer ample space for relaxation, each benefiting from generous storage solutions, neutral decor, and large windows that enhance the airy feel of the home. The property also includes a contemporary bathroom, featuring modern fixtures, built-in shelving, and natural light for a refreshing environment. A carpeted staircase with modern artwork provides a welcoming transition between floors, further adding to the home’s character. Additional features enhance the property’s appeal and practicality. The versatile layout includes a dedicated home office setup with ample desk space and decorative lighting, ideal for remote work or study. This home personifies modern decor and abundant storage. Outside, a charming, low-maintenance front garden with wooden fencing, planters, and vibrant hanging flower baskets creates immediate kerb appeal, while double glazed windows ensure comfort and energy efficiency. There is a block built, rendered storage unit at the front of the house which is very handy storage space that any family home needs. Period features such as the traditional brick facade and bay window complement convenient on-street parking directly outside the property, providing accessibility for residents and guests (residents permit parking). This exceptional home combines thoughtful design, flexible living spaces, and stylish finishes, making it an outstanding choice for a range of buyers seeking comfort, practicality, and charm in a terraced house. From an investment point of view, we would suggest a comfortably achievable £1000pcm rent which at our asking price would be an impressive 8.5% rental yield annually. Better figures are hard to achieve with nothing needing doing to the house day 1! results.summary: An extremely rare opportunity to acquire this substantial period home which is set within beautifully maintained gardens. A remarkable and truly individual five-bedroom period home which is conveniently located within the highly regarded village of Collingham. Occupying an enviable position, this marvellous home boasts far-reaching views over the village and countryside beyond. This wonderful home retains many of the building’s original features. On approaching the property, the discerning purchaser is greeted via an entrance hallway which provides access to all the ground floor accommodation and the cellar. The formal bay-fronted dining room displays a traditional fireplace and provides an ideal area for formal gatherings. Progressing further into the property, this lovely home begins to provide a glimpse of the space on offer. The bright and airy living room features an open fire and adjoins the separate sturdy, whilst offering an open aspect across the private rear garden. Stairs from the entrance hallway lead to the lower ground floor which offers a modern breakfast kitchen with patio doors leading to the rear garden, whilst offering access to the separate family room. Further lower ground accommodation includes a guest w.c. and separate laundry room. Returning to the entrance hallway, stairs from the entrance hallway lead to the first-floor landing which provides access to all the first-floor accommodation. There are three good-sized bedrooms to the first floor and a recently appoint and most stylish house bathroom. A further flight of stairs leads to the second floor which provides two further well-proportioned bedrooms, alongside useful eaves storage. Set amid well-tended and mature private gardens, the property is approached via a shared driveway which leads to a detached garage which when combined, provide off-street parking facilities for several vehicles. The gardens of this charming home lie predominately to the rear of the property and have been carefully planned and landscaped, ensuring a good degree of privacy is enjoyed. A stone terrace which is accessed via the breakfast kitchen, relishes a sunny south facing aspect, providing an ideal space for al fresco dining. A Rare Country Estate with Panoramic Views – Over 7,000 sq ft on 10 Acres Tucked away in the exclusive Cragg Wood conservation area of Rawdon, Brenaire Park stands as one of West Yorkshire’s most distinguished private residences. Originally constructed in the 1930s, this remarkable home occupies an expansive 10-acre estate of mature gardens, grassland, and established woodland, offering an unrivaled sense of privacy and tranquillity. Perched in an elevated position, the property enjoys uninterrupted southerly views across the surrounding countryside, creating a rare combination of natural beauty and refined seclusion. Rawdon, a highly sought-after leafy suburb of Leeds, offers excellent local amenities, well-regarded schools, and convenient transport connections. Apperley Bridge train station lies less than two miles away, and Leeds Bradford International Airport is less than five miles from the property, yet due to its position off the flight path, Brenaire Park remains blissfully unaffected by aircraft noise. A truly unique opportunity to acquire a substantial family home in one of Yorkshire’s most desirable addresses. Extending to over 7,000 sq ft and offered with no onward chain, this grand family home is approached via a sweeping private driveway and offers superb proportions throughout. The elegantly arranged accommodation spans three floors and includes: • A magnificent galleried entrance hall • Three large south-facing reception rooms • A formal drawing room, study/playroom and family dining kitchen • An additional cinema/games room with separate staircase • Seven bedrooms across the first and second floors, including a luxurious principal suite with dressing room and en suite • Multiple en suite and family bathrooms with modern finishes Approached via a long, sweeping driveway framed by dual gated entrances, this distinguished residence exudes grandeur from the moment of arrival. Ample space for multiple vehicles is complemented by a setting of exceptional privacy and elegance. The manicured grounds are a true horticultural showcase—lush with mature trees, sculpted shrubs, and seasonal blooms that bring vibrant colour and texture throughout the year. Beyond the formal gardens, gently rolling pastures offer a pastoral charm where animals graze peacefully, enhancing the tranquil, estate-like atmosphere. Set within an exclusive enclave, the property enjoys a privileged position on Woodlands Drive, a private road nestled in the heart of the Cragg Wood conservation area. Surrounded by ancient woodland and protected greenbelt, this remarkable location offers an unparalleled sense of seclusion, prestige, and natural beauty. The property enjoys a high degree of privacy while remaining within easy reach of local amenities in Rawdon, Horsforth, Yeadon and Guiseley. Location Highlights: • Positioned on a private road in a greenbelt setting • Within easy reach of Leeds, Bradford, and Harrogate. • Proximity to outstanding schools and train stations at Apperley Bridge and Horsforth • Leeds Bradford Airport a short drive away This is a rare opportunity to acquire one of the region’s most remarkable and perfectly situated private homes, offering space, privacy, character, and views rarely found so close to the city. Call our Prestige team on for more information or to arrange an off-market viewing. House Bathroom Comprising of a modern three piece bathroom suite which includes a bath with a shower over, a wash hand basin, and the w.c. Also includes a heated towel rail, and pat tiling. Double glazed window to the rear and ceiling spotlights. Headingley is approx. 15 minutes away on foot, and the open spaces of Woodhouse Ridge and Hyde Park are close by. The building itself was originally part of Leeds Girls High School, dating from circa 1876, and was converted into luxury apartments in 2017. Complementary white granite-style worktop and matching upstands complete this stylish look. There are integrated BOSCH appliances including a dishwasher, fridge/freezer, washer/dryer, electric oven, halogen hob and a concealed extractor hood. One and a half bowl sink and drainer with mixer tap. Slow closing mechanism to kitchen unit door and drawer fronts. Pelmet lights under wall units. FIRST FLOOR BEDROOM ONE (DOUBLE) A spacious double bedroom with a carpeted floor and fitted wardrobes, plus the benefit of three windows and leading to… EN SUITE BATHROOM Comprising a panelled bath with over bath plumbed shower, a low level WC and a pedestal washbasin. Benefiting from a window fitted with privacy glass. Benefiting from a window fitted with privacy glass. OUTSIDE There are well-established communal grounds with mature trees and grassed areas for residents to enjoy. results.summary: Sold chain free in this popular Pudsey location is this three bedroom semi-detached home, offering fantastic potential for buyers looking to modernise and create a long-term family home. With well-proportioned accommodation throughout, a generous rear garden and a garage, the property provides excellent scope to add value and tailor to individual taste. The internal accommodation comprises an entrance hall with stairs rising to the first floor. The living room is a good size and enjoys plenty of natural light, while the separate dining room sits to the rear, creating a flexible space for family meals or entertaining. The kitchen is fitted with a range of units and provides access through to the rear garden. Offers excellent scope to the rear of the home to knock through and create beautiful open plan living. To the first floor are three well-proportioned bedrooms, two of which are comfortable doubles, alongside a spacious single room ideal as a child’s bedroom, nursery or home office. The house modern shower room and separate WC complete the first floor layout. Externally, the property benefits from a generous rear garden, currently set for east maintenance with some mature shrubbery and trees. A garage provides useful storage or off-street parking. Located within easy reach of Pudsey Town Centre, the home benefits from a wide range of local amenities including shops, schools, parks and excellent transport links to both Leeds and Bradford, making it an ideal choice for commuters and growing families alike. The property has been thoughtfully arranged with family life in mind, providing versatile accommodation suitable for a mixture of uses with the convenience of a downstairs fourth bedroom & a fully-tiled separate shower room. The ground floor features a bright and spacious lounge and dining area, finished in modern neutral décor and offering plenty of room for both relaxing and entertaining. results.summary: A modern and spacious top floor apartment, positioned in a highly desirable and conveniently located development just moments from Wetherby town centre. This beautifully presented apartment offers stunning riverside views, generous open plan living space and two well proportioned double bedrooms. Situated in a peaceful yet central location, 14 Bridge End offers an exceptional two bedroom apartment, ideal for those seeking a secure, well-maintained home with excellent outdoor space. Built in 2006/7 by Shepherd Homes, this apartment is the only one with three separate balconies, providing stunning views and a perfect spot for outdoor relaxation. The accommodation benefits from gas fired central heating with Hive remote access thermostat, double glazed windows and in further details comprises:- Located on the second floor accessible via communal entrance with staircase, entering in via private hallway, the apartment boasts a spacious living with dining area, having rear facing balcony that extends the living space outdoors. The newly fitted kitchen is fully equipped with integrated Neff appliances, including an oven with induction hob, washing machine and fridge-freezer, dishwasher along with a boiling water tap, stylish worktops and soft close handle-less units, offering both style and functionality Both bedrooms are generously sized, with the principal featuring walk-in wardrobe and a spacious en-suite bathroom, along with its own private east-facing balcony. The main bathroom and en-suite are both well-appointed, with modern fixtures and fittings, heated towel rails, tiled walls and floor covering. To the outside the property benefits from secure gated parking with two allocated spaces, one of which is undercover. The apartment is serviced and managed by Smiths Co. with a monthly charge of £225, which covers gardening, window cleaning, buildings insurance, and maintenance, providing peace of mind for the homeowner. Available with no onward chain this apartment is well suited for those seeking a high quality, low maintenance property with fantastic views and ample outdoor space. Leasehold. The remainder of a 125 year lease from 2006 Annual service charge £3140.00. Annual ground rent £416.50. results.summary: Property Description A well-presented one bedroom ground floor retirement apartment with direct garden access. Situated in a peaceful position at the rear of the development, this attractive one bedroom ground floor retirement apartment enjoys a pleasant outlook and direct access to the communal landscaped gardens. Recently redecorated and newly carpeted, the property is well presented throughout and offers comfortable, low-maintenance accommodation ideally suited to retirement living. The accommodation briefly comprises an entrance hall with a useful storage cupboard. The living room is light and spacious, benefitting from windows to two elevations and a French door opening onto a small private patio area with direct access to the beautifully maintained communal gardens. A feature fireplace with electric fire provides an attractive focal point. The kitchen is fitted with a modern range of eye-catching wall and base units complemented by work surfaces and tiled splashbacks. Integrated appliances include a waist-height oven, four-ring electric hob with extractor hood, washer/dryer, fridge and freezer. A window provides natural light and ventilation. The double bedroom is well proportioned and features built-in mirrored wardrobes providing excellent storage. The shower room is fully tiled and fitted with a quality white suite comprising a shower enclosure, wash basin and WC, together with a medicine cabinet and heated towel rail. Residents of Tatterton Lodge benefit from the use of a communal residents’ lounge with kitchen facilities, ideal for socialising, as well as beautifully maintained landscaped gardens and a residents’ car park. A guest suite is also available within the development for visiting friends and relatives. Tatterton Lodge is a well-regarded retirement development of 55 one and two bedroom apartments, conveniently located within comfortable walking distance of the excellent amenities, shops and services available in Wetherby town centre. Early viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the accommodation and location on offer. Tenure Leasehold. Service charge for 2025/26 is £3,334.56 per annum. Ground Rent £812.24 per annum. The remainder of a 125 year lease commencing December 2016 Service charge covers "Careline system, buildings insurance, water and sewerage rates, ground source heating, communal cleaning, apartment heating, utilities and maintenance, garden maintenance, lift maintenance, lodge manager and contribution to the contingency fund." At least one apartment resident to be over the age of 60 with the second resident over the age of 55. results.location: Layton Mount, Rawdon, Leeds, West Yorkshire
results.summary: Situated in one of Rawdon’s most sought-after residential locations, this substantial five-bedroom detached home extends to over 2,500 sq ft and occupies a fantastic south - facing corner plot. Offering a unique and characterful layout, this individual property must be viewed internally to fully appreciate the space, versatility and potential on offer. The accommodation briefly comprises; an entrance porch, a hallway which provides access to a useful cloaks cupboard, a utility room and the integral tandem garage. The heart of the home is a spacious dining kitchen, fitted with patio doors opening directly onto the garden, creating a wonderful space for both everyday living and entertaining. To the ground floor there is also an extremely generous dining room, ideal for hosting family and friends, along with a superb family room featuring patio doors leading out to the rear garden. Further ground floor accommodation includes a double bedroom, a versatile playroom or additional reception space, a shower room and a separate WC, offering flexible living arrangements for growing families or those requiring guest accommodation. To the first floor is a house bathroom, four further well-proportioned bedrooms, including an impressive principal suite which benefits from its own dressing room and en-suite facilities. Externally, the property enjoys off-street parking to the front along with a lawned garden bordered by a variety of established shrubs and planting. A private patio seating area provides the perfect setting for relaxing, outdoor dining or entertaining while enjoying the surrounding outlook. Combining generous living space, flexible accommodation and a highly desirable location, this distinctive home offers a rare opportunity to acquire a truly individual property in the heart of Rawdon. Rawdon is highly sought after due to the excellent local schools, the property has easy access to the centre of the village with newsagents, butchers, restaurants and more. Located a short distance from the property is Rawdon Billing and Micklefield Park which is a great space to take the family to enjoy the facilities. Great commuting links, with Horsforth train station and Leeds Bradford Airport both around 10 minutes away. This historic former banking hall has been meticulously restored and transformed into just 17 luxury boutique apartments, offering an impressive blend of architectural grandeur and contemporary city living. Located in one of the most sought-after areas of LS1, The Bank perfectly balances heritage and modern design, reflecting both the rich history and vibrant future of Leeds. Originally designed by Sir Reginald Blomfield – the celebrated architect behind Regent Street and The Headrow – this iconic building retains its striking original façade, while the interiors have been thoughtfully reimagined for modern lifestyles. Behind its grand exterior, residents will find beautifully appointed homes with contemporary open-plan layouts, premium finishes and carefully curated design details throughout. The Bank represents a rare opportunity to own a distinctive home within one of Leeds’ most architecturally significant buildings, combining timeless character with refined contemporary living in a prime LS1 location. results.summary: Upon arrival, you are welcomed into a useful entrance porch, ideal for everyday practicality. From here, you step into the spacious living/dining room, a comfortable and inviting space. The room features a fireplace as a central focal point, adding warmth and charm, while double doors open through to the rear, creating a natural flow into the stunning extended heart of the home. The real highlight is the impressive extended kitchen and living space, expertly designed to maximise both space and light. This gorgeous area offers an ideal modern layout where cooking, dining, relaxing, and entertaining come together effortlessly. Practicality is well catered for with under stairs storage, a downstairs W/C, and a side external door providing convenient access outdoors. The fully fitted kitchen is finished to a high standard and offers excellent storage and generous worktop space. There is space for an American style fridge freezer, alongside a range of integrated appliances including a wine fridge, eye level oven, integrated microwave, gas hob with extractor fan, as well as an integrated dishwasher and washing machine. A stand out feature is the stylish breakfast bar, providing additional storage and casual seating. This entire extension is flooded with natural light, thanks to the combination of bi-folding doors and skylights, creating a wonderfully bright and airy atmosphere that really enhances the sense of space. The bi-folding doors open the room out to the rear garden, making this an exceptional setting for entertaining and summer living. Adding yet another clever touch, the extension has been designed with a discreet `hidden` office area, ideal for working from home, studying, or creating a tucked away workspace without compromising the main living space. To the first floor, the property continues to impress with well proportioned bedrooms and excellent built in storage throughout. The master bedroom is a great size and benefits from fitted wardrobes and a modern en-suite shower room, complete with a double shower. There is a further double bedroom and a good-sized third bedroom, both also featuring fitted wardrobes, ensuring practical storage for the whole household. The accommodation is completed by a fully tiled three piece family bathroom, finished in a modern style and ideal for both family use and guests. Externally, the home offers excellent kerb appeal and practical outdoor space. To the front, there is a driveway providing off road parking, leading to a garage ideal for additional storage or secure parking. A turfed garden area enhances the frontage, while a patio pathway leads around to the rear of the property. The rear garden offers a combination of turfed and patio areas, creating a versatile outdoor space. Notice Please note we have not tested any apparatus, fixtures, fittings, or services. Interested parties must undertake their own investigation into the working order of these items. All measurements are approximate and photographs provided for guidance only. results.summary: **ONE BEDROOM SECOND FLOOR RETIREMENT APARTMENT** Situated in the fantastic development of Tatterton Lodge is this delightful one bedroom apartment. The property is presented in fantastic order throughout and boasts lovely garden views. The Living Room offers ample space for living and dining room furniture and benefits from a feature electric fire with attractive surround. A window provides lots of natural light. The Kitchen offers a range of modern eye and base level units with working surfaces over and tiled splashbacks. There is a built-in waist height oven, 4 ring electric hob, washer/dryer, fridge and freezer. The Bedroom is a generous double room with a built-in mirrored wardrobe. A large window keeps this fantastic bedroom bright and light. The Shower Room offers a curved shower with handrail, a WC, wash hand basin with vanity unit beneath and a heated towel rail. Perfectly complimenting this wonderful apartment is a useful walk-in storage cupboard located in the hallway. Call us today to book your viewing at Tatterton Lodge! Tatterton Lodge is a delightful development of 55 one and two bedroom apartments located in the charming historic town of Wetherby, centrally located between Leeds, York and Harrogate. Wetherby’s rich heritage owes much to its location being a half way staging post between London and Edinburgh on the old Great North Road, which used to run directly through the town; many of the coaching Inns established during that time are still there to enjoy today. Having been granted a Royal Charter in 1240, the town has always been a popular place to live and visit. The 13th century medieval bridge remains a prominent feature of the town and there are many delightful riverside walks and the Turner Trail to enjoy a stroll. Nestling in the heart of Yorkshire’s Golden Triangle of Leeds, York and Harrogate, Wetherby is ideally located for trips to these major cities to visit the shops and explore the many visitor attractions or enjoy days out to the Yorkshire Dales, the North Yorkshire Moors and the East coast. Wetherby racecourse, Harewood House and the delightful parks of Stockeld and Roundhay are nearby and the town centre has various shops, restaurants and eateries. Wetherby is well served by regular public bus services with bus stops ideally located just outside Tatterton Lodge; in addition the main bus station is located in the market place. The town is also within easy reach of major road networks and served by Leeds Railway Station and Leeds Bradford International Airport catering for a variety of journeys. Tatterton Lodge’s manager is on hand throughout the day to support the Owners and keep the development in perfect shape as well as arranging events such as movie nights to strawberry and cream afternoons, board games, music evenings, fitness classes and birthday celebrations. A Guest Suite is available for your friends and family to stay in. In addition, you are entitled to use the Guest Suites at all Churchill Living developments across the country. Prices are available from the Lodge Manager. Tatterton Lodge has been designed with safety and security at the forefront, all apartments and communal areas have an emergency Careline system installed, monitored by the onsite Lodge Manager during the day and 24 hours, 365 days a year by the Careline team. A Careline integrated intruder alarm, secure video entry system and sophisticated fire and smoke detection systems throughout both the apartment and communal areas provide unrivalled peace of mind. Tatterton Lodge is managed by the award winning Churchill Estates Management, working closely with Churchill Living and Churchill Sales & Lettings to maintain the highest standards of maintenance and service for every lodge and owner. Tatterton Lodge requires at least one apartment resident to be over the age of 60 with any second resident over the age of 55. Service Charge (Year Ending 31st May 2026): £3,334.55 per annum. Ground Rent: £812.24 per annum. To be reviewed December 2030. Council Tax Band C 125 year Lease commencing 2016 Please check regarding Pets with Churchill Estates Management. Any consents given in relation to pets are subject to the terms of the lease and any further rules and regulations made by Churchill Estates Management. Service charges include: Careline system, buildings insurance, water and sewerage rates, ground source heating, communal cleaning, apartment heating, utilities and maintenance, garden maintenance, lift maintenance, lodge manager and a contribution to the contingency fund. results.summary: A delightful, two bedroom ground floor apartment situated in this much sought after over 60s retirement complex, offering an extremely well presented, ready to move into interior, perfect for those looking to downsize. Occupying a pleasant position within well-manicured communal gardens with a residents car park for off street parking, the property is well placed for local amenities and bus routes and early viewing is going to be essential! Comprising in brief, to the ground floor; communal entrance hallway with security intercom system, private entrance hallway with two good size, shelved storage cupboards and a welcoming living room with brass finish electric fire in modern surround, external access out to the grounds and with glazed double doors into a breakfast kitchen fitted with a range of white units to base and wall level with electric oven and hob, integrated fridge freezer, a washing machine and space for a small table. There is a generous principal bedroom with views over the gardens, a well-proportioned second bedroom and a shower room with a white suite to include WC, wash basin and a large corner shower enclosure with modern wall tiling and heated towel rail. Externally, the property has use of mature, lawned communal grounds and off street parking is available in the residents car park. Pudsey Town Centre offers a vast range of local facilities including schools for all ages, shops, cafes, bars and restaurants. Pudsey Park is centrally located in the town and offers a children’s playground and fabulous gardens. Out-of-town shopping on a larger scale is found at the nearby Owlcotes Shopping Centre which offers both Asda and Marks & Spencer Superstore, with bus links and New Pudsey Railway Station also being close by. Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Checks - As part of making an offer, we’re required by law to complete Anti-Money Laundering (AML) checks to confirm the identity of all purchasers. To cover the cost of this process, a fee of £48 inc VAT per buyer is payable when your offer is accepted. This is a standard requirement for all buyers and helps us ensure your offer can be progressed as quickly and smoothly as possible. results.summary: Situated on the quiet cul-de-sac of New Adel Avenue in Leeds, this wonderfully presented three-bedroom semi-detached house is a true gem. Set on a generous plot, the property boasts a well-maintained garden that is perfect for outdoor enjoyment. As you step inside, you are greeted by a spacious hallway that provides access to both the inviting lounge and the kitchen, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The lounge features double doors that open into the second reception room, allowing for a versatile living space that can be tailored to your needs, whether it be for entertaining guests or enjoying quiet family time. The immaculate mature rear garden is a standout feature, capturing the sun throughout the day, making it an ideal spot for relaxation or outdoor gatherings. In addition to the beautiful interior and garden, the property also offers a large driveway, providing ample parking space, along with a detached brick-built garage for additional storage or workshop needs. This home is perfect for families or anyone seeking a peaceful retreat in a vibrant community. With its charming features and excellent location, this semi-detached house is not to be missed. Hallway - Entering the property you are welcomed into the spacious hallway. The hallway offers access to the living room and through to the kitchen. A useful under stairs cupboard houses the tumble dryer and offers additional storage. Lounge - Generous sized living room offers ample space for seating and is naturally bright thanks to the large window to the front elevation of the property. A feature gas fireplace sits as a central focal point to the room. Internal double doors open up the lounge to the second reception room which creates a great space for hosting and socialising. Dining Room / Reception 2 - Positioned to the rear of the property this cosy reception room is flooded with natural light given its south facing orientation. The room over looks the rear garden and adjoins the kitchen. Kitchen - Made up of wall and base units providing plenty of storage with the addition of a useful pantry cupboard. The kitchen is complete with a freestanding oven with gas hob, and space for a freestanding fridge/freezer, and plumbing for washing machine. The side door leads out to the driveway and to the garage/rear garden. Bedroom 1 - Spacious primary bedroom offers ample space for bedroom furniture and is complete with wall to wall mirrored sliding wardrobes. Bedroom 2 - Second double bedroom overlooks the garden and is complete with fitted wardrobes. Bedroom 3 - Third single bedroom also makes for a great office space if needed. Bathroom - Comprising walk in shower, sink, storage cupboard and a separate toilet. External - To the front of the property is a large driveway for up to 3/4 cars. Side access leads up to the detached garage and round to the South facing rear garden. The rear garden is wonderfully maintained by the current owners with matures trees and plants throughout. A large lawned area also makes it ideal for families. To the rear of the garden is a wooden summerhouse. Garage - Brick built garage with manual front door. The garage has lighting and power and offers an abundance of storage space. Perched in an elevated position, the property enjoys uninterrupted southerly views across the surrounding countryside, creating a rare combination of natural beauty and refined seclusion. Rawdon, a highly sought-after leafy suburb of Leeds, offers excellent local amenities, well-regarded schools, and convenient transport connections. Apperley Bridge train station lies less than two miles away, and Leeds Bradford International Airport is less than five miles from the property, yet due to its position off the flight path, Brenaire Park remains blissfully unaffected by aircraft noise. A truly unique opportunity to acquire a substantial family home in one of Yorkshire’s most desirable addresses. Extending to over 7,000 sq ft and offered with no onward chain, this grand family home is approached via a sweeping private driveway and offers superb proportions throughout. Set within an exclusive enclave, the property enjoys a privileged position on Woodlands Drive, a private road nestled in the heart of the Cragg Wood conservation area. Surrounded by ancient woodland and protected greenbelt, this remarkable location offers an unparalleled sense of seclusion, prestige, and natural beauty. results.summary: Property Description Entered via a composite front door into a welcoming reception hallway with a useful downstairs cloakroom/WC. The breakfast kitchen is fitted with a range of cottage-style base units complemented by worktops with tiled splashbacks and a breakfast bar providing bar-stool seating. Integrated appliances include an electric double oven with six ring gas hob and extractor hood above, with further space and plumbing for an automatic washing machine, under-counter dishwasher and American-style fridge freezer. A double glazed bay window overlooks the front aspect and there is a wall-mounted Ideal gas fired central heating boiler. To the rear of the property lies a well proportioned living/dining room, enjoying a bright and airy feel with a large double glazed square bay window and French-style patio doors opening onto the rear garden. The room also benefits from a useful understairs storage cupboard and an attractive panelled feature wall. To the first floor, the landing provides access to a useful storage cupboard and three bedrooms. Bedrooms two and three are good-sized double rooms with double glazed windows to the front and rear respectively. Bedroom four is a single room, ideal as a nursery / child’s bedroom or home office. The house bathroom is fitted with a modern white three-piece suite comprising a low flush WC, pedestal wash basin and panelled bath, complemented by part-tiled walls and vinyl floor covering. A turned staircase leads to the second floor, where an extremely generous principal bedroom suite features a vaulted ceiling with double glazed Velux windows, a recessed area ideal for a desk or dressing table, together with bespoke fitted wardrobes and chest of drawers. The en-suite shower room comprises a large step-in shower cubicle, pedestal wash basin and low flush WC, finished with fully tiled walls and laminate floor covering. Externally, parking is available to the rear of the property in front of a single garage. Positioned set back from Park View, the property enjoys communal use of an attractive shared green space to the front, maintained with neatly kept hedges, rose beds and small trees. The private rear garden is mainly laid to lawn and enclosed by timber fencing to three sides, together with a timber decking area providing an ideal space for outdoor entertaining, relaxation and al fresco dining during the summer months. The garden is further complemented by an external electric point. results.summary: NO CHAIN This beautifully finished two-bedroom end-terrace sits on a generous corner plot in the heart of Farsley, a thriving village known for its independent shops, cafés, and restaurants. Offering modern style with characterful touches, the home features a log-burning stove, a shaker-style kitchen with range cooker and Belfast sink, and wrap-around gardens perfect for outdoor living. With excellent transport links, well-regarded schools, and Leeds city centre just 15 minutes away, this home is ideal for first-time buyers, downsizers, or young families looking for style and convenience in equal measure. LOCATION Farsley has been named as an up-and-coming area to watch in the The Sunday Times Best Places to Live 2021 guide. It is a small but increasingly popular Village from which commuting is straightforward, either by private or public transport The A6120 and A647 are both on hand and provide major links to the motorway networks. Just a short distance away is the popular Owlcotes Centre at Pudsey offering a Marks & Spencer store, Asda superstore, and there is a train station adjacent. In addition, the bus services are frequent from the village, getting you into Leeds & Bradford City centres. There is a good selection of shops, pubs and eateries in Farsley and schools are also popular. The neighbouring villages of Pudsey and Horsforth are only a short distance away and also offer a comprehensive range of facilities. A recreation/playground is within a short walk, ideal for children and pets. GROUND FLOOR The ground floor is designed for modern living with both practicality and charm. At the rear, the stylish kitchen/dining room combines classic shaker-style units with wood-effect worktops and metro-tiled splashbacks. A range cooker set in a feature alcove and a Belfast sink overlooking the garden add character, while the understairs cupboard provides valuable storage. With space for a dining table, it’s perfect for everyday use or hosting guests. At the front, the lounge is light-filled thanks to a large window, with a log-burning stove and oak mantel creating a cosy, welcoming focal point. Neutral décor and wood-effect flooring make the space versatile for any style. FIRST FLOOR Upstairs, the property offers two generous double bedrooms. The main bedroom is bright and spacious with a wide corner window, fresh neutral décor, and soft carpeting, providing plenty of room for wardrobes and furnishings. The second bedroom is equally versatile, currently used as a study and day room, but ideal as a guest bedroom, child’s room, or home office. The bathroom has been finished to a high standard, featuring a white three-piece suite with a panelled bath, rainfall shower, vanity unit, and modern tiling. OUTSIDE Set on a generous corner plot, the home benefits from wrap-around gardens that offer both lawned and paved seating areas, perfect for family time or entertaining. Mature trees add privacy and shade, while a timber shed provides extra storage. With a welcoming stone wall frontage and potential for further landscaping, the outdoor space is both practical and full of promise. results.summary: A modern two-bedroom terrace home which is located within a short walk from Wetherby market town and offers generous living accommodation, beautiful gardens and private parking. Occupying an enviable position within a small and peaceful cul-de-sac of just five properties and located within easy walking distance of Wetherby market town, this beautiful terrace home offers generous and well-proportioned accommodation. The property has been finished to an exceptional standard by the current owner and further benefits from a fully landscaped, private rear garden. On entering the property, the welcoming entrance hallway provides access to all the principal rooms and offers useful storage facilities. The modern kitchen sits to the rear of the property and offers patio doors that lead to the rear garden whilst offering a wealth of quality fitted appliances and cupboards. Further accommodation to the ground floor includes a spacious living room, guest w.c. and built in storage. Stairs from the entrance hallway lead to the first-floor landing which provides access to all the first-floor accommodation. There are two well-proportioned bedrooms – the principal bedroom being of a very generous size, alongside a stylish house bathroom. The gardens of this home have been planned for ease of maintenance, are fully enclosed and provide for an ideal place to enjoy al fresco dining. The property has the further benefit off-street parking to the front of the property. Occupying a most convenient position within the favoured ‘Spofforth Hill’ area of Wetherby, the property is nestled within a small community which offers well-maintained and most pleasant grounds, alongside private allocated parking. There are further parking facilities for both residents and guests. This much sought-after area is within easy level walking distance of this popular market town and the renowned Wetherby golf course. Wetherby market town provides a wide choice of shops, recreational amenities and schools for all age groups. The area is rightly popular with those working in Leeds, Harrogate and York, with the nearby A1 providing excellent access to the region's motorway network. results.summary: ***THREE BEDROOM SEMI-DETACHED WITH GARAGE AND ENCLOSED GARDEN TO REAR *** Presenting a great OPPORTUNITY to aquire this spacious family home with the scope to make it your own!. The house has been well maintained by the present owner and offers spacious accommodation and throughout but does require some modernisation. To the ground floor there is a large entrance hall which in turn leads to the living/dining room and kitchen. The living room benefits from a dual aspect and can be easily zoned into living and dining space with furniture. The log burning stove creates a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The first floor boasts three well-appointed bedrooms. The first and second bedrooms are spacious double rooms, while the third is a comfortable single room, all offering a refreshing space to rest. A well appointed bathroom includes a bath with shower over, pedestal hand wash basin and low flush w.c. An outstanding feature of this home is the rear garden. Larger than most on the street there are multiple paved seating areas, external power points and raised flower beds - ideal for a veg plot or flowering shrubs. results.summary: EweMove is delighted to bring to the market this truly outstanding period home. Dating back to circa 1840, this unique residence presents a rare opportunity to acquire a piece of local history. It has been beautifully restored to balance a wealth of original character with the sleek, contemporary amenities required for modern family life. GROUND FLOOR ACCOMMODATION: Entrance & Hallway: Upon entering via the welcoming porch, you are greeted by an impressive hallway. This space offers an immediate sense of grandeur and volume that sets the tone for the rest of the property. Formal Reception Room: Positioned to the front elevation, the formal lounge is a sanctuary of calm. The room is bathed in natural light thanks to sash windows on two aspects. The focal point of the room is a charming wood burning stove, perfect for cosy winter evenings. Open-Plan Kitchen & Dining: To the rear lies the true heart of this home: a stunning, open-plan modern dining kitchen designed for entertaining. Fitted with sleek high-gloss cabinetry, the space boasts: • A large central island with a breakfast bar. • Ample floor space for a formal dining table. • Integrated dishwasher and a stainless steel sink/drainer. • Space for an American-style fridge-freezer. • A show-stopping space for a range cooker, set into the original chimney breast with an exposed stone lintel. Utility & Cellar: Practicality is key in this family home. A separate utility room keeps laundry appliances out of sight, accompanied by a convenient ground floor WC. From the kitchen, there is access to a useful cellar. Currently ideal for storage, this space offers exciting potential for conversion into a cinema room, gym, or playroom. FIRST FLOOR ACCOMMODATION: The first-floor landing gives access to three well-appointed bedrooms, comprised of two generous doubles and a versatile single: • Bedroom 2 & Bedroom 4: Positioned to the front of the property, these rooms (one a generous double, the other a single/home office) are west-facing. They benefit from uninterrupted views over fields and farmland—the perfect vantage point for stunning sunsets. • Bedroom 3: A further generous double bedroom completes the sleeping accommodation on this level. Family Bathroom: Exceptionally spacious, the stylish family bathroom features a four-piece suite including a freestanding roll-top bath, a separate walk-in shower, low flush WC, and hand wash basin. The room is finished with contemporary part-tiled surrounds. SECOND FLOOR PRINCIPAL SUITE: The top floor is dedicated entirely to the elegant principal suite. This private haven features bespoke fitted wardrobes and access to useful eaves storage. It benefits from a luxurious en-suite shower room which has been recently renovated to a high standard. LOCATION: Wakefield Road is nestled in the lovely commuter town of Garforth, offering the perfect blend of suburbia and city access. The area is exceptionally well-connected, boasting two train stations. You can enjoy fast, frequent services to Leeds City Centre in just 10–15 minutes, alongside direct links to York, Hull, and other key destinations. Plus, with the A1(M) and M1 motorways just a stone's throw away, traveling around the region is effortless. The local high street is a treasure trove, ranging from convenient supermarkets to unique independent stores. The town is a vibrant community hub, rich with pubs, restaurants, and cosy coffee shops. Beyond the town centre, the area is surrounded by beautiful green spaces and is close to major local attractions like Lotherton Hall and Temple Newsam. Garforth is also a top choice for families due to its reputation for excellent education. Primary options include the OFSTED 'Good' rated Strawberry Fields Primary School, while for secondary and sixth-form education, Garforth Academy is highly rated and offers excellent facilities. SUMMARY: This home is ideal for the discerning buyer seeking timeless charm combined with contemporary comfort. Viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the scale and quality of this restoration.
