results.summary: Cornerstone are delighted to offer for sale this charming two-bedroom end terrace home, believed to have been constructed around 1983 and occupying an enviable position within a highly desirable cul-de-sac in the heart of Meanwood. The Home - The First Viewings Are Saturday 21st March 2026 and Sold With No Onward Chain. Cornerstone are delighted to offer for sale this charming two-bedroom end terrace home, believed to have been constructed around 1983 and occupying an enviable position within a highly desirable cul-de-sac in the heart of Meanwood. Elevated above the surrounding area, the property enjoys wonderful far-reaching views down and across Meanwood, creating a sense of openness that is rarely found within such a convenient residential location. Sandfield Garth is a particularly sought-after setting, appreciated for its peaceful atmosphere while still being within comfortable walking distance of the vibrant centre of Meanwood. The property benefits from a garage, with additional on-street parking available within the cul-de-sac itself. Approaching the home, a pathway with a small number of steps leads down to the front door. The path also continues down the side of the property, providing access to the rear garden. At the back of the home, you will find a pleasant patio seating area, perfect for relaxing or entertaining during the warmer months. From the patio, a number of steps lead up to a sliding patio door which opens directly into the sitting room, creating a lovely connection between the indoor and outdoor living spaces. Entering through the front door, you are welcomed into a practical entrance vestibule, providing useful space for coats and shoe storage. From here, a door opens into the kitchen diner. The kitchen diner is decorated in a stylish yet neutral tone, creating a bright and inviting environment. The space offers a generous range of fitted cupboards complemented by contrasting worktops and tiled splashbacks. A one-and-a-half stainless steel sink with a drainer is positioned beneath a large double-glazed window, allowing plenty of natural light while offering a pleasant outlook over and up the front garden. The kitchen utilities comprise an oven, a four-ring gas hob, space for a freestanding fridge freezer, and space with plumbing for a washing machine. A door from the kitchen leads through to the sitting room. The sitting room is well presented and provides a comfortable and welcoming space to relax. A premium wood-effect floor adds warmth and character, while the sliding patio door allows natural light to pour in and provides direct access to the rear garden, with steps down to the patio. A staircase rises from this room to the first-floor landing. Upstairs, the landing benefits from a double-glazed window which allows natural light to fill the landing and also provides a pleasant outlook. Doors from the landing lead to two bedrooms and the bathroom. The principal bedroom, located to the rear of the property, enjoys truly spectacular far-reaching views across Meanwood, taking full advantage of the home’s elevated position. Waking up to this outlook is a real highlight of the property and gives the room a wonderfully peaceful feel. The front bedroom is also a good size and benefits from a built-in storage cupboard, making it a versatile space that could serve equally well as a bedroom, home office, or guest room. The bathroom is well presented and predominantly tiled. It comprises a bath with a rainfall-style shower over, a toilet, and a wall-mounted wash basin, offering a clean and modern finish. The Location - The location of Sandfield Garth is truly exceptional. Residents are within easy walking distance of the centre of Meanwood, a suburb that has become highly desirable thanks to its vibrant community atmosphere and excellent amenities. Here you will find both Waitrose & Partners and Aldi, alongside a wide range of independent shops, cafés, restaurants, bars and traditional pubs that give Meanwood its distinctive character. Nature lovers will also appreciate the close proximity to Meanwood Park, a beautiful stretch of woodland and parkland that is perfect for walking, running or simply enjoying time outdoors. Just a short distance away lies the ever-popular suburb of Headingley, renowned for its lively atmosphere and diverse range of amenities. Headingley offers an excellent selection of restaurants, cafés, bars, boutique shops and supermarkets, as well as popular entertainment venues and sporting attractions, making it a vibrant hub for residents and visitors alike. The property is also ideally positioned for access to Leeds, with the bustling Leeds City Centre located only a short journey away. The city centre offers an outstanding array of amenities, including brilliant shopping opportunities at Trinity Leeds and Victoria Leeds, which includes a John Lewis & Partners alongside theatres, galleries, museums, an impressive restaurant scene and a large financial and business district. This makes the property particularly attractive for professionals and commuters seeking easy access to the city while enjoying a vibrant but quieter residential setting. The property is also surrounded by some excellent schools. Combining a sought-after location, attractive views, practical living space and excellent access to both green space and city life, this delightful home represents a fantastic opportunity for first-time buyers, young professionals, or those looking to downsize within one of Leeds most popular suburbs. A viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate everything this lovely home and its superb location have to offer. Important Information - TENURE - Freehold Council Tax Band B. results.summary: A fabulous, one bedroom loft-style apartment situated in a fantastic location on the doorstep of the vibrant Farsley centre with its eclectic mix of independent shops, bars and restaurants. Forming part of a sympathetic mill conversion, with an impressive open plan living, dining and kitchen space, a generous double bedroom and allocated parking in the residents car park, this is a property ideal for those looking for their first home and internal inspection is essential to fully appreciate the character this wonderful building has to offer. The property is located on the second floor and enjoys a pleasant dual aspect with lovely elevated views. The well-presented accommodation comprises in brief, to the ground floor; communal entrance hallway with security intercom system and staircase rising to the second floor, an entrance vestibule with cloakroom space, hallway and a bright and spacious living, dining and kitchen space with large windows to dual elevations, modern laminate flooring, fitted kitchen units with built in electric oven and gas hob, integrated washing machine, plumbing for a dishwasher and space for an under-counter fridge. There is a good size double bedroom and bathroom with white suite to include WC, wash basin and bath with shower over, with complementary tiled floor and splash backs. Externally, the property is situated within well-maintained communal grounds and has an allocated parking space in the communal car park. The ‘village’ of Farsley offers a range of amenities that centre around the bustling Farsley Town Street. Additional shopping facilities are found at the nearby Owlcotes Shopping Centre which provides both Asda and Marks & Spencer superstores. For those who commute or require transport links, New Pudsey Railway Station is located adjacent to the Owlcotes Shopping Centre and provides a direct route to both Leeds and Bradford City Centres, the Leeds Outer Ring Road offers access to other areas of the city. results.summary: A beautifully presented four bedroom period cottage nestled in the heart of this popular and historic village. "Tynedale House" reveals exceptionally well balanced and spacious accommodation that needs to be viewed to be fully appreciated. Property Description This charming four bedroom period cottage, located in the historic village of Clifford, skilfully blends character with modern living. Offering just under 1,600 sqft of tastefully decorated space, the property is fitted with double glazed windows, gas fired central heating and in further detail comprises:- To the ground floor, upon entering you are greeted by a genuinely spacious and welcoming entrance hallway featuring an exposed hardwood floor, a cast iron radiator and an attractive staircase leading to the first floor. The hallway also provides useful under stairs storage, as well as a guest WC. The hardwood flooring flows seamlessly into the spacious living room, which boasts high ceilings with exposed timbers and an elegant fireplace with an open fire. One large window at the front of the room allow for ample natural light, with a radiator beneath each window. The heart of the home is a stunning open plan dining kitchen. The spacious kitchen features oak block work surfaces, hand painted shaker-style units and drawers beneath, as well as an inset Belfast sink. Integrated appliances include dishwasher a range cooker with a gas hob and extractor hood. Attractive natural stone floor tiles flow into the dining area, which comfortably accommodates a dining table and chairs. Double glazed patio doors lead out to the enclosed rear garden, offering a perfect space for outdoor dining or relaxation. Adjacent to the dining area is a further reception room, currently used as a family room. This room is fitted with bespoke furniture to one side, housing the washing machine, tumble dryer and fridge freezer, along with a seat having trunk storage beneath and a cupboard above. The room also features wood effect laminate flooring and double glazed patio doors leading to the rear garden. To the first floor, the landing area provides access to a useful store room with Velux and door into a partially boarded loft space via a hatch and drop down ladder. results.summary: Situated in a peaceful position with open allotments directly to the rear, this beautifully presented stone-built terraced home offers the perfect balance of character and contemporary style. With generous room proportions set across three floors, modernised interiors throughout, and a truly rare private rear garden, this property stands out within its setting. Ideal for families, professionals or those seeking flexible living space, the home combines period charm with high-quality modern finishes and excellent outdoor space. LOCATION Horsforth, named as one of the top 10 most desirable postcodes in England and is a prime residential location, popular with families and young professionals alike. The property is within easy reach of an array of excellent amenities including well regarded schooling for all ages, lovely canal & river walks, and the extensive shopping facilities found on New Road Side and Town Street including Morrisons supermarket. Horsforth Hall Park is a great addition to the community with a children’s playground, bandstand, cricket pitch, skate park and bowling green. For commuters, Horsforth Train Station provides services to Leeds, York and Harrogate. Kirkstall Forge Train Station is located down the A65 and offers further means of convenient access into the city (8 mins) and surrounding areas. The Ring Road (A6120) and the (A65) are nearby and provide main road links to the commercial centres of Leeds, Bradford, York and Harrogate, a regular bus service runs into the City Centre and, for the more travelled commuter, Leeds-Bradford Airport is a short drive away. All in all, this location is sought after by a wide variety of buyers and enjoys a strong sense of community and a thriving village atmosphere. GROUND FLOOR A welcoming entrance opens straight into a spacious and light-filled lounge, beautifully styled with fresh modern décor and warm wood flooring. A tall front window enhances the sense of space while a contemporary electric fire set within the chimney breast creates an inviting focal point. To the rear, the recently modernised kitchen diner provides an impressive space for both everyday living and entertaining. Fitted with shaker-style units, elegant quartz worktops and fully integrated appliances, the kitchen offers both style and functionality. There is ample space for a dining table, pleasant views over the garden and direct access outside, seamlessly connecting indoor and outdoor living. A useful cellar is accessed from this level, providing excellent additional storage. FIRST FLOOR The first floor hosts two well-proportioned bedrooms. The principal bedroom sits to the front of the property and benefits from a handy under-stairs wardrobe, while the second bedroom is a generous small double positioned to the rear, enjoying peaceful views across the garden and neighbouring allotments. Completing this floor is a contemporary three-piece family bathroom, fitted with a shower over bath and finished in crisp white ceramic tiling, creating a fresh and modern feel. SECOND FLOOR Occupying the top floor is an excellent double bedroom, quietly positioned to create a calm and private retreat. Natural light pours in through a rear Velux window, enhancing the bright and airy atmosphere. This versatile space works perfectly as a main bedroom, guest suite or dedicated home office. OUTSIDE The property is set slightly back from the roadside behind a gated, lawned front garden with attractive planted borders, creating a welcoming first impression. On-street parking is readily available. To the rear lies a fully enclosed private garden — a rare and highly desirable feature for stone terraced homes in this location. Predominantly laid to lawn with a decked seating and entertaining area, the garden provides a peaceful outdoor haven with a beautiful open backdrop directly onto allotments, ideal for relaxing, entertaining and family life. BROCHURE DETAILS Hardisty and Co prepared these details, including photography, in accordance with our estate agency agreement. Ideal for families, professionals or those seeking flexible living space, the home combines period charm with high-quality modern finishes and excellent outdoor space. LOCATION Horsforth, named as one of the top 10 most desirable postcodes in England and is a prime residential location, popular with families and young professionals alike. The property is within easy reach of an array of excellent amenities including well regarded schooling for all ages, lovely canal & river walks, and the extensive shopping facilities found on New Road Side and Town Street including Morrisons supermarket. Horsforth Hall Park is a great addition to the community with a children’s playground, bandstand, cricket pitch, skate park and bowling green. For commuters, Horsforth Train Station provides services to Leeds, York and Harrogate. Kirkstall Forge Train Station is located down the A65 and offers further means of convenient access into the city (8 mins) and surrounding areas. The Ring Road (A6120) and the (A65) are nearby and provide main road links to the commercial centres of Leeds, Bradford, York and Harrogate, a regular bus service runs into the City Centre and, for the more travelled commuter, Leeds-Bradford Airport is a short drive away. Only some 4 miles from the Market Town of Wetherby and easy car commuting distance of Leeds,York and Harrogate with the A1/M1 link road nearby. DIRECTIONS Leaving Wetherby travelling East along Walton Road, upon approaching Walton village and passing the 30mph speed zone, take the second turning on the right into Grange Avenue. Bear left and the property will be identified on the right hand side. THE PROPERTY Benefitting from gas fired central heating and double glazed windows throughout; the well presented and tastefully decorated living accomodation in further detail giving approximate room sizes comprises:- GROUND FLOOR ENTRANCE HALLWAY Entering through composite front door into attractive entrance hallway with staircase leading to first floor, double radiator to side and central pendant light fitting. LIVING ROOM - 4.89m x 3.32m (16'0" x 10'10") A bright and airy living space with large double glazed window to front, double radiator beneath and central pendant light fitting. OPEN PLAN KITCHEN/DINER - 8.97m x 2.95m (29'5" x 9'8") An excellent family kitchen with open plan dining area, ideal for entertaining. DINING AREA - 3.76m x 2.95m (12'4" x 9'8") With double glazed French style patio doors onto rear garden, double radiator and central pendant light fitting. KITCHEN AREA - 5.35m x 2.96m (17'6" x 9'8") Fitted kitchen comprising a range of modern wall and base units including cupboards and drawers, work surfaces with splashback behind hob. Integrated appliances include electric oven with four ring gas hob and extractor hood above, undercounter fridge and undercounter freezer along with dishwasher. Space and plumbing for automatic washing machine, circular stainless steel sink unit with mixer tap above, boiler cupboard housing wall mounted Worcester gas fired central heating boiler, two double glazed windows, wood effect laminate flooring, further side personnel door. Useful pantry cupboard with storage shelving. FIRST FLOOR LANDING Double glazed window and half stair. Central pendant light fitting and loft access hatch. BEDROOM ONE - 3.88m x 3.33m (12'8" x 10'11") With large double glazed window to front enjoying open aspect across Walton Road over adjoining countryside. Double radiator and central pendant light fitting. BEDROOM TWO - 3.32m x 3.23m (10'10" x 10'7") Double glazed window to the front, radiator beneath and fitted wardrobe cupboard and central pendant light fitting. BEDROOM THREE - 3.35m x 3m (10'11" x 9'10") Double glazed window overlooking rear garden, radiator beneath, central light fitting. BEDROOM FOUR - 3.08m x 2.01m (10'1" x 6'7") Double glazed window to rear, radiator beneath, fitted wardrobe cupboard, central light fitting. BATHROOM - 2.22m x 2.01m (7'3" x 6'7") Fitted with a modern white suite comprising a low flush w.c., pedestal wash basin, panelled bath with shower and screen above, part tiled walls with tiled flooring, chrome heated towel rail, double glazed window and recess ceiling lighting. TO THE OUTSIDE Street parking is available to the front of the property along with single garage forming part of a garage block to the rear. GARDENS Decorative front garden set largely to lawn behind Dwarf garden wall extending round the side of the property, well-stocked and neatly maintained flower beds house a range of flowering bushes and shrubs. Side gate and flagged path provides ample bin storage and access to rear garden. A generous sized south westerly facing rear garden is a particular feature of this property, set largely to lawn with timber fence and conifer hedgerow perimeter. Well-stocked and neatly maintained flower beds house a range of colourful bushes and shrubs and trees. There is a garden workshop to the bottom of the garden providing useful garden storage, flagged patio area provides an ideal space for outdoor entertaining and relaxation along with barbecue and 'al-fresco' dining in the summer months. results.summary: STARTING BIDS - £225,000 Positioned in a highly sought-after location just moments from Town Street and its wide range of amenities, this three-bedroom semi-detached home offers an exciting opportunity for buyers looking to modernise and add value. With no onward chain, the home is ready for its next chapter. LOCATION Horsforth, named as one of the top 10 most desirable postcodes in England and is a prime residential location, popular with families and young professionals alike. The property is within easy reach of an array of excellent amenities including well regarded schooling for all ages, lovely canal & river walks, and the extensive shopping facilities found on New Road Side and Town Street including Morrisons supermarket. Horsforth Hall Park is a great addition to the community with a children’s playground, bandstand, cricket pitch, skate park and bowling green. For commuters, Horsforth Train Station provides services to Leeds, York and Harrogate. Kirkstall Forge Train Station is located down the A65 and offers further means of convenient access into the city (8 mins) and surrounding areas. The Ring Road (A6120) and the (A65) are nearby and provide main road links to the commercial centres of Leeds, Bradford, York and Harrogate, a regular bus service runs into the City Centre and, for the more travelled commuter, Leeds-Bradford Airport is a short drive away. The kitchen is fitted with modern cupboards and laminate worktops, offering a practical layout with a contemporary feel. A side utility area and a convenient downstairs WC add further functionality to the ground floor. FIRST FLOOR Upstairs, the home offers three bedrooms. The master bedroom is a generously sized rear-facing double with built-in wardrobes, while the second bedroom is also a comfortable double, again featuring built-in storage. The third bedroom is a front-facing single room, perfectly suited as a child’s bedroom, nursery, or home office. The bathroom has been adapted into a wet room style, comprising a WC, wash basin, and shower area. OUTSIDE The property enjoys a large rear garden, mainly laid to lawn with fenced boundaries, offering excellent potential for landscaping, outdoor entertaining, or even extension (subject to the necessary permissions). results.summary: ***For Sale by Modern Method of Auction*** A WONDERFUL END MEWS HOUSE forming part of a select, gated development in the much sought after area of Weetwood. LEASEHOLD FOR 999 YEARS FROM 2001. NO ONWARD CHAIN. ***For Sale by Modern Method of Auction*** Bardon Hall Mews is a sympathetic conversion of a former stables and coach house dating back to 1873. In 2002 the building was renovated and converted into just 9 luxury mews houses and apartments; and is located at the end of a long sweeping private tree lined driveway surrounded by stunning, fully maintained communal gardens and grounds with mature trees, borders and lawned gardens. Accessed via double electric gates on Weetwood Lane, and surrounded by wildlife and mature woodland, the property is located a few minutes’ walk from The Hollies (an old oak woodland in Meanwood Park), only a couple of minutes’ drive from the Ring Road and just three miles from the city centre - this must be one of the best locations in north Leeds. The property provides approximately 1030 square feet of living accommodation and comprises: entrance hall, guest WC, dual aspect living room, a spacious fitted kitchen with excellent storage, principal bedroom with en suite bathroom, second double bedroom and a family bathroom. Gas central heating, double-glazing, alarm and resident parking. NO ONWARD CHAIN. Weetwood is a highly sought after suburb in north Leeds, located approximately 4 miles out of the city centre, and popular with young professionals and families alike. The property is walking distance of Far Headingley, with a range of local independent shops, restaurants and pubs. The Ring Road is easy to access for routes to Horsforth, Bradford, Harrogate etc, as too is Leeds Beckett University campus. The open spaces of The Hollies, Meanwood Park and Beckett Park are close by; and Leeds Bradford airport is a 10-15 minute drive away. results.summary: A truly impressive executive residence, meticulously renovated to an exceptional standard, showcasing striking architectural design, luxurious finishes and beautifully appointed living spaces throughout. Positioned behind electric gates and set within generous wraparound gardens, the property offers outstanding family accommodation arranged over three floors. The spectacular open plan living kitchen diner forms the heart of the home, complemented by elegant reception rooms, five generous bedrooms with multiple en-suites, and a wealth of bespoke design features including a stunning mezzanine landing, bespoke bar area and high-end contemporary finishes throughout. Located in the highly sought-after Adel area, the property combines modern luxury with generous indoor and outdoor living space, ideal for both family life and entertaining. LOCATION Situated in the highly sought-after suburb of Adel, this property enjoys a perfect blend of peaceful residential living and convenient access to city amenities. Adel is renowned for its leafy streets, attractive period homes, and strong community atmosphere, making it one of North Leeds’ most desirable neighbourhoods. The area offers excellent local amenities including independent shops, cafés, pubs, and everyday conveniences, while nearby Headingley, Meanwood, and Horsforth provide additional shopping and leisure options. For outdoor enthusiasts, Golden Acre Park and Adel Woods are just moments away, offering scenic walks and green open spaces. The property benefits from excellent transport links, with regular bus services into Leeds city centre and easy access to the A660 and Leeds Ring Road, ideal for commuters. Well-regarded primary and secondary schools are also close by, further enhancing Adel’s appeal for professionals, couples, and families alike. GROUND FLOOR The ground floor immediately impresses upon entry, with a striking entrance hallway that sets the tone for the quality and design found throughout the home. Large format tiled flooring runs underfoot, enhanced by subtle LED strip lighting integrated into the skirting and ceiling recesses which create a warm ambient atmosphere in the evening. A bespoke glazed feature above the internal doorway allows natural light to filter through the space, creating an open and welcoming first impression. A standout design feature within the hallway is the bespoke bar area positioned beneath the staircase. Beautifully crafted cabinetry incorporates wine storage, shelving and feature lighting, finished with warm timber worktops and contrasting cabinetry. The open staircase above forms a striking architectural feature while allowing light to travel freely through the space. Leading from the hallway is the family lounge, a comfortable and stylish reception room centred around a bespoke walnut media wall with integrated shelving, concealed storage and subtle mood lighting that creates an elegant focal point. Soft carpeting adds warmth underfoot, while to the front of the room an additional sitting area measuring approximately 12ft by 5ft provides a versatile reading or relaxation nook and introduces additional natural light. Undoubtedly the centrepiece of the home is the spectacular open plan living kitchen diner. Designed with modern family living and entertaining in mind, the space is flooded with natural light from expansive glazing and a dramatic roof lantern above. The contemporary kitchen is beautifully appointed with sleek cabinetry and striking marble work surfaces, complemented by feature backlit splashbacks that create a bold design statement. A large central island with breakfast bar seating forms the social heart of the room, offering generous preparation space alongside integrated appliances, soft-close storage and a Quooker boiling water tap for everyday convenience. The adjoining living and dining areas provide ample space for both informal family gatherings and larger occasions, while full height crittall-style doors to the rear can open traditionally or fold back entirely to create a seamless connection with the outdoor terrace and garden. Flowing directly from the kitchen is the formal dining room, accessed via elegant crittall-style glazed doors that maintain a visual connection while allowing the space to function independently when required. This beautifully proportioned room enjoys a dual aspect to the front and side elevations, allowing natural light to fill the space throughout the day. Rich herringbone flooring adds warmth and character underfoot, while a striking Venetian plaster ceiling with feature lighting provides a refined setting for formal dining and entertaining. Underfloor heating runs throughout the tiled areas of the ground floor, including the hallway, cloakroom and living kitchen diner, ensuring comfort throughout the seasons while maintaining a clean contemporary aesthetic. Completing the ground floor accommodation is a stylish cloakroom/WC and a well-appointed utility room fitted with cabinetry matching the kitchen, incorporating an inset sink, space for a stacked washer and dryer, and convenient side access to the front of the property. FIRST FLOOR A striking staircase rises to an impressive mezzanine landing which overlooks the entrance hallway below, creating a wonderful sense of openness and architectural flow within the home. Contemporary glass balustrading and stylish black detailing frame the space, while large glazing to the front elevation allows natural light to flood in. Feature ceiling lighting and a dramatic pendant installation above the stairwell create a striking visual centrepiece that links the design of both floors. The principal bedroom suite occupies a generous position on this level and enjoys pleasant outlooks to both the front and side elevations, allowing natural light to fill the room throughout the day. The bedroom offers excellent proportions with ample space for freestanding furniture, creating a calm and comfortable retreat. The suite is complemented by a luxurious en-suite bathroom finished to a high specification with marble-effect tiling throughout. The space features a freestanding bath alongside a separate walk-in shower enclosure, creating a spa-like environment. Contemporary black fittings, a sleek vanity unit and modern sanitaryware complete the sophisticated design. Two further double bedrooms are located on this floor, both well proportioned and offering flexible accommodation for family members, guests or home working. These rooms are served by a stylish family bathroom finished in keeping with the property’s high specification, featuring marble-effect wall tiling, a freestanding bath and a separate walk-in shower enclosure with contemporary black fittings. Overall, the first floor provides a well-balanced arrangement of bedrooms centred around the impressive mezzanine landing, which continues to highlight the home’s striking architectural design while allowing natural light to flow beautifully through the property. SECOND FLOOR The second floor continues the impressive accommodation and offers excellent flexibility within the home. A staircase leads to a further landing which provides access to two substantial bedroom suites, along with a separate dressing area and useful eaves storage. Both bedrooms are beautifully proportioned and benefit from vaulted ceilings to the front elevation, creating character and architectural interest. To the rear, the rooms have been thoughtfully extended with a box dormer, significantly increasing the usable floor space while maintaining excellent ceiling height throughout. This design creates bright, spacious bedrooms that feel far larger than a typical loft conversion. Each bedroom benefits from its own private en-suite shower room, finished in keeping with the contemporary design seen throughout the home. Stylish tiling, modern sanitaryware and sleek black fittings create elegant and functional spaces, while skylight windows above allow natural light to flood the rooms. A separate dressing area on this level provides additional flexibility and practical storage space for clothing and accessories. Combined with the generous bedrooms and en-suite facilities, this floor offers ideal accommodation for older children, guests or extended family members, continuing the high specification and thoughtful design evident throughout the property. OUTSIDE Externally the property enjoys a commanding presence, set well back from Otley Road behind an electric gated entrance which enhances both privacy and security while creating an impressive sense of arrival. Beyond the gates, a substantial driveway provides extensive off-street parking for ten vehicles or more, making the property particularly well suited to larger households or those who enjoy entertaining. The driveway also provides access to a double garage, further enhancing the practicality of the home. The property sits within generous wraparound gardens extending to the front, side and rear, allowing the home to enjoy sunlight throughout the day. To the rear is a thoughtfully designed garden space created to maximise both usability and enjoyment. Immediately outside the house is a generous gravelled terrace area, ideal for outdoor seating, dining and entertaining, while beyond this the garden gently leads down to an expansive lawn. The rear boundary is framed by a mature line of established laurel hedging, providing excellent privacy and a beautiful natural backdrop to the garden. The rear garden benefits from an east-facing aspect, allowing morning and daytime sunshine to fill the space, while the wraparound layout ensures the property enjoys sunlight throughout the day. Altogether, the external setting perfectly complements the scale and quality of the home, offering both practicality and generous outdoor space in this highly sought-after Adel location. We will also offer to clients and prospective purchasers the services of our panel solicitors, removers, and contactors. We would normally be entitled to commission or fees for such services and disclosure of all our financial interests can be found on our website. We routinely refer buyers to Mortgage Advice Bureau Limited. We receive a maximum of £30 per referral. Buyers are asked to please assist with this so that there is no delay in agreeing a sale. The cost payable by the successful buyer for this is £50 +VAT per named buyer and is paid to the firm who administer the money laundering ID checks, being Iamproperty / Movebutler. Please note the property will not be marked as sold subject to contract until the appropriate identification has been provided. PLEASE NOTE The extent of the property and its boundaries are subject to verification by inspection of the title deeds. The measurements in these particulars are approximate and have been provided for guidance purposes only. The fixtures, fittings and appliances have not been tested and therefore no guarantee can be given that they are in working order. results.summary: Cornerstone are delighted to offer for sale this beautifully presented, 2018 built two-bedroom, three-storey corner townhouse, occupying an enviable position at the head of a quiet cul-de-sac, Asket Fold. Enjoying pleasant open views across the green corridor of Wykebeck Way and towards and up Easterly Road, this modern home offers stylish and flexible accommodation in a peaceful yet well-connected location. The Introduction - The property is offered for sale with no onward chain. Cornerstone are delighted to offer for sale this beautifully presented, 2018 built two-bedroom, three-storey corner townhouse, occupying an enviable position at the head of a quiet cul-de-sac, Asket Fold. Enjoying pleasant open views across the green corridor of Wykebeck Way and towards and up Easterly Road, this modern home offers stylish and flexible accommodation in a peaceful yet well-connected location. Occupying a desirable south-west facing corner plot, the property benefits from excellent natural light throughout the day and enjoys both a front and fenced side garden. A block paved parking area positioned directly in front of the property provides convenient parking. The Home - Entering through the front gate, a pathway leads up the garden to a contemporary composite front door which opens into a welcoming ground floor hallway. The ground floor has been thoughtfully designed to provide a flexible living space and comprises a well-proportioned double bedroom. Also located on this level is a modern house bathroom, along with a practical utility cupboard housing a washing machine, plus an additional storage cupboard containing the gas boiler that is accessed from the hallway. A staircase rises from the hallway to the first floor, where the true heart of the home is revealed. results.summary: Vision Properties are delighted to present this rarely available and beautifully presented four-bedroom detached family home, offering three bathrooms and a separate WC, alongside generous driveway parking, a substantial garage with integrated loft storage, and an impressive private rear garden. Situated within a quiet and exclusive cul-de-sac in the immensely sought-after area of Kirkstall, LS5, this superb home provides exceptional family living in a highly desirable setting. The property offers far more space and practicality than many comparable homes currently available on the local market. Internally, the accommodation has been thoughtfully maintained and arranged to provide flexible and comfortable family living, while externally the home benefits from a large rear garden – ideal for entertaining, outdoor dining, or simply enjoying the privacy of the surrounding setting. The generous driveway and sizeable garage further enhance the practicality of the home, offering excellent storage and secure parking. Perfectly positioned just moments from the Leeds–Liverpool Canal, the property enjoys access to scenic walking and cycling routes, making it ideal for those who appreciate outdoor living while still benefiting from excellent city connectivity. Kirkstall continues to be one of Leeds’ most popular residential locations, offering a fantastic balance of green spaces, amenities and transport links. The nearby A65 provides direct access into Leeds City Centre, while both Headingley and Kirkstall Forge train stations offer convenient rail connections for commuters. The area is also extremely well served by regular bus routes. A wide selection of retail and leisure amenities can be found close by at Savins Mill Way and Kirkstall Bridge Shopping Centres, where residents will find popular retailers including Morrisons, Boots and PureGym. The nearby Kirkstall Bridge Inn is a much-loved local spot, while Cardigan Fields leisure complex offers a cinema, bowling alley, gym and a variety of restaurants and bars. For those who enjoy the outdoors, Kirkstall Abbey and its surrounding parkland provide a beautiful historic setting for walks and recreation, while the neighbouring areas of Horsforth and Headingley offer vibrant social scenes with a fantastic choice of cafés, bars and restaurants. Headingley Stadium is also just a short distance away. Homes of this size and setting within such a peaceful cul-de-sac are rarely available on the open market, making this a superb opportunity for families seeking space, convenience and a highly desirable Leeds location. The current vendors, who are relocating for work, have thoroughly enjoyed their time in the property and comment: "This home has been incredibly special to us and has brought so much joy over the past 12 years. From the moment we moved in, it has always had a peaceful, calming energy that makes it feel like a true sanctuary. It has been a wonderful place to raise our family, on a quiet street with a genuine sense of community and the loveliest neighbours who really look out for one another. We have loved the freedom of watching our children play safely outside and grow up in such a friendly environment, and we’ve made many treasured memories here – from BBQs and street gatherings with neighbours to long, sunny summer days spent relaxing and playing in the garden. The location has been perfect for us too – close to great amenities, beautiful canal walks and with easy access to the city centre, it truly offers the best of everything. We will always hold this home close to our hearts, and we hope the next owners will create just as many happy memories here as we have." results.summary: An immaculately presented four double bedroom detached family home, occupying an exclusive and peaceful cul-de-sac setting in one of Horsforth’s most sought-after locations. Fully redecorated to an exceptional, turnkey standard, this stylish residence seamlessly blends refined interiors with beautiful outdoor spaces, all while enjoying idyllic countryside walks, open fields and river views just moments from the doorstep. With Horsforth’s renowned schools, amenities, train station and Leeds Bradford Airport close at hand, this home offers an enviable lifestyle of tranquillity and convenience. LOCATION Perfectly situated in this prime North Leeds location within Horsforth Vale, a semi-rural setting yet with every convenience on your doorstep. Transport links and local train stations get you into the City centre and beyond and the extensive motorway network is easily accessed to take you further afield. In Horsforth Village there is a wide selection of shops, eateries and trendy cafe/bars etc, the local park is very popular with families and several sports centres/golf and tennis clubs are all available locally. There are schools to suit all ages and requirements, including private and co-ed, many of them highly regarded. For the more travelled commuter Leeds Bradford Airport is a few miles away. You will find beautiful open countryside around you where walks and cycling can be enjoyed during important family leisure time. GROUND FLOOR The ground floor welcomes you into a light and inviting entrance hallway that immediately sets the tone for the quality and finish found throughout the home. To the front sits an elegant and generously proportioned lounge, featuring solid oak flooring and a calm, contemporary ambience ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. To the rear, the impressive family dining kitchen forms the heart of the home, flooded with natural light from floor-to-ceiling glazing and French doors that open directly onto the landscaped patio and garden beyond. The kitchen is beautifully appointed with quartz work surfaces, integrated appliances and excellent storage, perfectly designed for modern family life. A separate utility room and stylish guest WC complete the ground floor accommodation. FIRST FLOOR Rising to the first floor, the home continues to impress with four beautifully finished double bedrooms, each presented to an exceptional standard. The luxurious principal suite offers a serene retreat, complete with fitted wardrobes and a contemporary ensuite shower room. The remaining bedrooms are spacious and versatile, ideal for family members, guests or home working, and are served by a sleek, modern house bathroom finished with high-quality fittings and finishes. OUTSIDE Externally, the property enjoys a private and enclosed rear garden that has been thoughtfully enhanced to create a superb outdoor living environment. Stylish, landscaped patio areas provide the perfect setting for al fresco dining, entertaining and relaxing, seamlessly linking with the dining kitchen to extend everyday living into the outdoors. Beyond the patios, a well-maintained lawn is bordered by attractive stone walling and fencing, offering a safe and versatile space for children and pets. To the front, the home benefits from driveway parking and an attached garage, completing the excellent outdoor offering of this beautifully presented family residence. BROCHURE DETAILS Hardisty and Co prepared these details, including photography, in accordance with our estate agency agreement. SERVICES – Disclosure of Financial Interests Unless instructed otherwise, the company would normally offer all clients, applicants, and prospective purchasers its full range of estate agency services, including the valuation of their present property and sales service. We also intend to offer clients, applicants and prospective purchasers' mortgage and financial services advice through our association with Mortgage Advice Bureau. We will also offer to clients and prospective purchasers the services of our panel solicitors, removers, and contactors. We would normally be entitled to commission or fees for such services and disclosure of all our financial interests can be found on our website. MORTGAGE SERVICES We are whole of market and would love to help with your purchase or remortgage. Call to book your appointment today option 4. Otley - Otley is a beautiful Yorkshire market town having a population of approximately 15,000 people, set on the banks of the River Wharfe. Otley is a friendly and picturesque town with a rich commercial and community life. The town lies in attractive countryside within Mid-Wharfedale at the centre of the rural triangle between Leeds, Harrogate and Bradford. Immediately to the south of the town rises Otley Chevin, which gives magnificent views over Mid-Wharfedale, fantastic walks and cycling routes and in the past provided much of the stone from which the town centre was built. Highly regarded primary schools and the outstanding Prince Henry's Grammar School are found within the town itself, together with a lovely mix of popular branded stores and a fantastic array of independently run shops, making Otley a very popular and pleasant town in which to live. results.summary: Set within the ever-popular Roundhay area, this attractive semi-detached home presents a wonderful opportunity for those looking to begin their journey in one of Leeds' most sought-after neighbourhoods. With a generous driveway providing ample off-street parking, along with a garage offering additional parking or useful storage space, the property combines practicality with comfortable family living. A welcoming porch provides the perfect space for coats and shoes before stepping into the main hallway, setting a warm and inviting tone for the rest of the home. Immediately to the right, the dining room enjoys a large window overlooking the front garden, allowing natural light to pour into the space throughout the day. This bright and welcoming space works beautifully for both everyday meals and relaxed gatherings with friends and family. Continuing down the hallway, the home opens into an extended kitchen that forms a bright and sociable hub of the property. A skylight window floods the space with natural light, while wooden flooring adds warmth and character. Thoughtfully designed, the kitchen also features a built-in pantry cupboard and a breakfast bar, perfect for casual dining, morning coffees, or catching up at the end of the day. Just off the kitchen, the reception room provides a comfortable and versatile living space. Patio doors open directly onto the rear garden, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living while allowing the room to benefit from the home's desirable south-west facing aspect. A statement fireplace provides a cosy focal point, making this a wonderful room to enjoy throughout the seasons. Upstairs, the family bathroom is positioned to the rear of the property and is fitted with a bath/shower. The principal bedroom sits next door, overlooking the generous rear garden and offering a peaceful place to unwind. A further double bedroom and a single bedroom complete the first floor, providing flexible accommodation that can easily adapt to family life, guest space, or working from home. Outside, the garden is a standout feature of the home. A paved patio area sits just beyond the house, currently arranged with a dining table for outdoor meals and summer gatherings. The lawn stretches back an impressive distance, where a mature tree creates a lovely focal point and adds a natural sense of greenery to the space. With its bright kitchen, welcoming living spaces, and generous south-west facing garden, the home offers a wonderful setting for both everyday family life and relaxed entertaining. The property sits within easy reach of Roundhay Park, offering acres of green space, lakes, woodland walks, and cafés to enjoy throughout the year. Nearby Street Lane provides a vibrant selection of independent cafés, restaurants, and everyday amenities. The area is also well regarded for its excellent local schools and convenient transport links into Leeds city centre, making it an ideal location for both families and professionals. These include a variety of shops, cafés, and popular restaurants. The property opens into a spacious and welcoming entrance hallway, leading to a shaker-style kitchen offering ample storage and a shelved pantry. To the front of the property is a generously sized lounge featuring a large bay window that allows natural morning light to flood the room, along with an electric fireplace. To the rear is a separate dining and entertaining room, a versatile space that has been extended and is currently used as both a dining and living area. This room benefits from patio doors opening onto a private, west-facing garden. To the first floor are two generous double bedrooms, along with a third extended bedroom that comfortably accommodates a single bed and fitted furniture. The house bathroom includes an over-bath shower, wash basin, and storage units for towels and bedding, complemented by a separate WC. There is also access to a fully insulated, partially boarded loft space. Externally, the property features a front garden with a large driveway leading to an extended walk-through garage/workshop with power and lighting, which also houses the boiler. The rear garden is private, secure, and a blank canvas, offering ample space for children to play or for further landscaping. The home is fully double glazed, cavity wall insulated, benefits from gas central heating, and is fitted with a security alarm. Street Lane offers an extensive selection of amenities, including well-regarded restaurants, café bars, designer boutiques, and a variety of shops. Further facilities can be found at Oakwood Parade and Moortown Corner, including supermarkets, banks, and additional dining options. Nearby Roundhay Park provides a wealth of recreational amenities such as parkland walks, lakes, tennis courts, Canal Gardens, Soldiers’ Field, and the popular Tropical World attraction. results.summary: A smartly presented, one bedroom, first floor apartment with balcony set within this prestigious development for the over 65’s with superb facilities and grounds, located in a central location close to the River Wharfe and Otley’s wide array of amenities. A rare opportunity to acquire a well planned, one bedroom first floor apartment for the over 65’s in the exclusive Adlington House development designed for residents to maintain an independent lifestyle. The apartment is located within easy reach of Otley’s amenities and the accommodation has pleasant views and a sitting out area with balcony and views of the communal grounds. There is an open plan area split into sitting and dining portions with the kitchen having a range of quality appliances, a substantial double bedroom with fitted wardrobes, shower room and useful storage area/utility room. There is 24-hour support every day, 365 days a year, in case of any emergency, working in tandem with a discreet emergency call system installed in each apartment included in the service charge. Adlington House communal areas are welcoming and provide areas for residents to socialise. The apartments are built with wider doorways and spacious rooms for wheelchair access. A fully furnished guest suite with en-suite facilities is available to pre-book for visitors and there is a table service restaurant for all residents and any family or friends of residents visiting. The development is a few yards from the River Wharfe with some delightful riverside walks nearby and the amenities in this thriving market town are also close to hand, these include shops, supermarkets, traditional pubs, places of worship and many leisure facilities. The town centre bus station has a regular service to Leeds, Bradford and Harrogate and in addition there is a railway station at nearby Menston offering main line links. results.summary: Step through the front door and into the inviting entrance hallway, where the charm and character of this home immediately shine through. Beautiful wooden flooring, intricate coving, and elegant period features set the stage for the warm and welcoming spaces that follow. The lounge is a true highlight, with its stunning original fireplace, graceful white coving, and an intricately detailed ceiling that adds depth and grandeur. A large bay window floods the room with natural light, enhancing the soft, neutral tones of the walls and emphasizing the timeless beauty of this space. Across the hallway, the generously sized kitchen offers plenty of storage with original wooden cupboards and drawers. Sunlight streams through the window, showcasing the period charm that makes this room so special. A traditional range cooker stands as a nod to the home's history. With potential for modernisation, this space could be transformed into a stunning kitchen-diner that seamlessly blends contemporary living with classic character. The dining room is perfect for hosting, featuring rich wooden flooring and a cosy log burner that adds warmth and ambiance. Two large windows allow light to pour in, making this an inviting and versatile space ideal for family meals or entertaining guests. Completing the ground floor is a convenient downstairs bathroom, fitted with a two-piece suite (toilet and sink) and finished in neutral tones with sleek ceiling spotlights. As you make your way upstairs, the original wooden banisters, intricate coving, and traditional doors continue to tell the story of this home's rich heritage. The principal bedroom is a bright and spacious retreat, tastefully decorated in soft pink tones. A large window overlooks the front garden, while built-in wardrobes provide ample storage. This room also benefits from a private en-suite bathroom, complete with a shower, toilet, and sink. Designed as a wet room, it features modern spotlights and a large window, creating a fresh and airy atmosphere. The second bedroom boasts beautiful views over the garden and has recently been refreshed in crisp white tones. Flooded with natural light, this space is perfect as a guest bedroom or a generous home office. For added convenience, a separate toilet is discreetly tucked away at the top of the stairs. The family bathroom, meanwhile, offers a luxurious Jacuzzi bath with a shower overhead, a stylish sink, and a classic white tile surround-an ideal spot to unwind after a long day. The final bedroom is another generously sized space, uniquely shaped with two large windows that invite in plenty of natural light. With built-in storage cupboards and a charming original fireplace, this room is brimming with character and potential for personalisation. One of the home's most exciting features is the large basement, which spans two separate areas, each with its own window. This expansive space offers endless possibilities-it could be transformed into additional living quarters, a home gym, a cinema room, or even a stylish office. Alternatively, it provides ample storage for those needing extra space to keep belongings neatly tucked away. Previously used as a wood workshop, the basement's versatility is truly impressive. The garden is a hidden gem, offering a private and tranquil escape from the bustle of everyday life. Thoughtfully landscaped with mature trees, flowering plants, and a charming stone patio, this outdoor space is perfect for entertaining, al fresco dining, or simply unwinding with a morning coffee. A small pond adds to the peaceful ambiance, while strategic planting ensures year-round beauty and serenity. The property benefits from both front and rear access, making it easy to transition between indoor and outdoor living. The rear of the property also gives access to Chapel Allerton allotments just across the street, offering an excellent opportunity for keen gardeners or those looking to grow their own produce. Whether you envision hosting summer barbecues, creating a play area for children, or designing your dream garden, this space is brimming with potential. Nestled in the heart of Chapel Allerton, this home enjoys an enviable location on Harrogate Road. The bustling high street is just a stone's throw away, offering popular local bars like Further North and The Regent, family-friendly pubs, cosy cafes, and independent shops-including butchers and fishmongers. Grocery shopping is a breeze with Aldi and Co-op nearby. Families will appreciate the excellent local schools, including Little Owls Nursery, Chapel Allerton Primary School, and Carr Manor Community School, while nature lovers can explore the scenic Gledhow Valley Woods for leisurely walks. With excellent transport links and the city centre just 10 minutes away, this charming home offers the perfect balance of comfort, style, and convenience. results.summary: A truly unique rural retreat blending countryside tranquillity with distinctive design Set along the highly regarded Church Lane in Bardsey, this exceptional modern stable conversion offers a rare opportunity to acquire a home of genuine character, privacy and charm, all set within approximately one acre of beautifully varied grounds. Blending countryside tranquillity with distinctive design, this remarkable property is unlike anything else currently available in the area. Originally converted from stables, the home has been thoughtfully transformed into a striking residence that perfectly balances modern comfort with its unique heritage. The result is a property that feels both individual and welcoming, with well-proportioned accommodation arranged to make the most of the surrounding landscape. The internal layout provides versatile living space extending to over 1,500 sq ft, including a generous living room with large picture windows framing the countryside beyond, a spacious dining room ideal for entertaining, and a well-appointed kitchen with views across the gardens. The ground floor also offers a bedroom suite with ensuite facilities alongside additional practical spaces including a utility room. To the first floor, a further bedroom with ensuite enjoys elevated outlooks across the grounds and rural surroundings. However, it is the setting and land that truly set this home apart. The property occupies a magnificent plot extending to approximately 1.3 acres, an exceptional feature rarely found with homes of this type. The grounds are beautifully varied, combining formal landscaped gardens with an enchanting woodland area including apple and other mature trees, creating a sense of privacy and seclusion while offering endless potential for enjoyment. To the front, carefully maintained gardens and a sweeping driveway create a wonderful first impression, leading to a detached garage and generous parking. Beyond the house, the grounds open out into expansive lawns and mature planting before giving way to a charming woodland area, adding character, wildlife interest and an idyllic natural backdrop. From many vantage points around the property there are far-reaching views across open countryside, providing a constantly changing rural panorama that enhances the sense of peace and escape. Properties of this nature — combining distinctive architecture, generous accommodation, and such substantial grounds — rarely become available in this sought-after village location. The result is a home that feels truly special, offering a lifestyle opportunity as much as a place to live. For buyers seeking something beyond the ordinary, this remarkable and highly individual property must be viewed to be fully appreciated. Early viewing is strongly recommended.
